TL;DR: 本文提出PanicCognitivePath (PCP)框架，基于评估情绪理论将恐慌情绪唤醒时机预测任务从行为推断范式转变为正向认知评估范式。PCP通过心理安全距离(PSD)模型融合物理、社会、认知、信息四域信号为统一风险指标，在经典BDI架构中引入显式Emotion节点形成BDEI认知路径，并将LLM限制在仅执行Belief-to-Desire转换的参数推断任务以抑制幻觉传播。在Hurricane Sandy数据集上的实验表明，PCP将个体唤醒时机准确率提升10.68pp，峰值数量误差降至7.07%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 紧急事件(如飓风、地震)中恐慌情绪的群体性爆发常造成比物理灾害更严重的次生伤害。现有方法(微分方程、ABM、LLM生成式代理)要么依赖平均化假设或预设规则，要么将LLM置于决策中心导致幻觉跨步传播，均未显式建模情绪唤醒过程，缺乏心理学保真度。论文主张以评估情绪理论(appraisal emotion theory)为基础进行恐慌唤醒时机预测，需解决三大挑战：多域威胁信号融合、显式情绪节点缺失、LLM幻觉与脆弱性。

Method: PCP框架包含三大核心组件：(1)心理安全距离(PSD)模型——基于心理距离理论，通过概率时空权衡(PTST)模型聚合时间、空间、社交、客观风险四个维度，形成统一风险度量V作为路径进入条件；(2)BDEI认知路径图——在BDI基础上引入显式Emotion节点(E)，构成O→B→D→E→I的五节点因果路径，将隐式情绪唤醒过程分解为可追踪的状态转换；(3)受限LLM角色——LLM仅承担B→D转换中的PPDTS量表(18题1-4分制)作答与认知因素计算，D→E转换采用基于欲望激活数量、激活强度均值和PSD归一化影响的概率公式P_panic采样生成二值恐慌状态。整个框架在飓风Sandy数据集(9,065用户、115时间步)上验证，LLM采用Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct (T=0.3)。

Result: 在Hurricane Sandy实验上，PCP实现峰值数量误差7.07%(次优ECR-Chain为18.80%)、峰值时间偏差2步(最优)；微层面总体准确率75.66%、Macro F1 0.5441，领先所有基线10.68pp；非恐慌/即时恐慌/延迟恐慌三类F1分别为0.8730/0.6401/0.1194。消融实验证实BDEI路径、PSD、LLM三者缺一不可，移除任一组件均导致峰值误差激增至72%-379%；同时PSD前置过滤使推理时间从纯LLM变体的115h56min降至14h27min(约8×加速)。鲁棒性分析显示Qwen2.5-72B在T=0.3下CV最低(0.076)，具有最佳评分稳定性。延迟恐慌识别为各方法共同瓶颈(PCP延迟F1=0.1194)，因现有方法均未建模次生事件对唤醒的再触发作用。

Conclusion: 论文论证了恐慌唤醒时机预测应被视作结构化认知路径推理而非行为模式拟合或无约束LLM生成。PCP通过三原则实现设计：(1)多域异构数据融合为统一感知度量；(2)目标过程分解为可追踪认知步骤；(3)将LLM约束于显式路径中的明确定义子任务而非置于决策中心。该框架将心理学理论与计算建模相连，为具有理论结构、多域输入需求且需结构化护栏的生成模型的社会仿真问题提供通用设计原则。局限包括：未建模次生事件交互、仅在单一飓风事件验证、PSD权重与欲望阈值缺乏自适应优化、Emotion-to-Intention转换采用简化模型。

Abstract: Predicting individual panic emotional arousal timing before manifestation is essential for proactive emergency intervention. Existing methods incorporate cognitive elements but none explicitly model the emotional arousal process, making them ill-suited for emotional arousal timing prediction. We argue that grounding prediction in appraisal emotion theory is necessary because it explicitly models this process, but three problems must be solved. (1) Appraisal theory posits that emotion arises from simultaneous evaluation across multiple threat dimensions, yet no prior work fuses these inputs into risk perception. (2) Existing cognitive models lack an Emotion node, decoupling threat appraisal from emotional arousal and forcing emotions to be inferred indirectly from behaviors. (3) Given their generalizable cognitive reasoning, current approaches adopt LLMs as the primary decision-maker, yet overlook the fragility and hallucination-proneness of their outputs. To address these issues, we introduce PanicCognitivePath (PCP), a framework that addresses all three. A Psychological Safety Distance (PSD) model, grounded in psychological distance theory, maps four-domain signals into a unified risk metric as the entry condition for subsequent cognitive reasoning. An explicit Emotion node grounded in appraisal emotion theory is introduced into BDI, forming a Belief-Desire-Emotion-Intention (BDEI) pathway. Agents whose risk metric exceeds the PSD threshold enter this pathway, coupling threat appraisal directly to emotional arousal. The BDEI pathway governs all state transitions while the LLM is confined to parameter estimation for the Belief-to-Desire transition, confining hallucinations to a single step and preventing error propagation. Experiments on Hurricane Sandy show PCP improves arousal timing accuracy by 10.68% over baselines, reduces peak count error to 7.07%.

</details>


### [72] [Can Agents Read the Room? Benchmarking Visual Social Intelligence in Multimodal Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15152)
*Shijun Wan,Xuehai Wu,Jiwen Zhang,Siyuan Wang,Zhongyu Wei*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出AgentViSS基准,用于评估多模态社交模拟中的视觉社交智能,涵盖240个场景、585个角色实例和2340个角色任务实例,通过文本-视觉对齐证据和四个角色级任务(表达、特征、交互调节、交互结果)测试多模态大语言模型利用视觉线索进行社交决策的能力,发现当前模型在局部角色扮演上接近饱和,但在交互管理和视觉信息整合方面仍存在显著困难。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有社交智能体基准大多基于文本,缺乏对视觉社交线索(面部表情、姿态、目光、情绪变化)的测试,无法评估多模态智能体是否能利用视觉证据指导交互决策。现实社交中,语言与可见行为常常不一致(例如口头表示没事但姿态和表情透露低落),纯文本环境无法复现这些关键信号。

Method: 1)从美剧《老友记》第一季脚本构建240个社交场景,提取群组图像和角色肖像作为视觉证据;2)为每个角色设计结构化档案(包含表达风格五类:诚实信号/策略性保留/欺骗/夸大/压制,以及冲突特征五类:竞争/合作/妥协/回避/迁就);3)基于BDI-Risk(信念-欲望-意图-失败风险)框架生成四个角色级任务维度;4)在两种观察模式下进行多轮模拟:verbalized-vision(VV,先转图像为文字)和direct-vision(DV,直接输入图像);5)使用三个评判模型(Gemini-3.1-pro-preview、GPT-5.4、Qwen3.5-27B)多数投票评估七个MLLM;6)设计三标签评分体系(Achieved/Partially Achieved/Not Achieved)并归一化为0-100分。

Result: 1)角色扮演任务(Expression/Characteristic)平均分达94.37,接近饱和;2)交互管理任务(Int.-Reg./Int.-Out.)平均分仅57.39,显著更难;3)VV在交互调节任务上比DV高18.39分(VV:49.60 vs DV:31.21),其他任务差异小于2分;4)Claude-Sonnet-4.6表现最佳(71.32),InternVL3.5-241B表现最差(43.87);5)强视觉依赖型结果任务比弱视觉依赖型低约21分;6)视觉描述质量高(Sonnet达2.94/3)但DV性能仍低,表明存在"感知-决策整合瓶颈";7)与纯文本基线相比,视觉信息确实提供额外社交信息;8)交互管理难度随参与者数量增加而上升(2人:53.67 vs 5人:30.89,VV模式);9)信息寻求类对话最难,争议性对话相对容易。

Conclusion: 当前多模态大语言模型在角色表达风格和冲突处理方面已接近饱和,但在视觉驱动的交互调节和结果实现上仍存在显著差距,核心瓶颈在于"感知-决策整合"——模型虽能描述视觉内容却难以将其转化为有效的交互决策。verbalized-vision显著优于direct-vision,说明将视觉线索显性化为语言有助于决策;但即便如此,强视觉依赖型任务仍困难。视觉证据对社交交互有独特价值,纯文本环境不足以模拟真实社交场景。该基准为评估多模态社交智能提供了重要测试平台,揭示了未来模型需要在视觉信息向交互决策转化方面取得突破。

Abstract: Social interaction depends on both language and visible social signals, such as facial expressions, posture, gaze, and emotional shifts. Yet existing social-agent benchmarks are largely text-based and rarely test whether multimodal agents can use visual cues to guide interaction. We introduce \textsc{\benchmarkname{}}, a benchmark evaluating visual social intelligence in multimodal social simulation. It contains 240 scenarios, 585 role instances, and 2,340 role-task instances, combining aligned textual-visual evidence, structured role profiles, and four role-level tasks: expression task, characteristic task, interaction regulation task, and interaction outcome task. Evaluating seven recent MLLMs under verbalized-vision and direct-vision reveals a clear gap between local role enactment and interaction management: role-specific expression and conflict handling are near saturation, whereas interaction regulation and visually grounded outcome achievement remain substantially more difficult. The code is released at this https URL , and the dataset is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [73] [Beyond Layer Importance in Layer-wise Sparsity: An Inter-Layer Perturbation-Absorption Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15161)
*Tao Jing,Ningxin Wu,Chen Kang,Dong Yu,Changliang Li,Pengyuan Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新的层间稀疏度分配视角：扰动吸收（perturbation-absorption）。通过在Transformer各层注入受控扰动并追踪其在深度方向上的传播行为，发现浅层倾向于放大扰动，而中后层会主动吸收扰动（相对L2漂移沿深度单调下降，且方向重新对齐到未扰动轨迹）。这种吸收是大扰动下的非线性现象，小扰动下网络处于线性化区域表现为单调累积。据此定义每层"吸收系数"r_ℓ，并提出吸收感知修正（absorption-aware correction），作为一种与现有指标法正交的增强，叠加在OWL和AlphaPruning之上，在70%稀疏度下使困惑度平均降低7.13%、零样本准确率提升1.02%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有层间非均匀稀疏度分配方法（OWL/AlphaPruning/ALS等指标法，DSA/EvoPress等搜索法，ATP等显式建模层间耦合的方法）主要基于层内局部信号或线性化重建误差传播分析，但都忽略了网络对剪枝引入扰动的实际下游响应——即后续层是放大还是吸收该扰动。论文认为层的"可剪枝性"不仅取决于自身重要性，还取决于下游网络的补偿能力，这是一个被忽略的维度。

Method: 1) 提出尺度不变的相对重建误差R_ℓ = ‖h̃_ℓ - h_ℓ‖_F / ‖h_ℓ‖_F，避免隐藏状态范数随深度增长带来的尺度偏差。2) 层间扰动注入实验：在第ℓ层输出h_ℓ上叠加高斯扰动δ_ℓ = η·‖h_ℓ‖_F·ξ（η为相对幅值），保持上游不变，追踪R_k沿后续深度的演化。3) 关键发现：η=10⁻²（剪枝尺度）下，浅层注入被放大、中后层注入被吸收且方向重对齐；η=10⁻⁴下所有层均表现为累积放大；过渡随幅值平滑发生，机制为非线性组件（LayerNorm、softmax重分布、激活饱和）介入。4) 定义吸收系数r_ℓ = E_x[R_L/R_ℓ]，r_ℓ<1为吸收、>1为放大。5) 吸收感知修正：对log r_ℓ做clip-mean-center得到零均值修正信号Δ_ℓ，通过能量归一化参数β控制修正强度，按Algorithm 1在保持全局稀疏度预算严格不变的前提下重新分配每层稀疏度。6) 在Wanda和SparseGPT两种底层剪枝方法上叠加OWL/AlphaPruning+abs进行实验，覆盖7个模型家族（LLaMA-2-7B/13B、LLaMA-3.2-3B、OPT-6.7B、Mistral-7B、Vicuna-7B、Qwen3-8B），评测WikiText-2困惑度与7项零样本任务。

Result: 在70%稀疏度下：吸收感知修正使OWL和AlphaPruning在大多数模型-剪枝方法组合上困惑度下降，平均降低7.13%；零样本准确率平均提升1.02%。以SparseGPT+OWL+abs为例，相对SparseGPT+OWL在LLaMA-2-7B上困惑度从19.72→18.27（↓7.35%），OPT-6.7B上76.33→54.36（↓28.78%）。Wanda+AlphaPruning+abs在Vicuna-7B上困惑度从37.62→28.11（↓25.28%），零样本准确率43.33→47.37（↑9.32%）。计算开销方面，吸收系数估计在LLaMA-2-7B上仅需1.90分钟，约为SparseGPT剪枝时间的27.7%，可忽略。消融实验：用高斯随机修正向量替代吸收信号后，性能与基线相当甚至更差，证明增益来自吸收信号本身而非额外的搜索自由度。

Conclusion: 论文将层间稀疏度分配的研究视角从"层重要性"拓展到"扰动吸收"维度，揭示了Transformer层对剪枝尺度扰动的异质性、非线性响应特性，并通过简单正交的吸收感知修正验证了该维度的实用价值。作者呼吁未来层间剪枝研究从代理信号的精细化转向对剪枝扰动传播的直接表征。论文的局限在于：未声称取得SOTA，主要验证增量增益；吸收系数估计仍需额外前向传播（约27.7%开销）；实验限于≤13B模型和单GPU。

Abstract: The considerable layer-wise redundancy in large language models (LLMs) has established non-uniform sparsity allocation across layers as the standard pruning approach for efficient compression. Existing layer-wise allocation methods that estimate allocation strategy from local signals such as activation outliers or weight spectra mainly derive from local layer importance, whereas the final post-pruning performance is also influenced by the network's subsequent compensatory capacity. In this paper, we directly characterize this property through controlled perturbation experiments. We make the following empirical findings. First, layers exhibit highly heterogeneous responses to pruning-scale perturbations. In most cases, early layers amplify perturbations, while middle and late layers actively absorb them, with relative L2 drift decreasing monotonically across depth and direction realigning toward the unperturbed hidden-state trajectory. Second, absorption is a large-perturbation phenomenon. Under small perturbations the network exhibits amplification across all layers, and the transition to absorption occurs smoothly as perturbation magnitude grows to pruning scale. This enriches the linearized accumulation theory underlying related works. Building on these findings, we define an absorption coefficient per layer and propose absorption-aware correction, an orthogonal augmentation that improves OWL and AlphaPruning by reducing perplexity by 7.13% and boosting zero-shot accuracy by 1.02% across multiple model families at 70% sparsity.

</details>


### [74] [AmchiBias: Measuring Stereotypical Bias in Goan Identity Groups with a Minimal Pair Dataset in English and Konkani](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15191)
*Michelle Barbosa,Sebastian Padó,Franziska Weeber*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了AmchiBias，这是首个针对印度果阿邦身份群体的社会文化刻板印象偏见评估基准数据集。该数据集包含313个最小对（minimal pairs），涵盖八个社会人口学维度（如种姓、职业、籍贯等），同时提供英语和天城体孔卡尼语两个版本。作者评估了五个多语言编码器模型在该基准上的表现，发现用英语查询时模型存在系统性刻板印象偏好（特别是印度语言模型对全印度（pan-Indian）可识别群体），而用孔卡尼语查询时分数接近随机水平，反映出低资源语言建模中"超本地"文化知识的严重缺失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的NLP偏见评估基准大多基于欧美假设（如种族、二元性别等），且印度的偏见研究也仅限于国家级（如IndiBias使用印地语和英语），忽略了印度各邦丰富且独特的社会文化子结构。果阿邦由于450年葡萄牙殖民历史，经历了种姓等级重构、本土语言孔卡尼语被压制、英语成为特权语言等独特的社会分层，形成无法映射到泛印度类别的身份群体。此外，孔卡尼语作为低资源语言，其NLP资源极为稀缺，迄今无任何偏见评估资源。本研究旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 1. 数据集构建：基于CrowS-Pairs和IndiBias的句子对方法，由第一作者（果阿本地人）选定37个身份群体覆盖8个维度。2. 使用gpt-4o-mini生成(身份群体, 属性)刻板印象元组，再生成短句；3名果阿本地标注员独立判断文化有效性（Fleiss' κ=0.446），从370个中保留316个，经去重和清洗后得到313个句子。3. 构造最小对：通过替换身份标记token构建反刻板印象句，并系统解决"职业身份耦合问题"。4. 翻译：使用Google Translate API翻译为天城体孔卡尼语，再由母语者人工修正。5. 评估：采用PLL-word-l2r伪对数似然评分（更适合多token词汇）计算偏见分数，并借鉴StereoSet的语言建模分数（LMS）区分"语言能力不足"和"真正无偏见"两种情况。在mBERT、XLM-RoBERTa、MuRIL、IndicBERT-v1、IndicBERT-v2五个编码器上进行测试，并通过bootstrap BCa方法进行显著性检验。

Result: 1. 聚合偏见分数：英语查询时分数范围为50.2%（IndicBERT-v1）至62.3%（MuRIL和IndicBERT-v2），四个模型超过53%，显示系统性刻板印象；孔卡尼语查询时分数集中在49.2%–53.4%，接近随机。2. LMS显示：mBERT和XLM-RoBERTa在孔卡尼语上LMS接近50%，说明其孔卡尼语分数低源于语言能力不足；而MuRIL和IndicBERT-v2在孔卡尼语上LMS分别达79.9%和91.4%，却几乎无偏见，表明其真正缺失果阿文化知识。3. 维度分析：英语中宗教（最高达91.7%）、职业（61.8%–74.5%）、年龄（最高87.5%）、种姓（53.5%–67.3%）维度偏见显著。4. 超本地vs泛印度：MuRIL和IndicBERT-v2对泛印度可识别群体（如印度教徒、穆斯林、刹帝利）的偏见显著高于超本地果阿群体（如Tarvottis、Mundkars），差异分别达-16.1%和-20.1%，说明英语信号反映的是泛印度预训练关联而非果阿文化知识。5. 词片段化分析：英语中词片段化与偏见呈强负相关（r=-0.821），但孔卡尼语中的词片段化差异无法解释语言间偏见差异。

Conclusion: 本文贡献了首个针对果阿身份群体的双语偏见评估基准AmchiBias，揭示了多语言NLP评估在低资源、超本地文化身份方面的关键空白。研究表明：英语查询下模型表现出的偏见主要反映泛印度预训练关联而非果阿文化知识；孔卡尼语查询下的近随机分数，对通用多语言模型反映语言能力不足，但对印度语言模型反映真正的果阿文化知识缺失。本研究强调了在偏见评估中纳入区域性和后殖民视角的必要性，呼吁开发基于文化基础语料库训练的语言模型，以提升对超本地社会文化刻板印象的敏感度。

Abstract: Socio-cultural stereotypical bias is an important consideration in the development and deployment of NLP systems. It is however often considered only at the national level, despite rich subnational socio-cultural structures. We present AmchiBias, the first benchmark for measuring socio-cultural stereotypical bias for the Indian state of Goa with its unique historically multicultural setting. It covers various Goan identity groups and comprises 313 minimal pairs across eight sociodemographic dimensions in both English and Devanagari Konkani. We then evaluate stereotypical bias in five multilingual encoder models on this benchmark. We find near-chance scores in Konkani, reflecting language incompetence for general multilingual models and a lack of Goan cultural competence for Indian language models. Queried in English, models with a stronger Indian language coverage show higher bias for pan-Indian groups than hyperlocal Goan groups. This suggests the English signal reflects pan-Indian pretraining associations rather than genuine Goan cultural knowledge. Our findings highlight a critical gap in low-resource multilingual NLP evaluation for hyperlocal community identities.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前S2ST系统在语义准确性和语音自然度方面取得显著进展，但词汇重音这一表达说话者意图和强调的关键韵律线索在跨语言传递中被严重忽视。英语等重音语言与普通话等声调语言在重音机制上存在根本差异，导致英语重音检测模型无法直接迁移；同时缺乏针对声调语言的可靠自动评估指标；现有TTS模型生成中文重音语音的能力也不稳定。这些问题共同制约了英中S2ST中的重音保留效果。

Result: 1）重音检测方面：Syl-BiLSTM F1达到0.91，显著优于Frame-Linear（F1=0.29）和Frame-BiLSTM（F1=0.66），验证了音节级池化、多层特征融合与BiLSTM上下文建模的有效性；2）S2ST客观评估：所提系统CETS-W达60.80%、CETS-S达58.30%，远高于基线（16%–25%），BLEU为47.35（与基线46.34相当，低于Gemini的54.26），UTMOS为3.68（最高）；3）主观评估：6名双语听者对20个样本的评测中，所提系统成功率达78.33%（基线11.67%–25.00%）；4）指标验证：CETS与人类主观判断呈显著正相关（Pearson r=0.52, p<10⁻⁶），绝对一致率79%。

Conclusion: 论文提出了一个涵盖数据集、检测模型、评估协议与生成模型的完整框架，有效解决了英中S2ST中重音保留的难题。Syl-BiLSTM在普通话重音检测上大幅超越英语基线，CETS作为自动评估指标与人类感知高度相关，所构建的级联S2ST系统在重音传递能力上显著优于Qwen2.5-Omni、GPT-4o-audio、Gemini+Base及StressTransfer+Base等基线，同时保持有竞争力的翻译质量和最高的语音自然度。未来的工作将把该评估与生成框架推广到更广泛的说话者和声调语言场景。

Abstract: Speech-to-speech translation (S2ST) systems have achieved impressive progress in semantic accuracy and speech naturalness. However, the cross-lingual transfer of lexical stress, a vital cue for emphasis and speaker intent, remains heavily underexplored, compounded by a lack of reliable automatic evaluation metrics for tonal languages like Chinese. We investigate English-to-Chinese S2ST stress transfer by constructing a stress-annotated Chinese dataset and an XLS-R-based Mandarin stress detector. Integrating this with the English EmphAssess system, we propose a novel objective metric for cross-lingual stress evaluation. Furthermore, we fine-tune CosyVoice3 to build a stress-aware S2ST system. Experiments demonstrate that our proposed S2ST architecture significantly outperforms existing systems in stress translation capability while maintaining competitive translation quality. Furthermore, our evaluation metric exhibits a strong correlation with human subjective judgments.

</details>


### [76] [Prior over Evidence: Stereotype-Driven Diagnosis in LLM-Based L2 Pronunciation Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15325)
*Rong Wang,Kun Sun*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文系统测试了三个多模态大语言模型（Gemini 3.0 Flash、GPT-4o、Qwen 3.5 Omni-plus）在L2英语发音反馈任务中的诊断可靠性。研究覆盖1,800条L2-Arctic语音（6种L1背景）、4个发音维度、5种证据条件，提出RA/EC/GC三指标评估框架。核心发现：39.6%的输出呈现"内部一致但事实错误"的虚构推理，音素反馈塌缩到固定的L2英语困难音清单（/θ/、/ð/、/r/、/v/），且不受L1背景或证据条件影响；声学证据仅在直接探测目标维度时（如文本化F0范围提升音高变化GC从0.18-0.19到0.45-0.62）才有效。结论是当前通用LLM更适合作为外部计算发音证据的"言语化器"而非独立诊断引擎。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CAPT系统日益依赖LLM生成书面发音反馈，隐含假设是模型诊断基于实际语音证据而非预训练先验。然而外部无法区分"接地模型"与"先验驱动模型"——两者都产生流畅自信的文本。错误的反馈比无反馈更有害，因为会误导学习者注意力。该研究旨在通过受控实验直接检验LLM发音反馈是否真正基于声学/语音证据。

Method: （1）数据：L2-Arctic语料库，6种L1背景（阿语、印地语、韩语、普通话、西班牙语、越南语）各300句，共1,800条带人工资质TextGrid标注的语音。（2）四维度标注：流畅度（slow/normal/fast，基于词/秒z分数±0.5）、音高变化（monotone/normal/varied，基于F0范围）、重音正确性、音素正确性（二元）。（3）五证据条件：text-only、text+ipa、text+acoustic（含F0 min/max、时长、强度等原始数值）、audio-only、audio+acoustic。（4）三模型API调用，温度0，结构化JSON输出。（5）三指标：RA（金标F1）、EC（无金标的内部一致性，LLM法官打分{0, 0.5, 1.0}）、GC（含金标证据的接地正确性），并定义"虚构率"Conf = |{c: EC≥0.7 ∧ GC<0.7}| / |C|。（6）元数据消融：隐藏L1/性别标签观察行为变化。

Result: 三大跨模型稳健发现：（1）RA与接地推理脱耦——在34,887个被双判的cell中，55.4%有连贯推理，但仅15.8%连贯且接地，39.6%连贯但错误（虚构），且虚构率在四个维度上均超过真实接地（流畅1.7×、音高2.4×、音素2.9×、重音3.4×）。（2）音素反馈塌缩到固定清单/θ/、/ð/、/r/、/v/，跨6种L1和5种证据条件持续复现，三者合计占发射音素token超1/3，而金标错误分布仅约20%，与对比分析预测的L1特异性替代模式相反。（3）声学证据仅在"直接探测目标维度"时有效：文本化F0使音高变化GC从0.18-0.19跃升至0.45-0.62（audio-only无法复现），流畅度提升不均匀（GPT-4o未升），重音和音素因需"目标-实现对齐"始终无法接地。消融实验进一步显示：隐藏L1标签后重音RA从0.08-0.14跳至0.40-0.65；隐藏性别后男/女声单调性评分差距反转，证明模型在利用人口统计标签而非语音本身。

Conclusion: 当前通用多模态LLM在L2发音诊断中表现出结构性"先验优先于证据"缺陷：表面F1掩盖接地失效，音素反馈退化为预训练习得的L2困难音清单，韵律预测受人口统计刻板印象驱动。仅在声学特征与目标维度一一对应时证据才能渗透。该研究为CAPT系统设计提出双重启示：评估上必须采用分层接地指标（EC+GC）以揭示"高F1幻觉"；架构上应将LLM重新定位为外部验证声学证据的下游"言语化器"，而非自主诊断引擎。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed for written pronunciation feedback in second-language (L2) English learning, under the assumption that their diagnoses are grounded in the supplied speech evidence rather than in priors from pretraining. This assumption is tested on 1,800 L2-Arctic utterances spanning six L1 backgrounds, three audio-capable LLMs, four pronunciation dimensions, and five evidence conditions ranging from a text-only baseline to numeric acoustic features and raw audio. Each (utterance x model x condition x dimension) cell is scored on three metrics: Rating Accuracy (RA) against gold labels, Evidence Coherence (EC) assessing internal consistency without ground truth, and Grounded Correctness (GC) evaluated against gold evidence. Results show three findings across models. First, rating accuracy and grounded reasoning decouple: 39.6% of judged cells contain internally coherent reasoning that supports a wrong rating, against only 15.8% where the reasoning supports a correct rating. Second, phoneme-level feedback converges to a fixed inventory of L2-English difficulty phones that recurs across all six L1 backgrounds and all evidence conditions. Third, acoustic evidence improves the rating only when the supplied feature directly probes the target dimension: textualised F0 range raises pitch-variation grounding from (0.18-0.19) to (0.45-0.62) across all three models, while stress and phoneme correctness, which require target-to-realisation alignment, remain ungrounded. The same audio waveform without textualised F0 values does not reproduce this improvement. These findings indicate that current general-purpose LLMs are more reliable as verbalisers of externally computed pronunciation evidence than as standalone diagnostic engines.

</details>


### [77] [Beyond Monolingual Deep Research: Evaluating Agents and Retrievers with Cross-Lingual BrowseComp-Plus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15345)
*Yuheng Lu,Qingcheng Zeng,Heli Qi,Puxuan Yu,Fuheng Zhao,Rui Yang,Hitomi Yanaka,Naoto Yokoya,Weihao Xuan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了XBCP（跨语言BrowseComp-Plus），这是首个用于评估跨语言深度研究（deep research）代理和多语言检索器的基准测试。该基准保留BrowseComp-Plus的英文问答空间，但将支持证据文档翻译成12种不同语言（中、英、法、德、日、韩、葡、西、斯瓦希里、沃洛夫、约鲁巴、祖鲁），构建跨语言和多语言两种设置，揭示了语言不匹配对检索和智能体证据整合带来的结构性困难。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的浏览类基准测试大多假设用户查询和支撑证据使用相同语言，忽略了智能体搜索系统在实际场景中可能需要跨语言获取证据的情况。跨语言信息检索（CLIR）虽已有研究，但评估仍局限于固定集合的排序问题，未涉及智能体在迭代搜索、证据选择和答案合成中的跨语言能力。本文旨在填补这一空白，形式化"跨语言深度研究"这一新任务。

Method: 1. 数据构建：基于BrowseComp-Plus，使用GPT-5.4将证据文档翻译成12种语言（8种高资源+4种低资源非洲语言），通过专家验证确保翻译质量（各语言平均分>4.0）。2. 两种评估设置：跨语言设置（每个查询对应单一目标语言证据）和多语言设置（5040个证据文档均匀分配到12种语言）。3. 评估对象：4个深度研究代理（GPT-OSS-20B/120B、Qwen3.6-35B-A3B、DeepSeek-V4-Pro）×5种检索器（BM25+Qwen3-Embedding-4B/8B、Multilingual-E5-Large、Arctic-Embed-L-2.0）。4. 多维评估指标：答案准确率、证据召回率、搜索行为、校准误差、引用保真度、Oracle检索等。5. 补充分析：逐语言分解、基于推理的查询扩展、推理努力控制研究。

Result: 1. 翻译证据导致准确率大幅下降（16-23pp），且密集多语言检索器也出现证据召回率损失。2. 代理在翻译环境下校准性变差，引用可靠性降低。3. 即便提供全部黄金证据（Oracle设置），翻译条件下的准确率仍低于原始语料，揭示存在独立的智能体侧证据整合瓶颈。4. 低资源语言主要在检索阶段受损（Oracle准确率仍接近高资源语言），说明问题在证据到达模型之前就已出现。5. 推理感知的查询扩展可提升跨语言检索效果，但不能完全弥合语言鸿沟。6. 提示词翻译（Oracle-tq+tp）反而降低性能，说明智能体在英语指令下表现更佳。7. DeepSeek-V4-Pro最强（原始64.70%，多语言48.80%，跨语言42.29%）。

Conclusion: 跨语言深度研究揭示了检索瓶颈和证据整合瓶颈两个可分离但相互作用的失败模式。语言不匹配是深度研究系统的结构性困难来源，而非仅仅是检索层面的扰动。检索质量提升和推理增强均不足以将跨语言问题转化为单语言问题。低资源语言的影响主要体现在检索阶段，一旦提供黄金文档，智能体仍能有效整合。未来的跨语言深度研究需要语言感知的智能体搜索策略，协同优化检索器、查询规划器、阅读器和引用机制，而非仅依赖更强的多语言检索器。

Abstract: Deep research agents are increasingly evaluated on their ability to search for evidence, reason over retrieved sources, and produce grounded answers. Existing browsing benchmarks, however, largely assume that the user's query and the supporting evidence are written in the same language, leaving open whether agentic search systems can operate when relevant evidence appears in another language. We introduce XBCP (Cross-lingual BrowseComp-Plus), a controlled benchmark that preserves the English question-and-answer space of BrowseComp-Plus but varies the languages of the supporting documents. XBCP instantiates two complementary settings: in the cross-lingual setting, each query is paired with evidence in a single assigned language. In the multilingual setting, the full evidence corpus is distributed equally and randomly across 12 languages spanning high-resource and low-resource regimes. We evaluate four deep research agents using sparse and dense multilingual retrievers, measuring answer accuracy, evidence recall, search behavior, calibration, citation fidelity, and oracle retrieval. Results reveal substantial degradation when evidence is translated. Even strong, dense retrievers lose evidence recall, and agents become less calibrated and cite evidence less reliably. Notably, accuracy remains lower even when all gold evidence is supplied directly. These findings suggest that cross-lingual deep research exposes both retrieval failures and an independent, agent-side difficulty in integrating language-mismatched evidence.

</details>


### [78] [Encode Errors: Representational Retrieval of In-Context Demonstrations for Multilingual Grammatical Error Correction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15416)
*Guangyue Peng,Wei Li,Wen Luo,Houfeng Wang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为"语法错误表示"（Grammatical Error Representation, GER）的新型检索方法，通过从大语言模型（LLM）的内部隐藏状态中提取与语义信息解耦的语法错误编码，来指导多语言语法纠错（GEC）任务中上下文学习（ICL）演示示例的检索。该方法在不进行额外训练的情况下，显著提升了多语言GEC的精确度，在高资源语言上8B开源模型可媲美GPT-4o-mini等闭源模型，在低资源语言上F0.5分数最高提升1.20倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语法纠错（GEC）需要定位和修正句子中局部的、结构性的语法错误，而传统的基于句子嵌入或kNN的检索方法将语法与语义混合在同一向量中，导致检索到的示例具有相似的语义而非相似的错误模式。此外，LLM在GEC任务中存在过度修正（over-correction）和输出与人工标注不对齐的问题。因此，需要一种能够从LLM内部状态中提取出与语义解耦的、专注于错误模式本身的表示方法，以实现更精准的演示示例检索。

Method: 1. **错误向量（EV）提取**：对LLM初始预测过程中，编辑位置与未编辑位置的隐藏状态之差应用PCA，得到主成分作为错误向量。第一主成分（EV1）反映错误的可修正难易程度，第二主成分（EV2）编码简单的错误类型（如时态）。2. **GER构建**：将错误位置的隐藏状态与同句中未编辑位置隐藏状态均值之差投影到前m个主成分上，得到语法错误表示GER，作为数据库的键。3. **检索策略**：推理时，测试输入经同样流程得到GER作为查询，通过kNN检索相似错误模式示例；并根据第一维GER绝对值动态分配示例数量（值小的错误优先分配示例）。4. **模型**：使用Llama3.1-8B-Instruct和Qwen2.5-7B/14B-Instruct等开源模型。5. **数据集**：涵盖英语（CoNLL-14, BEA-19）、德语（Falko-Merlin）、罗马尼亚语（RONACC）、爱沙尼亚语（Tartu-L1）四种语言。

Result: 1. **主要性能**：GER方法在所有五种数据集上均优于Random、Semantic、BM25、Explanation等基线方法。在GER-IPE设置下，英语CoNLL-14上F0.5提升4.36分，BEA-19上提升9.46分（相对提升约20%），德语Falko-Merlin上提升4.56分。低资源语言罗马尼亚语提升6.67分，爱沙尼亚语提升2.46分（约17%）。2. **SOTA对比**：在8B开源模型上，GER方法在高资源英语和德语上达到与Deepseek2.5和GPT-4o-mini相当的性能。3. **过度修正缓解**：GER方法主要通过大幅降低假阳性（FP）来提升精确度（FP减少近30%），有效缓解过度修正。4. **可解释性分析**：EV1可作为高效错误检测器（正确token分类准确率>98%），EV2能跨域聚类相似错误类型，证明GER的语义中立性。5. **层选择**：最优层位于模型中间层（Llama3.1第21层，Qwen2.5第12层）。6. **效率**：相比Explanation方法，GER示例选择阶段有约50倍加速。

Conclusion: 本文成功从LLM内部隐藏状态中提取出精确、可解释且语义噪声较少的语法错误表示（GER），证明了LLM内部确实编码了与语法错误相关的可解耦信息。GER驱动的检索方法在多语言GEC任务中显著优于现有检索方法，并有效缓解了LLM的过度修正问题。该研究开辟了利用LLM内部表示指导GEC任务的新方向，为可解释GEC研究提供了有前景的路径。局限性在于：GER后部维度中包含的细粒度错误分类知识难以有效分离和利用；对于超长多错误句子的处理仍有改进空间；未来可探索将错误信息用于解码过程控制等更广泛的预测流程。

Abstract: Grammatical Error Correction (GEC) involves detecting and correcting the wrong usage of grammar. While large language models (LLMs) with in-context learning (ICL) capabilities have shown significant progress on various natural language processing (NLP) tasks, their few-shot performance on GEC remains suboptimal. This is mainly due to the challenge of retrieving suitable in-context demonstrations that capture error patterns instead of semantic similarity. In this paper, we demonstrate that LLMs can inherently capture information related to grammatical errors through their internal states. From these states, we extract the Grammatical Error Representation (GER), an informative and semantically neutral encoding of grammatical errors. Our novel GER-based retrieval method significantly boosts performance in ICL settings on multilingual GEC datasets, improving the precision of correction. For high-resource languages, our results on 8B-sized open-source models match those of closed-source models such as Deepseek2.5 and GPT-4o-mini. For low-resource languages, our $F_{0.5}$ scores surpass the baseline by up to a factor of 1.20. This method provides a more precise and resource-efficient solution for multilingual GEC, offering a promising direction for interpretable GEC research.

</details>


### [79] [Pepti-Agent: An AI Agent for Peptide Design and Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15422)
*Houxu Chen,Achuth Chandrasekhar,Amir Barati Farimani*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 Pepti-Agent，一个基于 MCP 协议和大语言模型控制器的闭环治疗性肽设计框架，将生成、性质预测和单残基突变建模为可独立检查的模块化工具，通过追踪每步决策和性质变化实现可复现的多目标优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 治疗性肽设计需同时优化溶解性、溶血活性和非特异性吸附等多个相互制约的性质。现有计算流程通常以单体脚本方式耦合生成模型与性质预测器，难以检查、扩展或复用，且优化常依赖自然语言推理而非对候选分子多性质状态变化的显式追踪，限制了在多目标设计中的可复现性和策略可基准化能力。

Method: 提出 Pepti-Agent 闭环框架：将基于任务特化 PeptideGPT 的序列生成、基于 ProtBERT 的三类性质分类器（溶解性、溶血、非吸附）以及两种可互换的单残基突变算子封装为独立的 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 工具。由 LLM 控制器按需调用这些工具，并在调用间隙查询实时预测器输出，以当前多性质剖面而非纯语言推理指导序列迭代优化。系统记录每一步的控制决策、预测器输出和被接受的突变，构成可复现的轨迹数据。

Result: 论文主要报告框架设计与系统构成，而非具体的实验性肽性能数据。核心成果是将生成、预测与突变解耦为可独立检查的 MCP 工具，并配以逐步决策-预测-突变轨迹记录，从而提供一个可重复使用、可扩展的用于多目标肽设计的基准测试底座，便于候选分子的优先级排序和后续实验验证。

Conclusion: Pepti-Agent 通过 MCP 工具化与 LLM 控制器结合实时性质预测，实现以多性质状态而非语言推理驱动的治疗性肽闭环优化。该框架为多目标肽设计策略的基准比较和候选优先级评估提供了一个可复现、可扩展的计算平台。

Abstract: Therapeutic peptides occupy a valuable design space between small molecules and biologics, but their development requires satisfying several competing constraints at once: solubility, hemolytic activity, and nonspecific surface fouling are governed by overlapping sequence features, so improving one property often degrades another. Computational design addresses this by pairing generative models with sequence-based property predictors, iteratively proposing and refining candidates. However, these components are typically wired together as monolithic scripts that are difficult to inspect, extend, or reuse, and they often refine sequences by natural-language reasoning rather than by tracking the evolving multi-property state of each candidate. We present Pepti-Agent, a closed-loop, peptide-specific framework that exposes generation, property prediction, and single-residue mutation as independently inspectable Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools. A large language model controller invokes these tools and consults live predictor output between calls, so refinement is guided by each sequence's current property profile rather than by language reasoning alone. Task-specific PeptideGPT models generate candidates, ProtBERT-based classifiers score solubility, hemolysis, and non-fouling, and two interchangeable mutation operators propose sequence edits. By recording a per-step trace of controller decisions, predictor outputs, and accepted mutations, Pepti-Agent offers a reproducible substrate for benchmarking multi-objective design strategies and for prioritizing candidates for experimental validation.

</details>


### [80] [ESBMC-PLC: Formal Verification of IEC 61131-3 Ladder Diagram Programs Using SMT-Based Model Checking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15461)
*Pierre Dantas,Lucas Cordeiro,Waldir Junior*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: ESBMC-PLC 是首个支持 IEC 61131-3 梯形图（LD）原生输入的开源形式化验证工具，作为 ESBMC 模型检查器的新前端实现。它将 PLCopen XML 格式的 LD 程序翻译为 GOTO 中间表示，将 PLC 扫描周期编码为带有非确定性输入的 while(true) 循环，并通过基于 SMT 的有界模型检查（BMC）或 k-归纳法验证安全属性。在 13 个基准测试（涵盖 6 个工业领域、3 种程序来源，包括 CONTROLLINO 和 MathWorks 实际部署程序）上正确分类 61 个属性，发现 8 个可操作的 bug，所有运行在 60ms 内完成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PLC 执行安全关键程序，其梯形图（LD）编程语言是工业控制的主导语言（占北美和日本安装基数的 60% 以上），但现有的 SMT 模型检查器无法直接处理 LD 的图形化梯级-线圈表示。Stuxnet 和梯形图炸弹（LLB）攻击表明 PLC 是可行的攻击面，亟需对工业控制逻辑进行形式化验证。LD 的图形特性使其难以被传统的面向 C 的模型检查器解析和验证，形成了"翻译鸿沟"，使大多数工业控制逻辑无法被现代形式化验证技术覆盖。

Method: 方法包含五个阶段：（1）PLCopen XML 解析为内存中的梯级图；（2）YAML 属性文件解析；（3）LD 到 GOTO-IR 翻译，包括 IEC 61131-3 数据类型到 C 类型的映射（BOOL→bool, INT→int16_t, REAL→float 等）；（4）属性注入为 assert/assume 语句；（5）使用 Z3 4.13.0 作为 SMT 后端执行增量 BMC 或 k-归纳法。扫描周期编码采用三个关键设计决策：非确定性输入重采样（开放世界传感器模型）、静态持久输出线圈状态（模拟 PLC 输出映像）、无界 while(true) 循环体（支持 k-归纳法）。翻译规则覆盖 XIC/XIO 触点、OTE/OTL/OTU 线圈、TON/TOF/TP 计时器、CTU/CTD 计数器及算术功能块，设计上与 Ebnenasir 的形式化 LD 语义匹配。属性语言支持五种类型：mutual_exclusion、invariant、absence、response 和 reachability。

Result: 在 13 个基准测试（61 个属性）上实现 100% 正确分类，零误报和漏报：7 个安全程序通过 k-归纳法在 k=2 处获得无界安全证明，6 个不安全程序被正确识别并提供可操作的反例（标注故障梯级和修复建议）。发现 8 个 bug，其中 2 个在修复验证过程中意外发现。识别出两类系统性 LD 设计反模式：紧急信号传播失败和传感器故障条件下缺少互锁。所有运行在 Apple Silicon 上 60ms 内完成。同时通过 2,000 次随机输入序列（50 序列×10 扫描）的具体执行验证翻译保真度，零偏差。与 PLCverif 对比表明，ESBMC-PLC 是唯一同时提供原生 LD 输入、k-归纳无界证明和 SMT 位向量语义的开源工具。

Conclusion: ESBMC-PLC 证明了对工业 PLC 梯形图程序进行形式化验证是实用的、开源的且亚秒级完成的操作，可供任何拥有 PLCopen XML 导出的自动化工程师使用。该工作通过系统综述 22 项研究（2020-2026）识别出四个研究空白，并直接关闭了两个（缺乏开源 LD 到形式语言翻译器、缺乏 IEC 61131-3 的 ESBMC 前端）。局限包括：翻译规则尚未形式化证明等价于 IEC 61131-3 标准；不支持 REAL/FLOAT、数组、字符串和多 POU 程序；图形化 tc6_0201 格式已能解析但转换器尚未生成梯级逻辑。未来的主要方向包括：K 框架形式语义证明、与 PLCverif 集成作为 LD 前端和 ESBMC 后端、LLB 检测安全应用、扩展 IEC 61131-3 构造覆盖以及多任务和网络化扩展。

Abstract: PLCs execute safety-critical programs across industrial sectors. The dominant PLC notation, ladder diagram (LD) per IEC 61131-3, remains absent from formal verification: SMT-based model checkers cannot process LD's rung-and-coil graphics. This paper presents ESBMC-PLC, the first open-source formal verifier with native LD support (PLCopen XML format), implemented as a new ESBMC frontend. ESBMC-PLC translates LD rungs to GOTO IR, models the PLC scan cycle as a while(true) loop with nondeterministic inputs, and checks safety properties via SMT-based bounded model checking or k-induction. A five-property YAML language (mutual_exclusion, invariant, absence, response, reachability) avoids temporal logic. A survey of 22 studies (2020-2026) identifies four research gaps; ESBMC-PLC closes two of them. Evaluation on 13 benchmarks (6 domains, 3 sources - including deployed CONTROLLINO PLCs and MathWorks Simulink PLC Coder) shows correct classification across 61 properties: all 9 author-constructed programs (Categories A/B) as expected, all 4 vendor programs (Category C) correctly unlabeled, with 8 bugs found (actionable counterexamples), 7 unbounded k-induction proofs, all runs under 60ms on Apple Silicon. Feature comparison with PLCverif shows that ESBMC-PLC is the only open-source tool that combines native LD, k-induction, and SMT bit-vector semantics.

</details>


### [81] [Evaluative Judgement in Teaching AI-based Translation: A Class-room Case Study of AI-Mediated Translation and Post-Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15483)
*Gokhan Dogru*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文基于23个学生翻译项目，探讨在AI辅助翻译课堂中，如何通过结构化对比通用大语言模型与在线机器翻译系统来培养学生的翻译评价判断力。研究发现学生并非将自动评估指标视为最终权威，而是结合充分性、流畅性、术语、自然度及预期编辑工作量等维度做出选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在生成式AI和MT技术广泛渗透翻译行业的背景下，翻译教育需要探索如何培养学生针对AI生成译文进行批判性评价与判断的能力。该研究旨在填补关于学生如何在真实课堂情境中实际运用和权衡不同评估依据这一问题的研究空白。

Method: 质性与量化混合方法。基于某大学翻译专业本科四年级"机器翻译与译后编辑"课程的23个匿名学生项目（其中22个附书面报告）。学生任务流程为：将英语维基百科专业短文翻译为加泰罗尼亚语或西班牙语；生成4个系统输出；采用自动指标（automatic metrics）与人工充分性/流畅性评估进行评价；选定一个输出进行译后编辑；并在书面报告中说明选择理由。报告描述性统计数据，并对22份书面报告进行定性分析。

Result: 研究结果显示：（1）学生未将自动评估指标视为最终决策依据；（2）最终的译后编辑选择经常与自动指标的排名结果不一致；（3）学生的选择理由涵盖充分性（adequacy）、流畅性（fluency）、术语（terminology）、自然度（naturalness）以及预期译后编辑工作量（expected post-editing effort）等多个维度。该研究并非在受控条件下对系统进行基准测试，而是分析学生在真实课堂作业中如何论证系统选择。

Conclusion: 在AI中介的翻译教学中，学生展现出对自动评估指标的批判性使用态度，能够整合多维度（语言质量与编辑工作量）进行综合判断。这表明翻译评价素养（evaluative judgement）的培养应超越单纯依赖自动指标，强调对AI输出的情境化、批判性评估。该研究为翻译教育中如何整合AI工具提供了实证依据。

Abstract: Drawing on 23 anonymized student pro-jects from a fourth-year Machine Transla-tion and Post-editing course in a BA-level translation programme, this paper exam-ines how structured comparison of gen-eral-purpose LLMs and online MT sys-tems can elicit evaluative judgement in AI-mediated translation. Students translat-ed short specialised English Wikipedia texts into Catalan or Spanish, generated four system outputs, evaluated them using automatic metrics and human adequa-cy/fluency assessment, selected one output for post-editing, and justified their deci-sion in written reports. Descriptive counts are reported for all 23 projects, while qualitative interpretation is based on the 22 cases accompanied by written reports. Results show that students did not treat automatic metrics as final authority: final post-editing selections often diverged from metric rankings and were justified through adequacy, fluency, terminology, naturalness, and expected post-editing ef-fort. The study therefore does not bench-mark systems under controlled conditions; it analyses how students justified system choice within an authentic classroom as-signment.

</details>

*Nikolaos Lavidas,Kiki Nikiforidou,Dag Haug,Leonid Kulikov,Vassiliki Geka,Vassileios Symeonidis,Theodoros Michalareas,Sofia Chionidi,Anastasia Tsiropina,Eleni Plakoutsi,Evangelos Argyropoulos*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: AthDGC（Athens-PROIEL）是首个覆盖希腊语八个历时时期（古风、古典、柯因内、晚古、拜占庭、晚拜占庭、早期现代和现代希腊语）的开放许可依存句法树库，采用统一的 PROIEL XML 2.0 模式，并提供新约与拉丁文（武加大）、哥特语（乌尔菲拉）、古教会斯拉夫语（Marianus）和古典亚美尼亚语的诗句级交叉对齐。当前 v0.4 版本提供精选样本与开源工具包，完整语料库正进行 v0.5 审计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有希腊语依存树库存在历时覆盖不全、跨语言对齐资源有限、许可证受限等问题，制约了希腊语历史语言学与多语言经文比较研究。构建一个统一模式、覆盖全部主要历史阶段且与多种古文本资源对齐的开放树库具有重要学术价值。

Method: 基于 PROIEL Treebank 家族的模式与柯因内希腊语参考集构建；使用 Stanford Stanza 的 PROIEL 训练工作流进行依存标注；采用 LaBSE 多语句嵌入模型实现句子级对齐；采用基于多语言 BERT 注意力机制的 AwesomeAlign 流程实现词级对齐；统一采用 PROIEL XML 2.0 模式进行数据表示。

Result: v0.4 版本已发布精选样本与开源工具包；八个历时时期（古风至现代希腊语）均有覆盖；新约文本实现与拉丁、哥特、古教会斯拉夫、古典亚美尼亚语四语种的诗句级交叉对齐；完整的已标注语料库分区仍在希腊国家高性能计算平台上进行 v0.5 审计，详细规模与逐见证经文计数将随后发布。

Conclusion: AthDGC 是首个跨八期希腊语开放依存树库，填补了该资源空白；其与多语种古文本的对齐能力为历史语言学与圣经比较研究提供了新基础设施；v0.4 已可用，v0.5 完整版将完成审计后发布。

Abstract: AthDGC ("Athens-PROIEL") is an open, end-to-end workflow and dataset. It is, to the best of our knowledge, the first openly licensed dependency-parsed treebank of Greek that spans eight diachronic periods, namely Archaic, Classical, Koine, Late Antique, Byzantine, Late Byzantine, Early Modern, and Modern Greek, under a single PROIEL XML 2.0 schema, with verse-level cross-alignment of the New Testament to Latin (Vulgate), Gothic (Wulfila), Old Church Slavonic (Marianus), and Classical Armenian. AthDGC builds on the PROIEL Treebank Family (Haug and Johndal 2008; Eckhoff et al. 2018), which established the schema and the Koine-Greek reference set for the project. Annotation uses the Stanford Stanza PROIEL-trained workflow; sentence-level alignment uses LaBSE, a multilingual sentence-embedding model; word-level alignment uses multilingual-BERT attention through the AwesomeAlign procedure. The v0.4 release provides curated samples and the open-source toolkit; the full annotated corpus partitions remain under v0.5 audit on the Greek national HPC. Quantitative scale, per-witness verse counts, and per-period annotated-row counts are reported in the v0.5 release notes, after the audit pass completes. Concept DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20439182 .

</details>


### [83] [SHARD: Safe and Helpful Alignment via Self-Reframing Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15517)
*Viswonathan Manoranjan,Amogh Gupta,Anvesh Rao Vijjini,Thomas Hofweber,Snigdha Chaturvedi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: SHARD提出了一种自重构蒸馏方法，通过哲学伦理准则引导大语言模型将敏感提示重构为安全版本，并将模型自身重构后的安全有益响应作为监督信号进行SFT微调，从而在保持安全性的同时提升有用性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM在面对敏感提示时存在过度保守的问题：要么直接拒绝，要么给出泛化的安全套话，无法满足用户合理的预防性、教育性或自我相关信息需求（"benign intent"）。现有工作缺乏基于原则性标准的"何时以及多大程度限制"的判断依据，也未充分利用模型自身已具备的安全有益能力。

Method: SHARD包含三个核心步骤：(1) 基于Mill的伤害原则、Feinberg的最小限制标准和软家长主义等11条哲学通用准则，自动生成针对5类伤害类别的特定准则；(2) 让目标模型M自重构敏感提示P为P_reframed，并据此将原始响应O重构为安全有益的O_reframed；(3) 用LoRA SFT将M在自身(O_reframed, P)对上微调，仅保留被判定为比原始响应更有帮助的样本。评估使用Gemma 4 31B作为pairwise裁判，7个模型(4个家族)在DNA和LinguaSafe英文子集上实验。

Result: 在7个模型(4家族)上：(1) 推理时SHARD在多数模型上显著提升有用性（Qwen3.5 27B Δ=+66.4/+69.6），且安全Tie%>90%；(2) 蒸馏自重构数据后，Llama 3.1 8B胜率89.7% vs 9.1%负率；(3) 自我监督与Qwen3.5-122B教师蒸馏效果相当甚至更优（如Llama 3.1 8B自重构胜率89.7% vs 教师83.4%）；(4) 消融显示响应自重构是核心训练信号，移除后模型退化为单纯的拒绝或浅层有用性；(5) SHARD显著优于HHTune和Rational基线，证实增益来自重构而非额外训练或推理；(6) 增益随提示严重程度单调递增（Level 3 Δ=+42），公平与司法类别提升较小；(7) Mistral家族对方法响应较弱。

Conclusion: SHARD表明LLM内部已具备潜在的安全有益行为，可通过基于哲学准则的提示重构加以激发，并通过自重构蒸馏内化为模型参数；该方法在多模型多数据集上提升有用性而不损害安全性，且自我监督与大型教师蒸馏具有竞争力，为缓解safety-helpfulness trade-off提供了新路径。

Abstract: Large language models often struggle with sensitive prompts. They may refuse outright, provide generic safety boilerplate, or fail to address the user's legitimate informational needs that can be answered safely. We introduce SHARD, a self-reframing distillation method to improve safe-helpfulness. It first rewrites sensitive prompts to surface benign intent using philosophical guidelines, then reframes its original responses into safe, more helpful ones, and finally fine-tunes the model on its self-reframed responses. Across DNA and the English subset of LINGUASAFE, SHARD improves helpfulness for most model families while preserving safety. It also remains competitive with distillation from a larger teacher model, suggesting that models can internalize safe and helpful behavior elicited from their own. Warning: This paper contains content that may be offensive or harmful.

</details>


### [84] [Distilling Examples into Task Instructions: Enhanced In-Context Learning for Real-World B2B Conversations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15641)
*Guy Rotman,Adi Kopilov,Danit Berger Zalmanson,Omri Allouche*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文针对B2B（企业对企业）多边销售对话的低资源分类任务，提出了一种知识抽取框架，将冗长的少样本示例压缩为紧凑、可解释的结构化分类准则，从而在减少99% token用量的同时提升分类性能（macro-AUC提升7%），并解决了传统ICL随上下文增长而性能下降的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统上下文学习（ICL）在专业领域（如复杂多方的B2B销售对话）的低资源分类任务中存在明显局限：随着少样本示例的拼接，上下文长度急剧增加，且性能随上下文增长而下降。同时，现有的token压缩方法在该场景下也表现不佳（性能下降超过9个F1值）。如何在保持性能的同时实现高效、可解释且支持用户交互的分类，是实际NLP应用中的关键需求。

Method: 1. 构建Call Playbook数据集：包含5个从真实B2B销售对话中提炼的分类任务，聚焦核心销售概念。2. 提出新型知识抽取方法：将冗长的示例蒸馏为两类紧凑、可解释的表示——（a）结构化分类准则；（b）精确的任务描述。3. 该框架支持对分类逻辑的直接优化与精修，满足透明性、效率和用户交互需求。4. 与传统ICL及先进token压缩基线进行对比。

Result: 1. token使用量减少99%，大幅提升推理效率。2. macro-AUC比传统ICL提升最高达7%。3. 在上下文增长场景下，所提方法性能保持稳定，而token压缩基线方法F1值下降超过9个点。4. 框架支持分类逻辑的直接精修，提升了系统的可解释性和实用性。

Conclusion: 该工作表明，将少样本示例蒸馏为结构化知识表示是一种优于传统ICL和现有token压缩方案的有效路径，能够在专业领域实现高效、透明且用户可控的分类。该方法缓解了上下文长度对ICL的负面影响，对需要高透明度和交互性的实际NLP应用具有重要价值。

Abstract: In-context learning (ICL) is the standard method for low-resource classification, yet its efficacy in specialized domains remains largely unexplored. We address the challenge of classifying semantically complex, multi-party B2B conversations, where traditional ICL encounters significant limitations, especially as context length increases due to the concatenation of multiple few-shot examples. We introduce the \texttt{Call Playbook} dataset, featuring five classification tasks derived from real-world B2B conversations targeting core sales concepts. To bridge the gap between performance and practical utility, we propose novel knowledge extraction methods that distill verbose examples into compact, interpretable representations of structured classification criteria and precise task descriptions. Our approach achieves a 99\% reduction in token usage and improves macro-averaged AUC by up to 7\% over traditional ICL. Notably, it remains robust as context grows, unlike advanced token compression baselines which degrade by over 9 F1 points. Importantly, our framework enables direct refinement of classification logic, addressing critical needs for transparency, efficiency, and user interaction in real-world NLP applications.

</details>


### [85] [Extending Item Response Theory for Efficient and Meaningful Multilingual Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15643)
*Gili Lior,Tzviel Frostig,Gabriel Stanovsky,Matan Eyal*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 Multilingual-IRT 框架，将经典项目反应理论(IRT)扩展为支持多语言场景的统一统计模型，用以解决多语言基准测试中评估成本随语言数量线性增长、自动翻译错误难以检测、以及题目混淆通用与文化专有知识三大问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前多语言基准（如 MMLU-Pro-X）存在三个核心缺陷：(1) 评估开销随语言数量线性增长，难以扩展；(2) 自动翻译引入的噪声在大规模评估中易被忽略；(3) 题目常将通用知识与文化专有知识混在一起。基于准确率的简单基线方法在跨语言、跨模型比较中既不高效也缺乏诊断能力。

Method: Multilingual-IRT 在经典 IRT 基础上引入三项扩展：(1) 每语言难度偏差项，捕捉题目在不同语言下的难度差异；(2) 拆分判别力（split discriminability），将题目内容本身的区分度与语言效应分离；(3) 每语言能力残差，建模模型在不同语言上的能力偏移。在 25 个 LLM × 29 种语言 × MMLU-Pro-X 题目集上进行参数拟合。

Result: 拟合所得参数支撑三类实际应用：(1) 对未观测的 (题目, LLM, 语言) 三元组进行预测，二值交叉熵比最强准确率基线降低 11–16%；(2) 候选翻译错误检测在全部 28 种非英语语言中均有分布，而准确率基线集中于少数语言；(3) 可恢复文化专有题目，弥补准确率基线的遗漏。

Conclusion: Multilingual-IRT 提供了一个理论上统一、实践上可扩展的多语言评估范式，能够同时实现高效预测、翻译质量诊断与文化专有知识识别，显著优于传统基于准确率的方法。

Abstract: Multilingual benchmarks are central to evaluating large language models (LLMs) across languages, but they suffer from three issues: exhaustive evaluation scales linearly with the number of languages, automatic translation introduces errors that are easily missed at scale, and some items conflate general and culture-specific knowledge. We address all three with a unified statistical framework, Multilingual-IRT, which extends Item Response Theory with per-language difficulty deviations, split discriminability separating content from language effects, and per-language ability residuals. Fitting Multilingual-IRT on 25 LLMs across 29 languages of MMLU-Pro-X, we show that its fitted parameters support three practical applications: predicting unobserved (item, LLM, language) instances with 11-16% lower binary cross-entropy than the strongest accuracy-based baseline, surfacing candidate translation errors distributed across all 28 non-English languages, whereas accuracy-based baselines concentrate detections in a few languages, and recovering culture-specific items that accuracy-based baselines miss.

</details>


### [86] [Beyond English: Uncovering the Multilingual Gap in Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15714)
*Hanyang Chen,Hongliang Li,Jiarui Cao,Yang Li,Yang Jiang,Haonan Wen,Kaiyu Huang,Shengnan Guo,Huaiyu Wan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文首次系统性地研究了视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的多语言指令跟随能力，揭示了VLA模型在非英语指令上存在显著的性能差距（多语言鸿沟），并提出了一种基于主成分对齐（MPCA）的多语言微调方法来缓解该问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的VLA模型在训练和评估中主要以英语指令为主，忽视了机器人在全球化真实部署场景中需要理解多种语言指令的需求。尽管多数VLA模型采用多语言VLM作为骨干网络，但在与机器人动作对齐训练后，其多语言能力是否能有效迁移到动作执行仍不清楚。这一研究空白限制了VLA模型在多语言环境下的实际应用。

Method: 1. 构建多语言评估框架：基于LIBERO和SimplerEnv基准，通过云翻译API生成中、法、俄、阿四种语言的指令变体；同时设计代码切换（code-switching）指令，混合英语关键词与目标语言。2. 相对性能评估：定义Relative Performance指标衡量多语言性能差距。3. 系统性实验：在多种代表性VLA模型（OpenVLA-OFT、π₀.₅、ABot-M0、Cosmos Policy、Qwen2.5/3-VL系列）上进行多语言评估。4. 多角度分析：从模型行为（两种失败模式）和表征（嵌入空间偏移）两个角度分析多语言鸿沟成因。5. 提出MPCA方法：基于主成分分析（PCA）提取多语言指令表征的主成分子空间，通过余弦相似度对齐多语言表征与英语表征。

Result: 1. 揭示显著多语言鸿沟：所有VLA模型在非英语指令上均出现明显性能下降，基于PaliGemma等英语中心VLM的模型性能接近无指令状态。2. 发现四个关键规律：基础VLM的多语言训练数据是性能差距的主要驱动因素；相似视觉输入（如LIBERO-Goal）放大多语言鸿沟；代码切换中的英语关键词有助于缩小差距；扩散式动作头（GR00T/π风格）比FAST风格动作头具有更好的多语言泛化能力。3. 两种失败模式：模型无法理解指令（误判任务）和模型理解指令但无法正确执行动作。4. 表征分析显示多语言指令导致显著的嵌入空间偏移。5. MPCA方法显著提升多语言性能：在LIBERO上，阿拉伯语性能从原GR00T的59.3提升至90.8，俄语从56.5提升至85.5，且在英语上几乎不损失性能。

Conclusion: 本文首次系统性地揭示了VLA模型中存在的多语言性能鸿沟，证实了基础VLM的语言训练数据和动作头设计对多语言泛化的关键影响。提出的MPCA方法通过表征空间主成分对齐有效缩小了多语言性能差距，为增强具身智能体的多语言鲁棒性提供了一种实用解决方案。未来工作可探索更广泛的模型和基准，并开发更复杂的方法来应对多语言与视觉、动作表征交互的细微挑战。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action models have recently demonstrated promising capabilities in learning generalist robot policies from large-scale multimodal data. However, most existing VLA systems are trained and evaluated primarily with English instructions, leaving their ability to understand and execute instructions in other languages largely unexplored. While the underlying large language models often possess multilingual capabilities, it remains unclear whether these multilingual capabilities transfer to VLAs during training. In this work, we present the first systematic study of multilingual instruction following in VLA models. We first construct multilingual instructions by extending existing benchmarks with translations of their instructions. Using these instructions, we evaluate several representative VLA models across a range of tasks in simulation settings. Our experiments reveal a significant multilingual gap: models trained primarily on English instructions exhibit substantial performance degradation when evaluated on other languages, even when the underlying language backbone is multilingual. We provide several findings and analyses to understand the multilingual gap. Cross-lingual transfer behavior analysis shows that performance drops correlate with both instruction understanding and action execution. Representation analyses suggest that multilingual instruction-caused representation shifts may contribute to the multilingual gap. Motivated by these findings, we further explore strategies to improve multilingual performance in VLAs. We propose a simple yet effective multilingual fine-tuning approach, Multilingual Principal Component Alignment, which leverages Principal Component Analysis to get the principal component subspace and align projected multilingual representations, effectively reducing the multilingual performance gap.

</details>


### [87] [ttda704 at SemEval-2026 Task 6: Structured Chain-of-Thought Prompting for Political Evasion Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15770)
*Tai Tran Tan,An Dinh Thien*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文介绍作者团队参加 SemEval-2026 Task 6 (CLARITY: Unmasking Political Question Evasions) 的系统，系统性地比较了两种范式：基于 QLoRA 的 Qwen3 模型参数高效微调 (PEFT) 和基于 DeepSeek-V3.2 与 Grok-4-Fast 的结构化思维链 (CoT) 提示。最佳系统 Grok-4-Fast + 少样本分层 CoT 在子任务 2（9 类逃避策略）上 Macro F1 为 0.5147，子任务 1（3 类清晰度）上为 0.7979，分别排名第 8/33 和 13/41。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 政治人物在电视访谈中频繁使用逃避策略（话题转移、回避、拒绝），损害民主透明度。先前研究表明政治家仅 39-46% 的回答是清晰的。现有标准文本分类器在处理含蓄、微妙的逃避时表现不足，因为它们缺乏显式的语用推理能力。区分"General"与"Implicit"、"Deflection"与"Dodging"等细微类别需要上下文敏感的推理，而非表层匹配。

Method: 方法分为两条并行路线：
1. **Approach A (PEFT)**：使用 Unsloth 框架对 Qwen3 系列（4B/4B-Instruct/2507/14B/32B）进行 QLoRA 微调（4-bit NF4 量化，LoRA rank 32, alpha 64），训练 1 个 epoch，AdamW 8-bit 优化器，余弦学习率调度。为应对严重类别不平衡（13.32:1），对三个最少类（Clarification、Claims ignorance、Partial/half-answer）进行 2× 上采样，并对交叉熵损失使用逆频率加权（最大权重 5.0）。主实验中禁用 Qwen3 原生思考模式。
2. **Approach B (结构化 CoT 提示)**：对 DeepSeek-V3.2（deepseek-chat vs deepseek-reasoner）和 Grok-4-Fast（grok-4-fast vs grok-4-fast-reasoning）进行零样本/少样本（9 个示例）的分层或扁平化分类法提示。所有模型强制输出包含 reasoning 字段和 evasion_label 字段的 JSON。提示设计包括"直接性检查"和"主题忠实性"两个推理步骤。

Result: 主要结果（308 个官方测试样本）：
- **最佳系统**：Grok-4-Fast Reasoning + 少样本分层 CoT：子任务 2 F1=0.5147，子任务 1 F1=0.7979
- **最佳 PEFT 系统**：Qwen3-32B 少样本 CoT：子任务 2 F1=0.3630
- 官方排行榜：子任务 2 第 8/33，F1=0.56；子任务 1 第 13/41，F1=0.79
- 主办方修订基线：子任务 2=0.57，子任务 1=0.82

关键发现：
- 结构化 CoT 提示显著优于基线 PEFT 设置（绝对值高出约 0.15 F1）
- 启用扩展推理模式带来实质性提升
- 分层分类法作为推理支架有用，但最强提示变体之间在统计上不可区分（p>0.19）
- McNemar 检验显示 Grok 与 DeepSeek 少样本分层系统在样本层面存在显著分歧（p=0.015）
- 子任务 1 分数普遍较高，因为粗粒度清晰度将多个难分逃避标签合并到同一父类
- 错误主要出现在 Dodging（召回率 0.1852）、General、Implicit、Deflection 的相互混淆
- 思考模式后续实验：Qwen3-32B 启用思考模式将硬后备率从 37.99% 降至 0.00%，Evasion F1 从 0.0734 提升至 0.2362
- 标注者间一致性中等（Fleiss' Kappa=0.4723），最常见的分歧模式与模型混淆模式一致

成本：所有 16 个 API 配置总成本约 1.50 美元；最佳 Grok 配置全测试集 0.1359 美元。

Conclusion: 推理型 API 模型的 CoT 提示在绝对 Macro F1 上显著优于基线 PEFT 设置，但该比较受模型规模、推理能力支持和示例数量等因素混淆。最佳配置（少样本分层 CoT）与最强零样本扁平变体在统计上不可区分。分层提示作为推理支架有用，少样本示例作为任务校准，剩余最难错误源于模糊逃避标签的语用歧义。局限性：PEFT 训练仅 1 个 epoch 且无广泛超参数搜索，Qwen3 思考模式在主实验中禁用；最佳结果依赖专有 Grok-4-Fast 模型；最强可复现的开源权重配置为 DeepSeek-V3.2 Reasoning 少样本 CoT（分层）Macro F1=0.5115。

Abstract: This paper describes our system for SemEval-2026 Task 6, which addresses the classification of political evasion strategies in English question-answer pairs extracted from U.S. presidential interviews. We systematically compare two distinct paradigms: (1) Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Qwen3 models (4B-32B) using QLoRA, enhanced with tiered upsampling and weighted cross-entropy loss to address severe class imbalance, and (2) structured Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting of reasoning-capable API models, namely DeepSeek-V3.2 and Grok-4-Fast. Our evaluation demonstrates that structured CoT prompting of reasoning-enabled models substantially outperforms our baseline parameter-efficient fine-tuning implementation in absolute Macro F1. Our best system, Grok-4-Fast with extended reasoning and few-shot hierarchical CoT prompting, achieves a Macro F1 of 0.5147 on Subtask 2 (9-class evasion) and 0.7979 on Subtask 1 (3-class clarity), ranking 8th out of 33 teams on Subtask 2 and 13th out of 41 teams on Subtask 1 on the official leaderboard. Furthermore, our ablation studies reveal key insights into effective prompt design for evasion detection: presenting labels within a hierarchical taxonomy helps structure model reasoning, while few-shot exemplars provide task calibration. However, the strongest prompt variants are not statistically distinguishable in Macro F1, and explicitly enabling extended reasoning modes yields substantial performance gains by facilitating the multi-step pragmatic analysis required to detect evasive intent.

</details>


### [88] [ttda704 at SemEval-2026 Task 4: Modeling Narrative Structures via Pseudonymization and Multi-View Sentence Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15783)
*Tai Tran Tan,An Dinh Thien*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了SemEval-2026 Task 4（叙事故事相似性与叙事表示学习）的参赛系统ttda704，针对Track A（三元组分类）和Track B（表示学习）分别设计了单视图和多视图对比学习流水线，基于微调的sentence-transformer模型，并结合化名化预处理和多视图自监督对齐，在两项任务中分别获得第14名（42支队伍）和第6名（25支队伍）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 叙事相似性判断是NLP中的核心难题，传统STS方法仅关注词面重叠，而故事相似性需要建模抽象主题、情节发展和结局等深层结构。生成式LLM推理成本高、延迟大，不适合大规模故事检索，因此需要高效的嵌入式表示学习方案来捕捉叙事的深层架构。

Method: 方法包含两条流水线：Track A采用单视图对比学习，使用化名化（基于fastcoref和spaCy的共指消解与NER，将实体替换为Character_A等占位符以减少表面噪声）预处理全文本，配合all-mpnet-base-v2骨干网络、智能层冻结（冻结嵌入层和底部40%层）以及三元组边际损失（margin=0.3）进行训练。Track B采用多视图对比学习框架，通过LLM（o3-mini）将故事分解为主题、情节、结局三个视图，共享transformer骨干配合视图专属的两层投影头（768→512→768），使用对比损失（τ=0.07）和自监督视图对齐损失（λ=0.5），推理时以权重(0.5, 0.1, 0.2, 0.2)融合四个嵌入。

Result: Track A在测试集上以化名化数据获得0.6925的私有分数（第14名/42队），其中all-mpnet-base-v2结合化名化取得最佳效果（化名化使分数从0.6650提升至0.6925），化名化对MPNet有稳定增益但对其他模型效果不一致。Track B在测试集上以all-mpnet-base-v2+o3-mini组合获得0.6875分数（第6名/25队）；开发集上的融合权重消融显示(0.5, 0.1, 0.2, 0.2)优于等权或单一视图设置（0.725 vs 0.625/0.65）。LLM提取器对比中，o3-mini在测试集上与MPNet配合最佳。

Conclusion: 该工作验证了基于sentence-transformer的对比学习在叙事相似性任务上的有效性，化名化预处理能有效减少实体偏差并提升MPNet性能，多视图结构化建模配合自监督对齐能进一步改善表示质量。方案在保持推理效率的同时取得了有竞争力的成绩，适合大规模叙事检索应用。局限性包括依赖合成数据、LLM提取可能引入噪声、融合权重和温度参数在开发集上调优可能不适用于未见域。

Abstract: We present our approach to SemEval 2026 Task 4: Narrative Story Similarity and Narrative Representation Learning. Our solution uses contrastive learning with fine-tuned sentence transformers to capture narrative similarity across abstract themes, course of action, and outcomes. We develop two pipelines: (Track A) a single-view method that encodes full narratives with smart layer freezing to reduce overfitting, and (Track B) a multi-view method that models theme, plot, and outcome with view-specific projection heads and self-supervised alignment. Both pipelines build on sentence-transformers models and are trained with contrastive loss on synthetic data. The code is available at the following GitHub repository: this https URL .

</details>


### [89] [On Defining Erasure Harms for NLP](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15815)
*Yu Lu Liu,Arnav Goel,Jackie Chi Kit Cheung,Alexandra Olteanu,Ziang Xiao,Su Lin Blodgett*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文针对自然语言处理（NLP）系统中表征性伤害之一的"抹除"（erasure）问题，指出当前缺乏清晰统一的理论基础，提出了一个结构化的抹除定义框架，以明确建立和测量抹除所需的必要组成部分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: NLP系统的部署引发了对其可能造成伤害的关注，其中表征性伤害（representational harms）日益受到重视。"抹除"作为表征性伤害的一种，已开始被概念化和测量。然而，该领域目前缺乏清晰、统一的理论基础来识别和衡量抹除：现有概念化要么过于宽泛，难以确定建立和测量抹除所需的条件；要么过于特定于某些场景，虽便于在特定情境下测量，但难以推广到其他场景。这一概念基础的缺失促使作者进行此项研究。

Method: 作者通过分析现有抹除概念化中过于宽泛或过于具体的局限性，采用概念分析和定义构建的方法，发展并提出了一个结构化的抹除定义。该方法旨在澄清建立抹除发生与否所需的具体组成部分，并指导从业者明确阐述和操作化这些组件以实现抹除的测量。

Result: 论文提出了一个结构化的抹除定义框架，明确定义了建立和测量抹除现象所必需的核心组成部分。该框架为从业者提供了明确的指导，使其能够根据具体的应用场景明确阐述和操作化抹除的测量标准，从而弥合了现有理论在通用性和可操作性之间的差距。

Conclusion: 通过提出结构化的抹除定义，该研究为NLP领域中的抹除概念化奠定了更清晰、更具操作性的理论基础。该定义有助于从业者在不同情境下系统地识别和测量抹除现象，对推动NLP系统伤害评估的规范化和标准化具有重要意义。

Abstract: The deployment of NLP systems has raised concerns about harms they might produce, including representational harms. Recent literature has begun to conceptualize and measure one such harm, the harm of erasure. Nevertheless, the field lacks a clear and cohesive conceptual foundation for identifying and measuring erasure. Existing conceptualizations of erasure are often broad -- making it difficult to identify what is needed to establish and measure erasure -- or else specific to particular settings -- facilitating measurement for those settings but potentially challenging to adapt to other settings. To address this gap, we develop and propose a structured definition of erasure that clarifies what components are necessary for establishing whether erasure has occurred, which practitioners need to explicitly articulate and operationalize in order to measure erasure.

</details>


### [90] [When Correct Edges Cannot Be Verified: A Provenance Gap in Incomplete KGQA and a Provenance-Favoring Completion Policy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15833)
*Yongqi Kang,Yu Fu,Yong Zhao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文揭示了不完全知识图谱问答（IKGQA）中一个被忽视的"溯源性鸿沟"：76-96%的正确补全边在文本中无法被验证，因为大多数Freebase风格的事实并不以头-尾实体共现的形式出现在文本中。由此将边补全重新定义为"溯源不确定性下的风险管控"问题，并提出TGComplete方法——一种在推理断点处检索证据、轻量级验证候选边、在无支持时放弃的溯源优先接纳策略。实验表明，相比GoG基线，TGComplete将边的严格忠实度提升3.1-7.4倍且无统计可检测的准确率损失，但代价是较低的召回率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有IKGQA方法普遍采用"验证后再接纳"的策略，将文本支持度作为边质量的代理指标。然而，文本可验证性是否真正反映正确性从未被系统检验。论文质疑这一隐含前提：由于知识图谱本质上不完整，检索文本以验证补全边成为一种直觉但未经检验的做法。如果文本支持并不能可靠地指示正确性，那么整个验证-接纳范式的基础就需要重新审视。

Method: 论文采用测量研究方法，利用随机删除协议中已知的"黄金删除三元组"作为正确性标签，独立测量文本可验证性，量化二者的差距。在此基础上提出TGComplete方法：(1) 在推理断点(h,r,?)处触发针对性文本检索（BM25 + BGE混合检索）；(2) 三因子验证循环——多源一致性、LLM蕴含判断、KG冲突检测；(3) 合并置信度评分 s_final = w_multi·s_multi + w_llm·s_llm，阈值τ=0.5决定接纳或放弃；(4) 固定阈值的回溯机制，绝不降低标准以接纳低质量候选；(5) 训练无关、索引无关，纯推理时运行。

Result: 核心测量发现：(1) 溯源性鸿沟——在穷尽性检索下，76-96%的黄金正确边仍无文本支持，跨删除率（20%/40%）、数据集（CWQ/WebQSP）、关系类型（结构性/常识/长尾）均稳健成立；(2) 因果冗余——95-97%的正确答案不依赖任何无支持的补全边，使边补全成为风险管控而非正确性竞争；(3) TGComplete将边精确率从GoG的3-14%提升至15-21%，严格忠实度提升3.1-7.4倍，且在EM上无统计可检测差异（McNemar p>0.05），代价是召回率降低（24-50%的拒绝边实为黄金正确边）。消融实验证实检索与拒绝两个组件缺一不可。

Conclusion: 文本忠实度衡量的是"溯源性"（能否被验证）而非"正确性"（是否真实），二者之间存在范式级鸿沟，无法通过语料内检索弥合。由此，边补全应被重新定位为"溯源不确定性下的风险管控"决策。TGComplete作为溯源优先的接纳策略，是精确率/溯源-召回权衡上的一个原则性取舍点，适用于需要可审计性的场景，但不适合以边召回本身为目标的场景。未来研究方向包括多前提证据聚合、结构化对齐证据、与多智能体辩论方法的对比等。论文呼吁将文本基础视为溯源信号而非正确性证书。

Abstract: Incomplete Knowledge Graph Question Answering (IKGQA) requires completing missing edges to continue reasoning. A growing line of work verifies completed edges against retrieved text, treating textual support as a proxy for edge quality. We ask a question that, to our knowledge, has not been systematically tested: does textual verifiability actually track correctness? Exploiting the gold deleted triples provided by the standard random-deletion protocol, we measure both. The finding is counterintuitive: among gold-correct completed edges, 76-96% have no supporting passage even under exhaustive retrieval, robustly across deletion rates (20%/40%), datasets (CWQ/WebQSP), and relation types (structural, commonsense, long-tail). Most Freebase-style facts simply do not occur as head-tail co-mentions in text. Textual faithfulness therefore measures provenance, not correctness -- separated by a paradigm-level gap no in-corpus retrieval closes. This reframes edge completion. Since most completed edges -- correct or not -- are causally redundant for the answer (95-97% of correct answers do not depend on any unsupported edge), the central question shifts from "is the edge correct?" to "admit or abstain under provenance uncertainty?" Within this framing we present TGComplete, a provenance-favoring admission policy that retrieves evidence at a reasoning breakpoint, verifies a candidate through a lightweight loop, and abstains when support is absent. Against the generate-to-complete baseline GoG, it attains higher edge precision against gold (15-21% vs 3-14%), with no statistically detectable EM loss and 3.1-7.4 times higher strict faithfulness of admitted edges -- at the cost of lower recall. We position TGComplete not as uniformly better, but as a principled point on a precision/provenance-recall trade-off, appropriate when auditability matters.

</details>


### [91] [SciOrch: Learning to Orchestrate Expert LLMs for Solving Frontier Multimodal Scientific Reasoning Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15872)
*Jingru Guo,Xiangyuan Xue,Lian Zhang,Wanghan Xu,Siki Chen,Philip Torr,Wanli Ouyang,Lei Bai,Zhenfei Yin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: SciOrch是一个通过训练轻量级8B编排模型来协调多个前沿商业LLM进行科学推理的框架。它将复杂问题分解并分发给不同的商业模型API，通过MCTS生成多样化的编排轨迹，并使用GRPO式训练优化编排器，在科学推理任务上以更低成本超越了单一模型和现有多智能体基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿商业LLM在科学推理任务中各有专长，存在显著互补性，但单一模型无法全面覆盖所有问题类型。现有在线强化学习方法因API调用成本高昂而难以直接应用于多模型编排场景，因此需要一种既能利用模型互补性又能控制成本的训练方法。

Method: 1) 训练一个8B轻量级编排器，将问题分解为子问题并通过API分发给选定的商业模型（如GPT、Claude等）；2) 采用基于蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）的方法生成多样化的编排轨迹以避免昂贵的在线rollout；3) 从轨迹中提取每节点的单轮样本；4) 使用GRPO（Group Relative Policy Optimization）风格的强化学习对编排器进行优化训练。

Result: 在涵盖SGI-Reasoning和Scientists' First Exam的240题测试集上，SciOrch达到56.66%的平均准确率，比最强单一商业模型高出3.74%，比最强多智能体基线高出3.33%，且API成本不到典型多智能体方法的一半；在SGI和SFE两个子集上均取得最佳准确率。

Conclusion: SciOrch证明了通过轻量级编排器协调多个前沿商业LLM在科学推理任务中具有显著优势，能够以更低成本实现超越单一最强模型和多智能体系统的性能，验证了模型间互补性的实际利用价值，并为昂贵API环境下的智能体训练提供了一种可行的离线MCTS+GRPO训练范式。

Abstract: Frontier scientific reasoning remains a major challenge for large language models (LLMs), where even the strongest commercial systems fall short of expert-level performance. A closer look at model behavior reveals substantial complementarity that single-model evaluation hides: different frontier models excel on different question types, and no single model captures the full picture. We present SciOrch, a framework that trains a lightweight 8B model to orchestrate frontier LLMs for scientific reasoning. The orchestrator decomposes each question, delegates sub-problems to selected commercial models through API calls, and synthesizes a final answer. Training such an orchestrator is fundamentally harder than conventional agentic RL: each action triggers an API call that is expensive in both dollar cost and latency, making standard online rollouts infeasible. We address this with MCTS-based approach, producing diverse orchestration trajectories, extracting per-node single-turn samples, and optimizing the orchestrator with GRPO-style training. On a 240-question test set spanning SGI-Reasoning and Scientists' First Exam, SciOrch reaches 56.66% average accuracy, outperforming the strongest single commercial model by 3.74% and the strongest multi-agent baseline by 3.33%. It also attains the best accuracy on both SGI and SFE with less than half the API cost of typical multi-agent methods.

</details>


### [92] [Neuron Level Analysis of Large Language Model in Legal Domain Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15884)
*Eri Onami,Youmi Ma,Shuhei Kurita,Naoaki Okazaki*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文对7个开源大语言模型在法律领域推理中的神经元进行细粒度分析，通过神经元归因分数识别并抑制任务关键神经元，发现法律领域存在跨司法管辖区的共享神经元，挑战了"重要神经元集中于中间MLP层"的通用假设。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用开源LLM在法律等应用领域表现不足，且因隐私保护、商业秘密及司法管辖区差异，构建覆盖全面的法律数据集不现实。借鉴机制可解释性研究中已发现的社会偏见神经元、语言神经元、文化神经元等先例，探索能否通过识别法律领域特定神经元，在不进行额外训练的情况下提升模型在法律任务上的表现。核心研究问题包括：任务特定神经元是否真正任务专属？法律领域是否存在跨任务共享神经元？其与其他领域神经元的关系及在网络中的分布如何？

Method: 采用基于梯度×激活的一阶Taylor近似作为神经元归因分数（Integrated Gradients的简化版），在训练集上聚合各神经元分数，选取top 0.5%神经元作为任务关键神经元，在测试集推理时将其激活值置零以验证因果效应，并以同等数量的随机神经元抑制作为对照。进一步移除跨7个任务全部共享的神经元以揭示真正任务特定的神经元。实验覆盖7个开源模型（Qwen3-8B/14B、Gemma-3-12b-it、Gemma-4-E4B-it、GPT-OSS-20B、Olmo-3-1025-7B、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct）和7个数据集：法律领域（中文LexEval、英文LexGLUE的CaseHOLD、英德文LEXam）、数学（GSM8K）、医学（MedQA）、常识推理（PIQA）、翻译（WMT19）。

Result: 1) 抑制被识别的top 0.5%神经元使目标任务准确率骤降至接近零，而抑制同等数量的随机神经元几乎不影响准确率，证明识别出的神经元确实对任务有因果贡献；2) 存在一小部分在全部7个任务中均有影响力的"共享神经元"（如Qwen3-8B有316个、Llama-3.1-8B有2,055个），移除这些共享神经元后，剩余神经元呈现真正的任务特异性，抑制它们仅破坏对应任务；3) 三个法律基准（LexEval、LexGLUE、LEXam）之间存在较高的神经元重叠，抑制某一法律任务的神经集会连带影响其他法律任务，表明存在跨司法管辖区的法律组件神经元；4) 重要神经元的分布因模型而异：Gemma系列符合中间MLP层集中假设，而Llama-3.1和GPT-OSS-20B的重要神经元主要分布在注意力的K和Q组件上，Qwen系列则广泛分布于各层MLP和K/Q中，提示"中间MLP层集中"并非普遍规律，而可能依赖于输入格式与内容。

Conclusion: 研究证实了法律领域特定神经元在LLM中的存在，并通过跨任务共享神经元的剥离揭示了真正任务专属的神经元子集。法律领域三个跨司法管辖区的基准之间的高重叠性，表明存在共享的法律推理组件神经元。同时，重要神经元的网络分布特征因模型和任务而异，挑战了先前在短文本/通用知识任务中得出的"重要神经元集中于中间MLP层"的普适性结论，提示该假设可能受输入长度和复杂度的影响。研究结果为开发选择性针对领域特定神经元的训练方法以提升LLM在专业领域表现提供了新方向。

Abstract: We presented a neuron-level analysis of legal-domain reasoning in LLMs, comparing it with other applied domain tasks across seven open-weight models. Using neuron attribution scores to rank and suppress influential neurons, we confirmed that suppressing the identified neurons collapses accuracy on the target task, whereas suppressing the same number of random neurons does not. We further found a small subset of neurons influential across all seven tasks; once these are removed, suppressing the remaining neurons degrades only the task they were identified from, revealing genuinely task-specific neurons in every model studied. Within the legal domain, the three benchmarks exhibit relatively high neuron overlap and tend to be affected jointly, suggesting of legal components neurons that span jurisdictions. The distribution of identified neurons in our experiments suggests that the hypothesis that influential neurons are concentrated in middle MLP layers may depend on the input format and content, rather than being a universal phenomenon.

</details>


### [93] [BALTO: Balanced Token-Level Policy Optimization for Hallucination Mitigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15893)
*Ning Li,Zixuan Guo,Yan Xu,Wenbo Fei,Yifan Niu,Chang Luo,Yasheng Wang,Weiwen Liu,Yong Yu,Weinan Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出BALTO（Balanced Token-Level Policy Optimization），一种用于缓解大语言模型幻觉的平衡token级策略优化框架。该方法通过将claim级事实性判断投影为token级标签，并引入平衡的token级信用分配机制（幻觉token获得负优势，忠实token获得正补偿优势，中性token获得零优势），将概率质量从幻觉内容重新分配到忠实内容，同时保持响应信息量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于RL的幻觉缓解方法主要使用响应级忠实性奖励，但存在粒度不匹配问题：局部幻觉会导致忠实内容受到虚假惩罚。虽然近期工作引入了细粒度反馈（如claim级验证和token级奖励），但不平衡的信用分配仍会引入长度、冗余或优化噪声偏差。需要一种能够在token级精确分配信用并保持响应信息量的方法。

Method: BALTO框架包含两个阶段：(1) 使用LLM忠实性评估器提取响应中的可检查事实claim，并对照参考文档进行验证，将幻觉claim投影到token级标签（标记hallucinated tokens为-1，faithful tokens为+1，neutral tokens为0）；(2) 引入平衡token级信用分配机制，幻觉token获得-1优势，忠实token获得N⁻/N⁺补偿优势，满足响应内零和性质（∑A_t^bal = 0）。使用GRPO风格的裁剪目标函数优化策略。基于Qwen3-4B和Qwen3-8B在ConFiQA、RAGTruth和FinLLM-Eval三个基准上进行评估。

Result: BALTO在所有六个模型-基准设置上均达到最高忠实性，并在Q-Score上持续优于现有后训练基线方法。相比各设置中最强的后训练基线，BALTO平均提升Q-Score 2.7分（最高4.9分），平均提升忠实性3.1分（最高6.7分）。消融实验验证了正优势分配的必要性。训练动态分析表明BALTO梯度范数比响应级RL方法小一个数量级，且仅需更新约12%的参数即可达到0.98忠实性，而GRPO_B需更新约17%参数达到0.93忠实性。

Conclusion: BALTO为细粒度幻觉缓解提供了一种有效的平衡token级策略优化框架。通过理论分析证明：(1) BALTO将梯度方差从与完整响应长度T成正比压缩至仅与幻觉token数量N⁻成正比，显著提升训练稳定性；(2) BALTO在训练早期（p→0）避免梯度饥饿，在训练后期（p→1）避免发散惩罚，保证全阶段的优化效率。实验验证了平衡细粒度信用分配是构建更忠实和信息丰富LLM的有效方向。该方法的主要局限性在于依赖外部忠实性评估器的准确性，且主要适用于检索增强的忠实性对齐场景。

Abstract: Hallucinations remain a major obstacle to deploying large language models (LLMs) in knowledge-intensive settings, where generated responses must be faithfully grounded in provided evidence. Reinforcement learning (RL) is a promising direction for hallucination mitigation, but response-level faithfulness rewards suffer from a granularity mismatch: localized hallucinations can cause supported content to receive spurious penalties. Although recent work introduces fine-grained feedback such as claim-level verification and token-level rewards, unbalanced credit assignment can still induce length, verbosity, or optimization-noise biases. We propose BALTO, a Balanced Token-level Policy Optimization framework for hallucination mitigation. BALTO extracts checkable factual claims, verifies them against the reference context, and projects claim-level judgments to token-level labels. A balanced token-level credit assignment mechanism is introduced into the framework. This design redistributes probability mass from unsupported content toward faithful content, rather than suppressing the entire response. We systematically analyze the limitations of response-level rewards from a theoretical standpoint, and prove BALTO's advantages in training stability and optimization efficiency for hallucination mitigation. Experiments on ConFiQA, RAGTruth, and FinLLM-Eval show that BALTO achieves the highest faithfulness across all six model--benchmark settings and consistently outperforms existing post-training baselines in Q-Score, demonstrating a stronger faithfulness--informativeness trade-off.

</details>


### [94] [Calibrated Triage, Not Autonomy: Confidence Estimation for Medical Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15910)
*Reza Khanmohammadi,Kundan Thind,Mohammad M. Ghassemi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该论文系统评估了七种置信度估计器在五个开源视觉-语言模型（LVLM）和三个医学视觉问答（VQA）数据集上的表现，提出医学LVLM在临床部署中应作为"校准分诊工具"而非自主诊断系统，核心结论是置信度的测量与聚合方式比模型本身更决定可自动化的工作量上限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型视觉-语言模型在医学图像解读中存在一个关键隐患：模型能流利且自信地回答问题，但实际可能几乎未使用图像，而是依赖语言先验。这种"看起来可信实则不可信"的失败在临床中最危险。现有置信度估计器针对通用域排序目标设计，尚未在医学影像上以临床部署目标（有界选择性预测）进行系统评估。本文旨在回答一个部署问题：在固定误差预算下，模型能安全处理多少医学影像工作，以及哪种置信度信号使之成为可能。

Method: 研究设计：（1）数据：训练探针仅使用通用域GQA数据集，评估时迁移到三个医学VQA数据集（GMAI-MMBench、SLAKE、PATH-VQA），覆盖广泛临床影像、放射学与病理学；（2）模型：五个开源LVLM（4.5B-27B参数）；（3）七种置信度估计器分为三组：推理时自报告方法（P(True)、Self-Probing、Prompt Ensemble）、训练型内部探针（SAPLMA、CCPS、InternalInspector）以及唯一具有视觉基础感知能力的BICR；（4）评估框架：有界选择性预测，自动化一个病例当且仅当其置信度超过阈值，其余转交临床医生；（5）评估指标：AUROC（判别力）、ECE（校准度）、AURC、Yield@τ（安全产量）、ErrTop10%（高置信度区错误率）。

Result: 核心发现：（1）标准指标具有误导性：判别力差异微小，廉价自报告的弱校准可被域外温度缩放廉价修复而不改变可部署产量；（2）高置信度区域区分方法优劣：最弱基线在错误案例中41-45%以高置信度犯错，最佳训练探针仅1-4%；（3）无单一估计器跨域或跨模型稳定最优；（4）能力-可自动化性梯度：放射学可恢复约1/3病例（20%误差预算），病理学几乎无安全自动化；（5）基础模型能力设定上限，校准良好的置信度层决定该上限中实际可安全到达的部分；（6）视觉基础感知探针BICR是唯一在模型忽略图像时降低置信度的方法；（7）池化排行榜会掩盖方法在罕见模态上的失效，形成公平性风险。

Conclusion: 医学LVLM在临床中的当前可用角色是"校准分诊"而非自主诊断：仅自动化校准分数标记为安全的病例，其余转交临床医生。安全委派受两层因素制约：基础模型能力设定天花板（从放射学到病理学骤降），置信度层决定该天花板的可达部分。视觉基础感知的校准探针是临床医生可依赖的信号类型。随着医学LVLM改进，安全产量边界将不均衡上升，最快出现在最接近通用训练数据的领域。部署时必须按模型和临床类别逐一验证置信度层，而非依赖汇总基准。

Abstract: A vision-language model can answer a question about a medical image fluently and confidently while barely using the image, leaning instead on language priors. In medicine this is the failure that matters most, because the answer looks trustworthy and is not, and the only protection is a confidence score reliable enough to tell the system when to abstain. We ask a deployment question rather than an accuracy one: how much imaging work a model can safely handle alone, and which confidence signal makes that possible. We evaluate seven confidence estimators across five open-weight LVLMs and three medical visual-question-answering datasets spanning broad clinical imaging, radiology, and pathology, with every probe trained only on natural images and applied without adaptation. Recast as bounded selective prediction (automate a case only when confidence clears a threshold, defer the rest), the comparison is cautionary. The standard metrics are poor guides: discrimination barely separates the methods, and the weak calibration of a cheap self-report is cheaply removed by off-domain temperature scaling without changing deployable yield. What distinguishes a usable estimator is the high-confidence region a clinician acts on: the weakest baselines are confidently wrong on 41 to 45 percent of their errors against 1 to 4 percent for the best probe, and no estimator is reliably best across domains or models. Safe handoff is governed at two levels: base-model competence sets a ceiling, so a well-calibrated score recovers roughly a third of radiology cases at a 20 percent error tolerance but almost none of pathology; the confidence layer then decides how much of that ceiling is reachable. The usable role today is calibrated triage, not autonomy: automate the cases a calibrated score marks safe, route the rest to a clinician. We release all outputs, correctness judgments, and confidence scores, with code.

</details>


### [95] [Interactor: Agentic RL oriented Iterative Creation for Ad Description Generation in Sponsored Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15911)
*Penghui Wei,Jiayu Wu,Chao Ye,Zhi Guo,Shuanglong Li,Lin Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 Interactor 框架,采用智能体强化学习(agentic RL)与多轮迭代生成机制,为搜索广告中的长文本广告描述生成任务提供解决方案。该框架通过 LLM 策略与定制化生成式奖励模型(GenRM)环境进行多轮交互,基于细粒度推理反馈持续优化生成质量,自 2026 年 5 月起在百度搜索广告系统正式上线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有广告文案生成研究主要集中在广告标题(短文本,以 CTR 为优化目标),而对具有更长文本跨度、能够融合世界知识与落地页卖点的广告描述生成关注不足。广告描述需要满足知识容量(knowledge capacity)和落地页一致性(landing page consistency)等多维质量约束,但基于标量奖励的单轮 RL/RLHF 方法难以提供细粒度指导信息,导致策略探索效率低、生成结果存在细微不准确性问题。

Method: Interactor 框架的核心设计包括: (1) 将 LLM 生成模型视为智能体策略,与定制化环境进行多轮交互; (2) 环境由两类生成式奖励模型(GenRM)和搜索引擎组成,GenRM 基于业务需求预定义的评分细则(rubric)对知识容量和落地页一致性两个维度进行评估,同时返回二元信号和细粒度推理反馈; (3) LLM 策略可在多轮中执行检索世界知识、生成广告描述、请求奖励评估等动作,并根据反馈迭代修正不忠实内容、补充缺失知识; (4) 采用 GSPO(Group Sequence Policy Optimization)critic-free 算法进行优化,奖励由知识容量奖励、落地页一致性奖励和 CTR 预测奖励加权组成,优势函数基于组内最后轮奖励的全局归一化估计; (5) CTR 估计模型基于用户点击日志增量训练以捕捉用户偏好动态变化。

Result: 在百度搜索广告系统的工业级数据集(100 万训练样本)上,Interactor 在所有五个评估维度上均显著优于 Ctop、Diver 和单轮 RL 等基线方法:基本质量 0.986、信息量 0.715、忠实度 0.872、吸引力 12.4%、多样性 0.732,尤其在忠实度上提升显著。消融实验验证了多轮迭代、推理反馈和更大规模 GenRM 对性能的贡献。在线 A/B 测试(覆盖 14 万+广告主、6000 万+曝光)实现广告收入 +0.74%、人工评估优质率 +7pp,自 2026 年 5 月起在百度搜索广告系统全量上线。

Conclusion: Interactor 验证了将广告生成从 CTR 驱动的短标题转向融合世界知识的长描述生成的必要性,证明了多轮迭代式 agentic RL 框架在开放式长文本广告描述生成任务中的有效性。其基于定制化 GenRM 提供细粒度推理反馈的机制,可同时提升多个质量维度,并已在工业级搜索广告系统中实现业务价值。论文也指出未来可探索人机协同优化范式,进一步挖掘人工撰写广告语料的价值。

Abstract: This paper focuses on automatically generating informative ad descriptions in sponsored search. Unlike ad titles which are usually optimized to attract user click feedbacks, ad descriptions have a longer text span and possess the potential of incorporating world knowledge to address user search intents while presenting the fine-grained selling points of the ads. We propose Interactor, a multi-turn iterative creation framework optimized with agentic RL for ad description generation. The generation model acts as a policy that interacts with a customized environment consisting of multiple generative reward models. Given initial generations by the policy, the customized GenRMs evaluate multi-dimensional qualities including knowledge capacity and landing page consistency, providing both binary signals and reasoning feedbacks. The policy then iteratively refines the descriptions based on such feedbacks to ensure continuous improvement. Experiments on industrial datasets show that the Interactor framework significantly outperforms state-of-the-art approaches in generating knowledge-rich and faithful ad descriptions. Since May 2026, it has been deployed online in a leading search ads system, contributing to both ad revenue and user experience.

</details>


### [96] [Contaminated Collaboration: Measuring Gender Bias Transfer in LLM-Assisted Student Writing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15914)
*Ariyan Hossain,Kazi Kamruzzaman Rabbi,Farig Sadeque,S M Taiabul Haque*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该研究通过控制实验发现，性别偏见的大型语言模型（LLM）写作助手会将偏见传递给使用它撰写职业规划文的学生，导致女性目标人物的能动性（agentic）语言被显著抑制，且性别刻板的职业推荐率显著上升，而精心配置的中性LLM则可避免甚至降低这种偏见传递。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管LLM输出中的性别偏见已被广泛研究，但这种偏见是否会通过AI辅助写作传递给人类作者（尤其是学生）的文本，仍缺乏系统性实证。本研究旨在填补这一空白，验证可验证的性别偏见LLM是否会在协作写作场景中将其偏见转移到学生撰写的文本中。

Method: 采用三条件被试间设计（N=123本科生）：（1）无AI辅助的对照组；（2）中性提示词LLM辅助；（3）性别偏见提示词LLM辅助（使用llama-3.3-70b-instruct模型）。参与者根据仅在姓名和性别代词上有差异的传记撰写职业规划文。主要测量指标包括基于BERT的能动性分类器所得的能动性差距（agency gap）和基于美国劳工统计局（BLS）数据的刻板一致性率（SCR），并辅以被试前后问卷调查。

Result: 偏见LLM条件下的学生作文表现出显著更大的能动性差距（Δ=+0.242, d=1.510, p<.001）和更高的性别刻板职业推荐率（SCR=0.714，约为中性条件下的4倍，p=.004）。偏见传递呈不对称性：能动性的变化主要由女性目标人物的能动性被压制驱动（下降51%），而男性目标人物的能动性基本不受影响。中性LLM条件下的SCR甚至低于对照组，表明精心设计的中性提示词可减少而非加剧偏见。参与者并未意识到自己受到偏见影响。

Conclusion: 可验证的性别偏见LLM写作助手会将其偏见传递给学生作者，尤其通过压制女性人物的能动性和强化性别刻板的职业建议。然而，谨慎设计的中性助手不仅能避免偏见传递，还可能减轻基线刻板印象。该不对称性表明，去偏工作应针对女性侧而非仅仅关注男性过度表征，并强调教育AI工具中公平感知设计的必要性。

Abstract: Gender bias in LLMs has been studied extensively in model outputs, with biased prompts shown to amplify stereotyped generations. Whether such bias propagates into text produced by humans who use these systems, however, remains underexplored. We investigate whether gender bias in an LLM writing assistant transfers into career plan essays written by students. We first verify that a gender-biased prompt induces gender-differentiated language in LLM-generated essays, while a neutral prompt does not. We then recruited participants (N = 123) in a controlled environment to write career plan essays for paired biographical profiles differing only in gender under three conditions: no AI assistance, neutral LLM assistance, or gender-biased LLM assistance. Students in the biased condition produced essays with a significantly larger agentic gap and more gender-stereotypic occupation suggestions than those in the control and neutral conditions. Our results also reveal that this bias transfer is asymmetric: agency is suppressed in female-target essays while male-target writing remains largely unaffected. Our findings highlight the risk of bias propagation in AI-assisted writing, calling for fairness-aware design in educational AI tools.

</details>


### [97] [Beyond NL2Code: A Structured Survey of Multimodal Code Intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15932)
*Xuanle Zhao,Qiushi Sun,Jingyu Xiao,Xuexin Liu,Haoyue Yang,Qiaosheng Chen,Xianzhen Luo,Jing Huang,Yufeng Zhong,Lei Chen,Shuai Fu,Zhenlin Wei,Jinhe Bi,Lei Jiang,Haibo Qiu,Siqi Yang,Peng Shi,Jian Hu,Zhixiong Zeng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 这是一篇关于"多模态代码智能"(Multimodal Code Intelligence)的系统性综述论文。该领域关注在视觉输入/输出(截图、图表、文档、SVG、CAD、视频等)下生成、编辑、执行或推理代码的系统,超越了传统纯文本到代码(NL2Code)的范式。论文提出以代码在任务中所扮演的角色(可渲染工件、可编辑符号结构、科学表示、推理中间轨迹、可执行策略)作为分类依据,将现有工作组织为四大领域:图形用户界面(GUI)、科学可视化、结构化图形、前沿任务与框架,并提出以"验证为中心"的四个未来研究方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统NL2Code(自然语言到代码)研究主要依赖文本描述来生成可执行程序,但许多真实编程任务的设计意图本质上是视觉性的(前端布局、数据可视化图表、文档结构、CAD几何关系等)。仅凭文本难以高效、完整地表达空间层次、几何结构、视觉编码等关键约束,导致生成结果与人类意图之间存在错位。论文旨在系统梳理"多模态代码智能"这一新兴领域,填补现有文献中缺乏结构化整合的空白,帮助研究者理解不同任务如何处理"正确性证据",并指出验证机制方面的发展方向。

Method: 1. **任务形式化**:将多模态代码智能任务形式化为"多模态代码合成"(直接生成C_gen=MLLM(I,T_desc)、指令驱动编辑C_edited=MLLM(I,T_edit,V,S)、基于参考的精化C_refined=MLLM(I,T_refine,C_draft))和"以代码为中心的推理与行动"(程序化工具使用、可执行策略)两大范式。2. **四领域分类法**:(1) GUI:网页应用(Design2Code、WebSight、IWR-Bench等)与移动应用(APPUI、CANVAS等);(2) 科学可视化:统计图表(Chart-to-Code与NL-to-Chart双向)、结构化文档(OmniDocBench、PubTabNet等)、学术演示文稿、科val证明交互演示;(3) 结构化图形:SVG(VGBench、StarVector、RLRF等)、图表(UML-LLaVA、Flow2Code等)、CAD(Text2CAD、ExeCAD、CAD-Coder等);(4) 前沿任务:程序化视觉操作、视频代码生成、具身控制、视觉接地编程、统一多模态代码生成。3. **验证为中心的方法论**:采用分阶段综述协议,从arXiv及主要AI/软件工程会议收集候选论文,经筛选、分类与一致性检查,辅以GitHub资源库持续更新。4. **贡献**:建立正式问题形式化、连接成熟工件生成与新兴智能体设置、对比不同任务的正确性证据处理方式。

Result: 1. **GUI域发现**:网页端有相对完整的"代码-渲染-交互"闭环(浏览器、WebDriver),但静态视觉相似度与动态交互正确性之间存在显著差距(例:IWR-Bench中视觉保真度64.25%但交互功能仅24.39%);移动端因缺乏统一的原生执行环境,主要依赖代理信号(artifacts、design-tool状态、批评模型、学习评分)。2. **科学可视化域发现**:图表生成中NL-to-Chart(欠指定合成)与Chart-to-Code(约束重建)任务不对称;结构化文档需同时恢复布局、阅读顺序、表格网格、公式语法等多重语法;演示文稿与科学演示需保留论证流程与领域语义。3. **结构化图形域发现**:SVG生成需平衡离散命令与连续坐标;图表生成是"逻辑编译"问题而非"绘画"问题(箭头方向、分支条件、关系类型易被外观相似度掩盖);CAD需恢复参数化构造逻辑(尺寸、布尔运算、约束、特征依赖)。4. **前沿任务域发现**:程序化视觉操作(如"Thinking with Image")的关键瓶颈是过程忠实性(工具执行是否真正改变了答案相关的视觉证据);视频代码生成面临时间一致性问题(代码表示离散时间 vs. 帧间连续动态);具身控制存在物理接地问题;视觉接地编程需保留视觉证据中的程序相关约束(空间关系、UI状态、视觉失败)。5. **统一模型挑战**:存在"泛化悖论"——更多领域覆盖≠学习到跨任务可迁移的视觉-代码抽象。

Conclusion: 论文提出以**验证为中心**的四大未来方向:(1)**多信号验证**:组合视觉相似度、执行成功、文本正确性、数据/语义保真度、结构有效性、可编辑性、交互正确性等互补信号,采用"代理判断器分类法"区分训练奖励与留出可靠性检查;(2)**多状态验证**:将GUI、视频、具身等有状态任务评估为执行轨迹(初始状态→生成代码→中间观察→预期转移→验证器输出→恢复),而非孤立渲染;(3)**跨任务迁移测试**:通过保留技能、原语和组合的拆分,比较基础混合、源域增强混合与匹配大小控制混合,报告正/负迁移,使统一多模态代码生成成为可证伪的共享机制声明;(4)**可验证智能体轨迹**:构建"证据日志"(观察、引用的视觉区域/工具输出、修改的代码/动作、预期改进的验证器、回放结果、回退决策),支持回放、视觉消融、反事实输入、权限控制、模拟器守卫与人工审查。中心论断:多模态代码智能应基于代码在渲染、执行、交互、回放后**暴露的证据**来评估,而不是仅基于视觉合理性。论文强调这是从"单输出模仿"迈向"证据接地的可执行系统"的范式转变。

Abstract: While LLMs have substantially advanced text-to-code synthesis, many real programming tasks specify intent through visual artifacts such as screenshots, charts, documents, vector drawings, videos, and interactive states. These tasks require models to connect visual perception to executable programs, because correctness depends not only on syntax but also on layout, geometry, data semantics, editability, interaction behavior, and domain-specific constraints that apply after execution. This survey examines Multimodal Code Intelligence, covering systems that generate, edit, refine, execute, or reason with code under visually grounded inputs and outputs. We first formulate the field by the role that code plays in each task, distinguishing code as a rendered artifact, an editable symbolic structure, a scientific representation, an intermediate reasoning trace, or an executable policy or tool interface. We then organize benchmarks and methods into four domains: Graphical User Interface, Scientific Visualization, Structured Graphics, and Frontier Tasks and Frameworks. This taxonomy connects mature artifact-generation problems to emerging agentic and unified settings and allows us to compare how different tasks treat evidence of correctness. Looking ahead, we argue that future research may benefit from four verification-centered directions. Multi-signal validation can combine complementary evidence of correctness, multi-state verification can test behavior across execution trajectories, cross-task transfer testing can probe reusable visual-code skills, and verifiable agent traces can reveal whether agent actions are grounded in visual evidence. Together, these directions may move multimodal code generation from single-output imitation toward evidence-grounded executable systems.

</details>


### [98] [FinBalance: A Multi-Document Accounting Reconciliation Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15949)
*Sasank Tumpati,Devansh Agarwal,Ayush Kedia,Arjun Neekhra,Murari Mandal,Krishna Garg,Yash Sinha,Suman Gupta,Dhruv Kumar*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出 FinBalance——一个多文档会计对账基准测试，要求模型从原始凭证包出发，生成带引用的日记账分录、汇总资产负债表并检测文档间矛盾。在 710 条记录的评估集上，六款主流 LLM 的 BS_exact（自报资产负债表精确率）最高仅 46%；四个模型在 BS_exact 与 BS_recon（由分录回放得到的资产负债表）之间存在 26–41 个百分点的"聚合鸿沟"，表明模型能写出数值合理的分录，却难以将其与支撑文档绑定并正确汇总。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有金融 NLP 基准（如 FinQA、FinanceBench、FinAuditing 等）多评估对已编制报表的理解能力，而真实会计工作从源文件开始：需将发票、银行回单、合同等原始凭证对账为引用型日记账分录，再聚合为满足会计恒等式的资产负债表，并识别文档间矛盾。该基准填补"从原始凭证到报表构建"这一上游任务的评估空白，并提供一个可扩展的诊断测试平台。

Method: 1）由人类编写行业场景、文档模式、会计政策、税务/外汇规则、支撑文档依赖、干扰项及矛盾模板；2）确定性生成器据此组合文档包（含 OCR 文本）、试算平衡表，并通过双引擎分类账计算期望分录、资产负债表与 23 类矛盾码标签；3）覆盖 8 个行业、3 种周期类型、5 个难度等级（L1–L5），含 7 类概念标志（ASC 606 收入确认、租赁、递延税、资产处置、外币重估、多辖区销售税、免税等）；4）主评估集 710 条（480 标准 + 230 强制矛盾记录）；5）评估 6 款 LLM（Gemini 3 Flash、GPT-5、Claude Haiku 4.5、Grok-4.3、DeepSeek Chat、Qwen 3 235B），设计两大指标 BS_exact 与 BS_recon，并开展提示词、可见性、上下文压力、工具/修复四类消融实验；6）由投行从业财务专家与注册会计师进行人工验证。

Result: 1）六款模型在 480 条标准记录上 BS_exact 最高 46.5%（GPT-5），整体远低于 BS_recon；2）四个模型存在 26–41 pp 的聚合鸿沟（如 DeepSeek Chat：BS_exact 6.7% vs BS_recon 47.3%；Qwen 3 235B：1.3% vs 30.2%）；3）文档链接是主要失败模式：52% 账户与金额正确的分录引用了错误的文档，强制引用提示仅减少 1.4 pp，证据仅可见性可降低 26.4 pp，属检索消歧问题；4）分类账反馈诊断使 BS_exact 提升 30–33 pp，但使矛盾码检测率下降 13–52 pp（弱检测器尤为严重）；5）最佳三选一在子集上将 BS_exact 从 0% 提升至 28.9%，单轮分类账反馈可达 84.4%；6）难度影响主导：L1 时 BS_exact 88%，L5 时 0%；7）专家评审 75 条记录与注册会计师全覆盖 143 条记录的审查获得 96–100% 的可接受一致性。

Conclusion: FinBalance 将"文档驱动的会计对账"确立为一项具体、可计算的评测任务，揭示了当前 LLM 在三大核心能力上的不足：证据选择、带引用的双引擎记账以及正确的报表聚合。聚合鸿沟与文档链接失败模式具有跨模型一致性；分类账反馈是修复自报报表的有效诊断手段，但会削弱矛盾识别能力。基准开源了生成器（Apache-2.0）与数据（CC BY 4.0），支持以种子生成新分层样本或扩展场景库，以缓解静态测试集污染风险。局限在于：合成文档保真度低于真实 OCR 与企业格式；会计政策覆盖有限（不涵盖完整 GAAP/IFRS 或行业特定规则）；未深入机制层面解释失败原因。

Abstract: Existing financial-NLP benchmarks mostly evaluate prepared artifacts such as filings, tables, or extracted values. Real accounting begins earlier: source documents must be reconciled into cited journal entries, aggregated into a balance sheet, and checked for contradictions.
