Motivation: 深度线性网络(DLN)是深度学习中过参数化几何结构的基本模型,具有精确的几何与热力学描述。Menon和Yu(2024)已建立实数DLN的熵公式,但对复数和四元数DLN缺乏统一处理。本文的动机在于:①将熵公式统一推广至三种除法代数(ℝ,ℂ,ℍ);②揭示参数β=dim_ℝ 𝔽在公式中扮演类似于随机矩阵理论中Dyson指标的角色;③为深度学习的几何-热力学描述提供更一般的数学基础。

Method: 方法分四步:1)定义DLN的乘法映射ϕ: M_d(𝔽)^N → M_d(𝔽),对给定端到端矩阵X∈GL_d(𝔽),引入其平衡分解的轨道𝒪_X^β(满足W_{p+1}*W_{p+1}=W_p W_p*);2)在X有不同奇异值时,证明𝒪_X^β与K_β^{N-1}(K_β为O_d, U_d或Sp_d)微分同胚,给出显式参数化𝔶_X;3)构造𝔨_β的实标准正交基(包含T_{sl}^ε和D_s^η两类基元),计算切空间上的诱导黎曼度量;4)将Gram矩阵G_{Σ,β}化为分块对角形式,通过计算三对角块L_{N-1}和H_{sl}的行列式(利用递推关系和几何级数求和)得到轨道体积,从而得出熵公式。同时建立det_ℝ(𝒜_{N,X}^{-1})的行列式恒等式。

Result: 主要结果(定理1.1):对于X∈GL_d(𝔽)具有不同奇异值σ_1>⋯>σ_d>0,Boltzmann熵S^β(X)=(N-1)log c_β + (β/2)log[van(Σ²)/van(Σ^{2/N})] + (β-1)[(d/2)log N + log(det Σ/det(Σ^{1/N}))]。在𝔽=ℂ时,体积与det_ℝ(𝒜_{N,X}^{-1})^{1/4}的乘积简化为c_2^{N-1}。无穷深度极限给出重整化熵S_∞^β(X)=(β-1)∑log σ_s + (β/2)∑log[(σ_s²-σ_l²)/(log σ_s² - log σ_l²)]。一个关键观察是熵公式不含Dyson型对数排斥效应,与经典β-系综行为不同。

Conclusion: 本文成功地将实数DLN的熵公式推广为涵盖三种除法代数(ℝ、ℂ、ℍ)的统一表达式,揭示了参数β=dim_ℝ 𝔽在深度学习几何中与随机矩阵理论Dyson指标类似的角色。证明技术核心是:通过显式构造李代数标准正交基,将Gram矩阵化为三对角分块对角结构,从而精确计算轨道体积。结果不仅恢复了Menon-Yu的原始公式(β=1情形),还建立了det_ℝ(𝒜_{N,X}^{-1})的行列式恒等式,并获得了无穷深度极限下的重整化熵表达式,为研究深度线性网络的热力学性质提供了完整的解析框架。

Abstract: We extend the entropy formula of Menon and Yu for the real Deep Linear Network (DLN) to its complex and quaternionic analogues, obtaining a unified formula for DLNs over $\mathbb{R}$, $\mathbb{C}$, and $\mathbb{H}$.

</details>


### [409] [Multi-Modal Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Network with Mixture of Experts for Soil Organic Carbon Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16580)
*Daniele Mos,Felipe Drummond,Anton Bossenbroek,Soufiane el Khinifri*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 SpTGNN,一种用于土壤有机碳(SOC)预测的多模态时空图神经网络。该模型通过异构图(包含空间邻近、NDVI 光谱相似度和高程三种边关系)、关系图注意力网络(RGAT)、微调的 TerraMind 基础模型以及稀疏混合专家(MoE)模块融合多源数据,并结合 5 模型深度集成与异方差回归实现可分解的不确定性量化,首次将基础模型特征提取、异构图注意力与分解式不确定性量化三者统一于 SOC 估计框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 SOC 预测方法存在两大局限:其一,使用手工设计的协变量配合经典机器学习或单模态深度模型,无法充分捕捉丰富的光谱与时序信息;其二,基于网格的架构(如 CNN)无法处理土壤采样点的不规则空间结构,忽略了邻近样本间的空间自相关性。论文旨在同时解决这两个问题,提升 SOC 预测精度与不确定性可靠性。

Method: 1. **多模态节点编码**:Sentinel-2、Sentinel-1、DEM 三种模态的 224×224 影像块经 TerraMind v1-large ViT 微调后冻结作为特征提取器,得到 ViT 嵌入;经纬度采用多尺度正弦编码,采样年份采用傅里叶特征编码,辅以 63 维表格协变量(气候、地形、土壤质地、土地利用等)。2. **稀疏 MoE 融合**:8 专家交叉门控 MoE 层配合 top-k 路由将影像、环境、位置、时间四路特征融合,辅以负载均衡与熵正则项防止专家坍缩。3. **异构图构建**:包含三种边类型——空间 k-NN(地理邻近)、NDVI k-NN(植被相似度)、空间边按高程梯度重加权。4. **关系图注意力(RGAT)**:四层 RGAT 配合基分解(basis decomposition)、残差连接与层归一化,缓解过平滑。5. **多任务学习目标**:Huber 损失 + Moran's I 空间自相关辅助损失 + MoE 正则项。6. **分解式不确定性**:异方差高斯 NLL 配合 β-NLL 估计偶然不确定性,5 模型深度集成估计认知不确定性,后验温度标定实现校准。

Result: 在三大区域数据集(全球 ~49k、非洲 ~26k、欧洲 ~14k 样本)上评估:非洲测试集上 5 模型深度集成 SpTGNN 达到 **R²=0.762,RMSE=3.51±0.48 g/kg,MAPE=22.9%**,较 XGBoost 表格基线(RMSE 3.84,MAPE 25.2%)有显著提升;最佳单模型检查点验证集 R²=0.864、MAPE=13.7%。校准后 ECE 分别为 0.031(混合)与 0.026(β-NLL)。消融实验证实:异构图(去除 NDVI/高程边 R² 下降 ~0.39)、MoE 融合(替换为拼接 MLP 后 R² 下降 ~0.29)与微调 ViT(去除后 R² 下降 ~0.25)均贡献显著。欧洲 R²=0.445、全球 R²=0.597,反映区域分布差异对性能的影响。诊断检验显示高斯似然假设被拒绝(Shapiro-Wilk 检验显著),残差存在异方差性。

Conclusion: SpTGNN 是首个将基础模型特征提取、异构图关系注意力与分解式不确定性量化三者统一的 SOC 估计框架,在非洲区域取得优于梯度提升基线的预测精度,架构具备跨区域可迁移性。然而性能随训练数据分布变化而波动,提示源区域特定变体是未来值得探索的方向;现有局限包括:高斯似然假设违反、未建模样本间误差相关性、缺乏显式 OOD 检测、ViT 主干冻结、转导式评估协议使指标偏乐观。模型与配置将通过公开模型卡发布以促进可复现性。

Abstract: Top-soil organic carbon (SOC) prediction is fundamental to agricultural sustainability, land use policy and fertilization planning. Existing approaches face two limitations: they pair hand-crafted covariates with classical ML or single-modal deep models that miss rich spectral and temporal information, and grid-based architectures ignore the irregular spatial structure of field measurements. We introduce SpTGNN, a multi-modal spatio-temporal graph neural network addressing both. SpTGNN represents soil measurements as nodes in a heterogeneous graph with three edge types (spatial proximity, spectral similarity, elevation), and applies relational graph attention to learn separate patterns per relation. A fine-tuned TerraMind encoder extracts node features from Sentinel-2, Sentinel-1 and DEM signals, combined with per-sample environmental covariates and learned positional and temporal embeddings. A sparse Mixture-of-Experts module fuses the four streams via top-$k$ routing. Uncertainty is captured by pairing heteroscedastic regression (aleatoric) with deep ensembles (epistemic), and a Moran's $I$ penalty regularizes spatial autocorrelation. We evaluate on a global SOC corpus split into three regional instances ($\sim$49k samples globally, Africa $\sim$26k, Europe $\sim$14k). Our 5-member deep ensemble reports $R^2=0.762$, RMSE $=3.51\pm0.48$ g/kg and MAPE $=22.9\%$ on the Africa test split, improving over a tabular XGBoost baseline; the best single checkpoint reaches validation $R^2=0.864$. Ablations confirm the heterogeneous graph, MoE fusion and fine-tuned backbone each contribute substantively, and the ensemble UQ stack achieves post-calibration ECE of $0.031$ (hybrid) and $0.026$ ($\beta$-NLL). To our knowledge, this is the first framework to unify foundation-model feature extraction, heterogeneous graph attention and decomposed uncertainty quantification for SOC estimation.

</details>


### [410] [PhysGuard: Fisher-Guided Gradient Projection for Sim-to-Real Neural PDE Surrogates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16602)
*Changjian Zhou,Junfeng Fang,Negin Yousefpour,Peng Wu,Bin Yan,Guillermo A Narsilio*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 PhysGuard 框架，通过在仿真数据上计算的经验 Fisher 信息矩阵（FIM）识别物理关键参数方向，并在微调时将梯度投影到其正交补空间，从而在 sim-to-real 迁移中保护预训练神经算子学习到的低频物理结构。实验在 RealPDEBench 基准的 4 种神经算子架构和 3 类物理场景上验证，PhysGuard 在 48 个指标-架构-场景组合中 38 个排名第一，在严重域偏移下低频误差最高降低 32%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经算子（Neural Operators）作为 PDE 替代模型，在仿真数据上训练后应用于真实实验测量时常因 sim-to-real 差距而性能下降。直接在有限真实数据上微调虽能缩小差距，但会破坏预训练阶段学习到的低频物理结构（如涡街、主流场等大尺度相干模式）。现有的知识保留方法（EWC、LoRA、GPM 等）多针对视觉/语言任务设计，其保护的语义或视觉特征与神经算子需要保护的核心物理结构本质不同，因此这些方法在神经算子上的适用性尚不清楚，亟需一种针对神经算子特点的物理保留微调方法。

Method: PhysGuard 采用两阶段流程：1）**物理子空间识别**（离线一次性计算）：在仿真数据上对每层独立计算经验 FIM，利用 Gram 矩阵技巧（K=GG⊤∈ℝᴺˣᴺ，N≪d）高效求解特征向量，累积 Fisher 信息占比达阈值 τ=0.9 的前 k 个特征向量构成物理关键子空间基 U（∈ℝᵈˣᵏ）；2）**约束微调**（在线迭代）：每个微调步对每层梯度 g 做正交投影 g_proj = g − α·UU⊤g（α=1.0 完整投影），阻止沿物理关键方向的更新。FNO 复数权重通过实部-虚部拼接在 ℝ²ᵈ 空间中处理。自适应阈值确定保护子空间规模（实验中介位 k/N=4%）。

Result: **关键实证发现**：谱探针实验显示 FIM 顶部特征向量对应的输出扰动几乎完全集中于低频带（f_low≥0.995），而随机方向则能量均匀分布，证实被保护方向确实编码低频物理。**迁移性能**：在 4 种架构（FNO 50.4M、CNO 8.0M、DeepONet 3.5M、Transolver 4.3M）×3 场景×4 指标的 48 个组合中，PhysGuard 排名第一 38 个。严重域偏移下（如 Cylinder Flow，预训练 R² 仅 0.34–0.72）优势最显著：FNO/CNO/DeepONet 的低频误差相对标准 DFT 降低 22%–32%，DeepONet R² 提升超 50%（DFT 不足 20%），Transolver 上其他方法甚至退化。**局限**：在 DPOT-S 上失效，因其 FIM 谱近似均匀，"保护子空间"吞噬了大部分有效更新方向。

Conclusion: PhysGuard 提供了一种架构无关、超参数精简的 sim-to-real 神经算子微调方法，通过 Fisher 引导的梯度投影保护低频物理结构而无需额外正则项。在多架构多物理场景上验证一致有效，尤其在域偏移严重时优势突出。未来工作方向包括：扩展到基础模型规模的算子、放宽固定子空间秩假设、推广到更广泛的 PDE 类型和传感模态。当前局限于流体力学场景与 FIM 谱需具备低秩结构的前提。

Abstract: Neural operator models trained on simulation data often lose accuracy when applied to experimental measurements due to the sim-to-real gap. Standard fine-tuning with limited real data can reduce this gap, but it may also damage the core physics-relevant representations learned during pretraining. Although knowledge-preserving adaptation has been widely investigated in vision or language tasks, it remains unclear whether these methods are suitable for neural operators whose architectures and protected knowledge are fundamentally different. Neural operators need to preserve core-scale physical structures rather than semantic or visual features. We propose PhysGuard, a physics-preserving framework for accurate sim-to-real adaptation of neural operators. Specifically, PhysGuard uses the empirical Fisher Information Matrix computed on simulation data to identify physics-critical parameter directions, then restricts fine-tuning updates to directions that do not interfere with them. A layer-wise Gram-matrix formulation makes this efficient for models with millions of parameters, while an adaptive threshold automatically determines the protected subspace size. A spectral probe experiment shows that the dominant Fisher directions are strongly associated with low-frequency output structures. Experiments on benchmark across four neural operator architectures and different physical systems show that PhysGuard performs strongly on most evaluation metrics compared to baselines. The benefits are most evident under severe domain shift, where it reduces low-frequency error by up to 32\% compared to standard fine-tuning while maintaining adaptability. Our code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [411] [TCHG: Tri-Trust Conditioned Heterogeneous Graph Learning for Reliable Dynamic Trust Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16611)
*Bohao Liao,Boyu Deng,Qipeng Song,Jieling Wang,Jingchao Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出TCHG框架，将信任证据分解为实体可靠性、交互行为可靠性和上下文信任三条通道，并赋予它们在图传播中不同的功能控制角色（消息准入、传播强度调节、上下文条件算子选择），通过组件解耦的时序记忆和不确定性感知校准实现可靠的动态信任预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于GNN的信任预测方法将异构信任证据视为无差别输入，混合到节点特征、注意力权重或路径嵌入中统一处理，无法区分不同证据在信任建模中的不同功能角色。此外，不同证据通道具有不同的时间稳定性（长期实体可靠性缓慢累积，上下文信任快速变化），统一记忆机制会互相覆盖；并且信任预测输出常用于风险敏感决策，仅靠排序指标无法反映预测概率的可靠性。

Method: TCHG框架包含四个步骤：(1)三元信任证据构建——从历史信任链接、用户-物品交互、时间统计和局部图结构中构建实体可靠性、行为可靠性和上下文信任三个独立通道；(2)三元信任条件异构传播——实体可靠性通过sigmoid门控函数控制消息准入，行为可靠性调节传播强度系数，上下文信任通过softmax软选择关系传播算子(K=4个候选算子的加权混合)；(3)组件解耦的时序信任记忆——三个通道维护独立记忆状态，使用非均匀衰减率(λ_E=0.015, λ_B=0.045, λ_C=0.090)和掩码更新，记忆增强当前证据表示；(4)不确定性感知预测与校准——同时输出信任概率和样本级不确定性，通过后验仿射logit校准对齐预测置信度与实际错误风险，训练目标联合BCE、Brier损失、不确定性正则化、误差-不确定性对齐和算子多样性正则化。

Result: 在Epinions数据集80%-10%-10%划分下，TCHG在观察用户场景达到MRR 0.8811（CAT为0.6758），在未观察用户场景达到MRR 0.7018（CAT为0.4282）；在Ciao和CiaoDVD全用户随机划分下，MRR分别为0.6499和0.9325，较CAT提升约48.8%和8.3%。消融实验验证了三元条件传播、组件解耦记忆和不确定性校准各自的必要性：去除任何一种控制机制（实体准入门、行为调节、上下文算子选择）均导致MRR下降；w/o Component-wise Memory导致最大MRR退化(0.5239)；校准后ECE降至0.0158。选择性预测表明，拒绝50%最高不确定性的边后，观察用户MRR从0.7171提升至0.9701。训练效率方面，TCHG单epoch训练时间14.73s（CAT为57.69s），GPU显存649MB（CAT为2699MB）。

Conclusion: TCHG通过将异构信任证据从"表示增强"转变为"传播控制"，为不同证据类型分配明确的功能角色，结合异步演化的时序记忆和可靠性输出建模，在排序性能和概率可靠性两个维度均优于代表性基线。该框架的有效性增益主要来自证据控制传播机制而非简单特征堆叠，且对冷启动和稀疏历史场景具有鲁棒性。局限性在于证据构建主要依赖信任链接、评分和时间统计，未融合评论文本、用户画像和物品语义等多模态信号；未来工作将扩展更丰富的平台证据并加强自适应和合谋攻击下的评估。

Abstract: Trust prediction infers latent user-user trust relations and provides important support for social recommendation, fake-review and manipulation detection, and risk identification. Graph neural networks have become a prominent approach to trust prediction because of their ability to learn network structures and complex trust dependencies. However, existing methods often rely on a unified representation of trust signals and do not disentangle heterogeneous trust evidence into separate evidence channels, failing to exploit the distinct roles that different evidence channels should play during trust modeling. To address this gap, this paper argues that trust evidence should not be treated as an undifferentiated input, but should be decomposed and used as functional control factors over graph propagation. We propose TCHG, a tri-trust conditioned heterogeneous graph learning framework that decomposes trust evidence into three channels and assigns them distinct functional roles in propagation: entity reliability governs message admission, interaction-behavior reliability modulates propagation strength, and contextual trust adjusts the propagation mode through context-conditioned operator selection. Since the three evidence channels evolve at different temporal scales, TCHG maintains independent temporal states with non-uniform decay rates to prevent rapidly changing contextual signals from overwriting slowly accumulated entity reliability. It further predicts trust probability and calibrates the output probability, improving predictive confidence under sparse or conflicting evidence. Extensive experiments on multiple public trust datasets show that TCHG achieves effective and reliable trust prediction compared with representative trust prediction and heterogeneous graph baselines.

</details>


### [412] [SPICE: Synergy and Partial Information Based Curriculum Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16639)
*Ankush Pratap Singh,Houwei Cao,Yong Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SPICE提出了一种基于偏信息分解(PID)理论的动态多模态课程学习框架,通过将多模态交互分解为冗余、独特和协同信息成分,构建随训练过程演化的渐进式课程,实现从共享线索到模态特定模式再到复杂协同交互的学习过渡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态课程学习方法假设样本相对难度在训练过程中保持不变,无法适应模型演化;同时样本难度的衡量往往依赖静态代理指标,缺乏对多模态交互复杂性的细粒度建模。

Method: 1)利用偏信息分解(PID)理论将多模态信息分解为冗余(R)、独特(U)、协同(S)三个成分;2)基于单模态和多模态预测的置信度及KL散度动态计算PID分数;3)设计两种课程策略:SPICE-S(分阶段样本分箱)和SPICE-E(全数据集样本排序);4)每k=5个epoch重新估计PID分数以适应模型演化;5)在冗余→独特→协同三阶段渐进式训练。

Result: 在CREMA-D、Kinetics-Sounds、NVGesture(三模态)和VGGSound(大规模)四个基准测试上,SPICE-E均取得最优性能:CREMA-D达83.06% ACC/89.07% mAP,Kinetics-Sounds达73.99% ACC/79.48% mAP,NVGesture达87.14% ACC/87.36% F1,VGGSound达54.98% ACC/56.63% mAP,均超过BSS-L等先进基线。SPICE-S训练效率更高,梯度更新量减少近2/3。

Conclusion: SPICE验证了多模态样本难度是动态且模型依赖的量,基于PID的内生信号比基于人类标注的静态先验或代理指标更有效;模型驱动的动态课程优于静态课程和混合自适应课程;该框架可扩展至大规模和更多模态场景。

Abstract: Multimodal learning exploits complementary information across heterogeneous modalities. The informativeness of each modality can vary widely across samples and training stages. Existing multimodal curriculum learning strategies often assume that the relative complexity of samples remains unchanged throughout training and therefore cannot adapt to model evolution. We propose SPICE (Synergy and Partial Information based Curriculum Evolution), a novel progressive curriculum framework for multimodal interaction learning. Guided by Partial Information Decomposition (PID) theory, our approach decomposes multimodal interactions into redundant, unique, and synergistic information components, enabling an interpretable and dynamic characterization of sample complexity. Building on this decomposition, we design a progressive curriculum that evolves throughout training, allowing the model to transition from learning shared cross-modal cues to modality-specific patterns and, finally, to complex synergistic interactions. Adapting to model evolution, sample ordering is refined in real-time using PID information estimates derived from unimodal and multimodal predictions. Experiments across multiple multimodal benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over conventional training and state-of-the-art baselines, highlighting the effectiveness of PID information decomposition and adaptive sample ordering for multimodal curriculum learning.

</details>


### [413] [Distribution Alignment for One-Shot Federated Learning via Optimal Transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16655)
*Daniele Berardini,Vito Paolo Pastore,Vittorio Murino*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SLOT-Align，一种基于最优传输的几何感知特征对齐框架，专门用于单次联邦学习(OSFL)场景。该方法通过冻结编码器提取客户端特征统计量，利用Bures-Wasserstein重心构建全局参考分布，并通过闭式测地最优传输映射对齐局部特征表示，无需训练即可即插即用地提升现有OSFL方法的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在单次联邦学习(OSFL)极端通信约束下，客户端与服务器仅交互一次，域偏移(domain shift)和标签偏移(label shift)的联合作用导致客户端特征表示严重错位，而现有OSFL方法（蒸馏、生成式、集成式或基于统计量的方法）要么假设表示已对齐，要么仅单独处理域偏移或标签偏移，无法有效纠正这种联合异质性带来的特征分布失配。

Method: SLOT-Align采用三阶段流程：(1) 各客户端利用共享冻结编码器提取局部特征的均值μ_k和协方差Σ_k（经Ledoit-Wolf收缩正则化保证正定性），用高斯代理近似特征分布Q_k；(2) 服务器通过加权平均构建全局参考均值μ_b，并求解Bures-Wasserstein重心优化问题（采用固定点迭代）构建全局协方差Σ_b；(3) 客户端利用闭式仿射最优传输映射T_k(z)=A_k z + b_k将局部高斯对齐到参考高斯，其中A_k通过矩阵平方根运算得到，并通过插值参数τ∈[0,1]在恒速测地线上调制对齐强度，避免过校正。该方法无需任何训练过程，可作为预处理模块与现有基于冻结编码器的OSFL流程无缝结合。

Result: 在Office-Home、Digits和DomainNet三个基准数据集上，使用CLIP预训练的ViT-B/32编码器，在Dirichlet浓度参数α=0.1/0.05/0.01的不同标签偏移强度下，SLOT-Align一致地提升了O-FedAvg、FedCGS和FedPFT三种OSFL基线的宏观平均准确率（最高提升达+8.09%），同时降低跨域标准差。在纯域偏移（无标签偏移）场景下性能与基线相当，无明显退化。对齐强度τ=0.4为最优折中，过大则性能下降。该方法在不同骨干网络（ResNet-18、ViT-B/32 ImageNet预训练）上均保持稳定增益，在更细粒度客户端划分下也持续有效。计算开销小，通信成本仅O(m+m²)，约264KB/客户端（m=512, float16）。

Conclusion: SLOT-Align通过最优传输理论为单次联邦学习提供了一种高效、训练无关的特征对齐机制，能够同时纠正域偏移和标签偏移引起的特征分布失配。作为轻量级预处理模块，它可与现有OSFL方法无缝集成，在多种数据集、骨干网络和异质性配置下均展现出一致的性能提升和鲁棒性增强，为严格通信预算下的联邦学习提供了新的解决方案。

Abstract: One-Shot Federated Learning (OSFL) addresses extreme communication regimes in which clients interact with the server only once, amplifying the impact of heterogeneous client data distributions. In particular, the interaction of domain shift and label shift across clients induces misaligned feature representations that cannot be corrected through iterative optimization. Existing OSFL methods rely on distillation, server-side generation or ensemble-based aggregation, but assume aligned representations or address domain and label shift separately. We introduce SLOT-Align (Single-round, Learning-free Optimal Transport Alignment), a geometry-aware feature harmonization framework for OSFL. SLOT-Align uses a shared frozen encoder to extract compact feature statistics, constructs a global reference via Bures-Wasserstein barycenters, and aligns local representations using closed-form geodesic optimal transport maps. The method is computationally efficient and can be combined with existing OSFL pipelines relying on frozen encoders without modifying their training procedures. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks, pretrained backbones, and OSFL methods show that SLOT-Align consistently improves accuracy and robustness under joint domain and label shift.

</details>


### [414] [Near-Optimal Stochastic Linear Bandits with Delay](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16656)
*Ofir Schlisselberg,Mengxiao Zhang,Yishay Mansour*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究具有延迟反馈的随机线性老虎机（stochastic linear bandits），在多种延迟模型下建立了近似最优的遗憾（regret）保证。研究揭示了线性结构与延迟反馈之间的根本性交互作用，刻画了何时线性老虎机的行为与多臂老虎机（MAB）相似，何时会出现本质性的新挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 延迟反馈是强化学习、推荐系统和在线广告等实际应用中的常见现象。现有研究大多集中于MAB场景，而对于利用特征进行泛化的线性老虎机，延迟反馈如何与线性结构相互作用仍缺乏系统性理解。本文旨在填补这一空白，明确刻画延迟反馈下线性老虎机与MAB在统计与计算复杂度上的本质差异。

Method: 本文针对三种延迟模型分别建立理论结果：（1）损失独立型延迟（loss-independent delays），即延迟不依赖于实际损失但可能依赖于臂（arm），分析其加性遗憾惩罚；（2）损失依赖型延迟（loss-dependent delays），证明线性老虎机在此情形下显著难于MAB，并建立匹配的上界和下界；（3）延迟即收益模型（delay-as-payoff model），作为损失依赖型延迟的特殊情形进行分析。研究综合运用了上界算法设计（可能包括基于乐观主义的线性bandit算法如LinUCB的变体）以及信息论下界证明技术。

Result: 主要结果包括：（1）对于损失独立型延迟：在随机延迟下，惩罚与期望延迟成比例；在对抗性延迟下，惩罚与最大未观察观测数量成比例。两者均为无维度依赖的（dimension-free），优于现有最优结果。（2）对于损失依赖型延迟：证明了匹配的上界和下界（差对数因子），其延迟惩罚依赖于维度的平方根，这与MAB情形有本质区别。（3）对于延迟即收益模型：证明MAB中仅依赖于最优臂延迟的最优保证在线性老虎机中无法实现。这些结果共同给出了延迟反馈与线性泛化交互作用的精确刻画。

Conclusion: 本文提供了延迟反馈与线性结构交互作用的尖锐（sharp）刻画。结论表明：损失独立型延迟仅引入轻度的加性惩罚，且对维度不敏感；但一旦延迟依赖于损失，线性老虎机将出现与MAB根本不同的困难——维度会进入后悔惩罚项（以平方根形式），且MAB中某些最优性质无法保留。这些结果对设计实际延迟环境下的bandit算法具有重要指导意义，并开启了关于线性泛化与反馈延迟相互作用的深入研究方向。

Abstract: We study stochastic linear bandits with delayed feedback under several delay models and establish near-optimal regret guarantees. Our results identify when delayed linear bandits exhibit the same qualitative behavior as multi-armed bandits (MAB), and when the linear structure creates fundamentally new challenges. Specifically, (1) for \emph{loss-independent delays}, where the delay does not depend on the realized loss (but potentially depends on the arm), we show that delays incur only an additive regret penalty. Under stochastic delays, this penalty scales with the expected delay, while under adversarial delays, it scales with the maximum number of outstanding observations. Notably, both delay penalties are dimension-free, improving upon the state-of-the-art results; (2) for \emph{loss-dependent delays}, we show that linear bandits are substantially harder than MAB: unlike in MAB, we prove matching (up to log factors) upper and lower bounds in linear bandits, whose delay penalty depends on the square root of the dimension. (3) for the \emph{delay-as-payoff model}, a special case of loss-dependent delay, we show that the optimal MAB guarantee, which depends only on the delay of the optimal arm, is also unattainable in linear bandits. Together, these results provide a sharp characterization of how delayed feedback interacts with linear generalization.

</details>


### [415] [Beyond Defensive Reporting: Machine Learning for Active Anti-Money Laundering Control in Insurance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16663)
*Dara Goldar,Geir Kjetil Ferkingstad Sandve,Martin Jullum*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了利用机器学习（梯度提升决策树）在保险理赔阶段主动检测洗钱行为的方法，发现将保险欺诈标签作为辅助训练信号可显著提升洗钱检测性能，最佳模型能在排名前2%–6%的可疑理赔中捕获近三分之二的洗钱案件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 洗钱活动通过保险理赔渠道对保险公司构成欺诈赔付与声誉/合规风险，但现有研究多集中于事后被动报告而非事前主动预防；同时，保险欺诈与洗钱在行为模式上可能存在关联，但尚未被系统研究利用。

Method: 使用挪威一家大型保险公司的真实生产数据，训练梯度提升决策树模型以识别事后被上报为涉嫌洗钱的理赔；引入保险欺诈调查标签作为辅助训练信号；提出新的评估指标"预算加权捕获率"（Budget-Weighted Capture Rate），用于衡量在仅能人工审核少量理赔时模型所能捕获的洗钱案件比例，并比较不同学习设置下的效果。

Result: 研究发现：(1) 加入欺诈相关调查标签作为辅助训练信号显著提升了洗钱检测效果；(2) 最佳模型在排名前2%–6%的可疑理赔中即可捕获约三分之二（近65%）的洗钱案件；(3) 这是首个针对保险理赔场景下机器学习检测洗钱的实证研究。

Conclusion: 机器学习可以有效将保险公司的反洗钱工作从被动报告转向主动预防；保险欺诈标签作为辅助信号在缺乏直接洗钱标签时具有重要价值；预算加权捕获率为评估有限审核资源下的检测效率提供了实用指标，对保险业反洗钱实践具有重要启示。

Abstract: Money laundering through insurance claims poses a threat to insurers both through fraudulent payouts and reputational and regulatory risk. Despite this, little research has examined how such laundering can be prevented. This paper examines whether machine learning can help insurers flag suspicious claims before payout, shifting the focus from passive reporting to active prevention. Using production data from a major Norwegian insurer, we train gradient-boosted decision tree models to detect claims later reported to authorities for suspected money laundering. Because fraud and laundering may share behavioural patterns, we also examine whether insurance fraud labels can serve as an auxiliary training signal. We compare different learning setups using the Budget-Weighted Capture Rate, a metric introduced in this paper to measure how many laundering cases are captured when only a small share of claims can be manually reviewed. The results show that incorporating fraud-related investigation labels substantially improves laundering detection. The best-performing model captures nearly two-thirds of laundering cases within the top-ranked 2 to 6 percent of claims selected for investigation. To our knowledge, this is the first empirical study of machine learning for money laundering detection in insurance claims.

</details>


### [416] [Multimodal Evaluator Preference Collapse: Cross-Modal Contagion in Self-Evolving Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16682)
*Zewen Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究多模态AI智能体在自评估反馈循环中出现的"评估者偏好崩溃"(EPC)现象及其跨模态传染效应。研究发现，使用GPT-4o评估DeepSeek-chat时，单一策略(step_by_step)占据48.4%权重（是纯文本自评估崩溃程度的3.2倍），而视觉专用策略仅获9.1%总权重。通过四阶段隔离训练范式，论文形式化定义了"跨模态传染"现象及传染矩阵Γ，并揭示了清晰的评估者风险层级：跨模型评估产生强烈但对称的双向传染(γ̄≈1.0-1.2)，高轮次导致单策略崩溃(70%零传染率)，而自评估提供近乎完全的免疫力(97%零传染率，d=0.07)。论文发布MM-EPC实验框架，识别跨模型评估架构为偏好传染的主要风险因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着大语言模型越来越多地作为评估者用于其他AI系统（特别是在GPT-4o等多模态模型崛起的背景下），一个关键问题浮现：评估者偏见是否在不同模态间存在差异，以及一种模态的偏见是否会污染另一种模态的评估？本文将之前在纯文本设置中发现的评估者偏好崩溃(EPC)现象扩展到多模态场景，旨在探究EPC是否在跨模型多模态评估中存在、其幅度是否依赖模态、以及在一种模态上训练获得的评估偏好是否会泄漏到其他模态。

Method: 论文采用测试时强化学习(TTRL)框架，将策略选择形式化为策略空间上的随机老虎机过程，通过乘性权重更新规则进行策略权重调整。核心方法包括：(1) 定义偏好崩溃指数(PCI)为权重分布的变异系数，并扩展为多模态版本(MPCI和CPCI)；(2) 设计四阶段隔离训练范式——纯文本训练(Phase 1)、纯视觉训练(Phase 2)、T→V传染测量(Phase 3)、V→T传染测量(Phase 4)；(3) 形式化定义传染系数γ_{A→B}为后传染权重向量与纯模态参考向量间的相对欧氏距离，并构建传染矩阵Γ。实验执行DeepSeek-chat作为执行者，使用GPT-4o、Qwen-plus、DashScope gui-plus作为评估者，进行多种配置的多轮重复实验(总计15,592次API调用)。

Result: 核心发现包括：(1) GPT-4o跨模型评估产生PCI=1.464，是纯文本自评估(0.461)的3.18倍、随机评估(0.716)的2.04倍；(2) 视觉任务崩溃强于文本(PCI 1.464 vs 1.348)，三个视觉策略仅获9.1%总权重；(3) 跨模型评估产生强烈但对称的双向传染——GPT-4o条件下γ̄_{T→V}=1.176, γ̄_{V→T}=1.089, Δγ=-0.088, p=0.575, d=0.29（不显著）；Qwen-plus条件下γ̄_{T→V}=1.119, γ̄_{V→T}=0.988；(4) 高轮次(DashScope 50轮)导致70%运行退化为零传染；(5) 自评估(DeepSeek-chat自评)提供近乎完全免疫——30次重复中29次(97%)产生精确零传染，γ̄_{T→V}=0.033, γ̄_{V→T}=0.023, d=0.07；(6) 纯文本训练偏好synthesis策略、纯视觉训练偏好step_by_step策略，跨模态暴露后发生策略反转。无任何评估条件显示统计显著的方向性不对称。

Conclusion: 论文得出结论：跨模态评估者传染是真实存在的、具有评估者条件性、且可通过自评估预防的现象。核心启示是跨模型评估架构是偏好传染的主要风险因素——跨模型评估者产生强烈但对称的双向传染(γ̄≈1.0-1.2)，而自评估提供近乎完全的免疫力(97%零传染率)。建议任何在反馈循环中使用LLM评估者的AI系统应：(1) 报告评估者身份以及PCI和传染矩阵Γ；(2) 优先使用自评估或多评估者集成以减轻传染风险；(3) 监控训练轮次以避免崩溃边界(R≳50)；(4) 隔离模态特定训练阶段以防止跨模态传染。论文同时诚实指出了多个重要局限：视觉任务为文本代理而非真实图像输入、策略集不平衡(8文本+3视觉)、样本量在某些条件下偏小等，这些限制使视觉相关结论的生态效度受到约束。

Abstract: When AI agents use language models to evaluate their own outputs in a feedback loop, systematic biases emerge. We show that Evaluator Preference Collapse (EPC) is dramatically amplified in multimodal settings. Using GPT-4o to evaluate DeepSeek-chat across text and visual tasks, we find that a single strategy (step_by_step) absorbs 48.4% of all weight -- 3.2x the collapse observed in text-only self-evaluation -- while three visual-domain strategies receive only 9.1% combined weight. We then demonstrate a novel phenomenon we term cross-modal contagion: evaluator preferences acquired on one modality transfer to and corrupt strategy selection on another. Through a four-phase isolation training paradigm, we measure contagion coefficients and document strategy inversion -- the optimal strategy for a modality reverses after cross-modal exposure. A Phase 3 statistical validation across four evaluator configurations (N=53 total independent repetitions, 15,592 API calls) reveals a clear hierarchy: cross-model evaluation (GPT-4o, N=8) produces strong but symmetric bidirectional contagion (mean gamma_{T->V}=1.176, gamma_{V->T}=1.089, Delta=-0.088, p=0.575, Cohen's d=0.29); high round counts (DashScope, 50 rounds) cause collapse to single-strategy dominance (70% zero contagion); and self-evaluation provides near-complete immunity -- 97% of runs (N=30, DeepSeek-chat) yield exactly zero contagion (mean gamma=0.033, 95% CI [-0.031, 0.010], p=0.642, d=0.07). No evaluator condition shows statistically significant directional asymmetry. We introduce the contagion matrix indexed by evaluator identity, release the MM-EPC experimental framework, and identify cross-model evaluator architecture as the primary risk factor for preference contagion.

</details>


### [417] [Learning Policy from a Single Trajectory in Average-Reward Markov Decision Process](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16729)
*Jongmin Lee,Ernest K. Ryu,Vaneet Aggarwal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对弱通信平均奖励马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），提出了首个基于单条轨迹的有限样本复杂度保证，包括无模型的基于价值和基于策略的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的平均奖励MDP有限样本分析研究有限，且大多依赖限制性较强的假设（如遍历性或可访问生成模型）。作者旨在突破这些限制，为更一般的弱通信MDP提供单轨迹下的样本复杂度保证。

Method: 作者深入研究了弱通信MDP中单条轨迹的动态特性，并基于此分析开发了新颖的无模型强化学习方法，包括基于价值的方法和基于策略的方法。此外，还提出了一种在通信MDP中无需任何问题相关先验知识的无模型方法。

Result: 基于价值的方法在弱通信MDP下达到了 Õ(1/ε²) 的有限样本复杂度；基于策略的方法达到了 Õ(1/ε⁴) 的有限样本复杂度，二者均基于单条轨迹。此外，提出了首个在通信MDP中无需问题相关先验知识的无模型方法。

Conclusion: 本文首次为弱通信平均奖励MDP提供了基于单条轨迹的有限样本复杂度保证，推进了平均奖励强化学习在更一般设置下的理论研究，并消除了对强假设或先验知识的依赖。

Abstract: While there is an extensive body of work characterizing the sample complexity of discounted cumulative-reward MDPs, finite sample analyses for average-reward MDPs have been limited, and most existing works rely on restrictive assumptions such as ergodicity or access to a generative model. In this work, we establish the first finite sample complexity guarantees from a single trajectory for weakly communicating average-reward MDPs. To this end, we study the dynamics of a single trajectory in weakly communicating MDPs and based on this analysis, we develop novel model-free methods. Notably, our value-based and policy-based methods provide finite sample complexity guarantees of $\widetilde{O}(1/\varepsilon^2)$ and $\widetilde{O}(1/\varepsilon^4)$ from a single trajectory in weakly communicating MDPs, respectively. Furthermore, we introduce the first model-free method that requires no prior knowledge of problem-dependent quantities for communicating MDPs.

</details>


### [418] [MyPCBench: A Benchmark for Personally Intelligent Computer-Use Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16748)
*Lawrence Keunho Jang,Andrew Keunwoo Jang,Jing Yu Koh,Ruslan Salakhutdinov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MyPCBench is a benchmark that evaluates computer-use AI agents as personal assistants on a fully seeded Linux desktop (17 simulated web apps + LibreOffice) built around a single canonical persona (Michael Scott from The Office), containing 184 tasks inspired by real personal-assistant requests from the OpenClaw community. It tests whether agents can reason over a user's personal data, history, and cross-application context rather than operating on empty, stock-state desktops.


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Existing computer-use agent benchmarks (WebArena, OSWorld, AppWorld, etc.) evaluate agents in impersonal environments with minimal or generic seeded data, leaving a large gap between evaluation and real deployment where personal assistants must navigate logged-in accounts, historical records, and cross-app personal context. Live-web benchmarks specifically exclude sites requiring login or personal information, exactly the kind of tasks a real personal assistant must handle. No prior benchmark seeds a coherent user identity at the scale of a full personal computer.

Method: The benchmark uses a reproducible Docker/QEMU Ubuntu 24.04 VM with GNOME, hosting 17 Next.js-built clones of real consumer apps (Gmail, Calendar, Uber, DoorDash, Chase, Airbnb, etc.) plus LibreOffice and Firefox, all pre-logged-in as Michael Scott. The environment is deterministically generated from a single persona JSON specification, seeding ~42,000 rows across 226 database tables (1,812 bank transactions, 2,398 emails, 679 calendar events, etc.) with cross-app consistency. 184 tasks were derived from 2,749 OpenClaw community requests, rewritten for the persona and paired with natural-language rubrics. Six models (Claude Opus 4.6, Sonnet 4.6, GPT-5.5, GPT-5.4 mini, Qwen 3.5 35B-A3B, Qwen 3.5 9B) were evaluated using their native CUA agents with a uniform computer+bash tool surface, a 100-turn budget, and LLM-as-a-judge (gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview) rubric-based grading.

Result: Claude Opus 4.6 leads at 55.4% perfect rate (81.8% rubric score)—the only model above 50%, ~1.4× the next-best (Sonnet 4.6 at 39.1%) and nearly 2× the best non-Claude (GPT-5.5 at 29.3%). Both Qwen models scored very low (35B-A3B: 7.6% perfect; 9B: 2.7% perfect, collapsing under dual-tool). Performance degrades sharply with cross-app complexity: Opus falls from 66% (1 app) to 36% (7+ apps), and the gap widens for weaker models. Three family-specific failure modes emerged: Claude takes "console-script shortcuts" (using bash/curl instead of visible UI), GPT prematurely emits DONE before satisfying rubrics (354 hits, 235 from GPT), and Qwen hallucinates persona data (13/31 hits) or collapses under dual-tool schemas. Adding bash to OpenAI/Qwen agents produced only small deltas, with Qwen 9B regressing by 13.2 rubric points.

Conclusion: MyPCBench exposes a substantial gap between deployment-ready personal assistants and current evaluation regimes: even the strongest frontier agent fully solves barely over half of personal-assistant tasks. The benchmark identifies three actionable, family-specific failure patterns (bash shortcuts in Claude, premature DONE in GPT, tool-schema collapse and hallucination in Qwen) that future agent designs can target. The hardest task categories (aggregation & reporting, multi-step orchestration, pattern inference) and high cross-app counts remain unsolved, indicating that balanced integration of coding/shell abilities with computer-use actions is critical for personal-assistant competence. The authors release the environment, tasks, rubrics, harness, and judge configuration as an open baseline, explicitly noting the trade-off of depth over persona diversity (one canonical persona and Linux/GNOME stack) and the deliberate choice of a low-sensitivity fictional persona to mitigate dual-use concerns.

Abstract: Current benchmarks for computer-use agents evaluate models in impersonal environments. This leaves a gap between evaluation and deployment where personal assistants are expected to work across a user's whole digital life, including their context, historical data, and logged-in accounts. This gap is widest on web tasks, where live web evaluations cannot exercise sites that require logging in or personal information, the kind of site a real personal assistant has to drive. We introduce MyPCBench, which tests computer-use agents as personal assistants on a Linux desktop populated with 17 simulated real-world web applications and a full desktop stack, all seeded for one canonical persona, Michael Scott from The Office. We define 184 tasks in this environment, each inspired by a real request drawn from the OpenClaw community, and benchmark six closed and open-weight models with a uniform computer+bash tool surface. We find that the best model, Claude Opus 4.6, fully solves 55.4\% of the tasks, the only model above 50\%. Model failures cluster on tasks that span many applications and on long trajectories, where personalization stresses an assistant the most. We release the environment, task set, and agent harness at this https URL .

</details>


### [419] [Maximum Entropy Inverse Reinforcement Learning for Mean-Field Games with Average Reward](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16759)
*Şevket Kaan Alkır,Naci Saldı,Berkay Anahtarcı,Can Deha Karıksız*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对平均奖励准则下离散时间、无限时域平稳均值场博弈(MFG),提出了一个统一的最大因果熵逆强化学习(IRL)框架。该框架在单一占测度视角下,同时处理有限维线性奖励和无穷维RKHS奖励两类模型。核心技术创新在于:通过引入基于minorization的次随机核,弥补了平均奖励设置中因无折扣因子而丧失的软Bellman算子严格压缩性,进而建立了具有Fréchet可微性和Lipschitz光滑性的对偶/得分函数,最终给出带收敛保证的梯度算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 1. 现有MFG-IRL工作多聚焦于折扣设置,平均奖励设置因软Bellman算子不再具备严格压缩性而面临根本性技术困难;2. 同时覆盖有限维参数化(线性特征)与无穷维非参数化(RKHS)奖励的需求尚未被统一处理;3. 平均奖励准则对长时域、无人工折扣的博弈建模更为自然,在网络安全(如恶意软件传播)和经济学(如消费者选择)等应用中具有实际意义;4. 既要保持IRL的可解释性(恢复潜在奖励),又要保证算法一致性。

Method: 1. 平稳MFG设定下,假设专家行为来自未知奖励下的平稳MFE,IRL目标转化为在占测度上最大化平均因果熵,并以专家均值场项不变性和长期特征期望匹配为约束;2. 线性奖励情形:对偶化得到显式对数配分函数形式的对偶目标,通过Sion极小极大定理证明无对偶间隙,证明Lipschitz光滑性(L=6M²√(|X||A|))以及在规范固定空间(R^k×R_0^X×R_0^X)上的紧集强凸性,从而支持常步长梯度下降并获线性收敛率;3. RKHS奖励情形:对约束做Lagrangian松弛,将内部最大化问题转化为关于Lagrange乘子ϑ=(ζ,ψ)∈R^X×H_k的熵正则化控制问题,导出软Bellman方程Q_ϑ=r_ϑ+p̃·V_{Q_ϑ};4. 关键技术:在minorization假设(存在次概率测度ξ使p≥ξ)下,构造次随机核p̃=p-ξ,证明软Bellman算子在∞范数下是压缩因子κ=1-ξ(X)<1的严格压缩;5. 利用隐函数定理建立Q_ϑ对ϑ的Fréchet可微性,通过求解算子方程∇_ϑQ_ϑ=(I-P̃Π(ϑ))⁻¹F推导Lipschitz常数L=|A|K²(κ+1)/(1-κ)³,得到对数似然得分函数的光滑性,完成梯度上升算法的收敛性分析。

Result: 1. 理论结果:(i)线性情形下对偶目标h在规范固定子空间上具有L-smooth与ρ(D)-强凸,常步长δ=1/L梯度下降线性收敛‖z_k-z_⋆‖²≤(1-δρ)^k‖z_0-z_⋆‖²;(ii)RKHS情形下软Bellman算子在∞范数下严格压缩,得分函数V是L-smooth,梯度上升产生最佳迭代收敛速率min_{k<K}‖∇V(ϑ_k)‖²≤2(V*-V(ϑ_0))/(γK);(iii)证明当∇V(ϑ*)=0时,ϑ*同时是对偶极小点和原问题极大点,且所恢复的(π_{ϑ*},μ_E)在恢复的奖励下构成MFE;2. 数值结果:(i)十状态恶意软件传播模型:80000次迭代后,恢复策略与专家策略最大逐项误差为0.1361,定性行为与专家一致(严重度<0.5时几乎不修复,>0.5时几乎必修复);(ii)四状态RKHS消费者选择模型:80000次迭代,得分V=-0.01969,梯度范数0.01619,均值场项L¹误差0.007892,最大策略误差0.06524,恢复策略在四个状态-动作对上的选择与专家完全一致。

Conclusion: 本文为平均奖励准则下平稳MFG的最大因果熵IRL问题建立了一个统一的严谨框架,成功解决了无折扣因子下软Bellman算子缺乏压缩性的核心难题。其方法学意义在于:通过minorization次随机核技术将平均奖励控制问题等价转化为压缩算子固定点问题,这一思路可推广至其他无折扣RL/IRL设置。所提算法在恶意软件传播和消费者选择两个截然不同的领域均取得良好恢复效果,验证了框架的实用性。论文明确指出了若干有前景的开放方向:(1)连续状态-动作空间的扩展需要测度论处理与无限维函数空间中的Bellman固定点分析;(2)从有限样本专家轨迹出发的有限样本分析;(3)随机/方差缩减梯度变体以适应高维问题;(4)向时变MFG、多群体异质主体以及部分可观察动力学的推广。总体而言,本文在MFG-IRL的折扣→平均奖励推广方面迈出了重要一步,同时为RKHS非参数奖励下的IRL提供了首个具有完整收敛保证的算法。

Abstract: We study inverse reinforcement learning for discrete-time, infinite-horizon mean-field games (MFGs) under an average-reward criterion. Expert demonstrations are assumed to arise from a stationary mean-field equilibrium under an unknown reward, and the goal is to recover a policy explaining the observed behaviour via the maximum causal entropy principle. We formulate the inverse problem by enforcing consistency with the expert mean-field term and long-run feature expectations, treating two reward classes within a unified occupation-measure framework. For finite-dimensional linear rewards, we give a convex dual reformulation with an explicit log-partition objective, and prove smoothness and curvature properties justifying constant-step-size gradient descent. For infinite-dimensional RKHS rewards, we develop a Lagrangian relaxation whose inner-maximising policy is characterised by a soft Bellman equation. The main obstacle is the absence of a discount-factor contraction. We resolve this by introducing a minorisation-based sub-stochastic kernel that yields a strict contraction of the soft Bellman operator. We establish Fréchet differentiability and Lipschitz smoothness of the log-likelihood score, leading to a gradient ascent algorithm with convergence guarantees. Two numerical examples, a malware-spread MFG and an RKHS-based consumer-choice model, show that the recovered policies closely match expert behaviour.

</details>


### [420] [A Validated LBM Dataset and Pipeline for Surrogate Modeling of Turbulent 3D Obstructed Channel Flows](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16765)
*Lukas Schröder,Shubham Kavane,Harald Köstler*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一套可复现的数据生成流水线，用于在Re=1,000–10,000范围内为3D通道流生成训练数据，以支持神经算子（Neural Operators）在湍流预测中的标准化基准评估。核心采用基于cumlant碰撞算子的格子Boltzmann求解器，并通过实验数据（Strouhal数、阻力系数、湍流脉动）以及高分辨率（1024×512×512）的网格收敛性研究进行了严格验证。论文还规划了对Fourier Neural Operator和U-Net变体在预测、超分辨率和误差校正任务上的系统评估，并拟采用物理信息驱动的指标衡量湍流能量级串的表征能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前神经算子在3D湍流问题上的评估缺乏经过严格验证的基准数据集和标准化的对比框架，阻碍了替代模型（surrogate model）的可重复比较与实际应用推进。作者希望通过建立一套经过物理基准校验的高保真数据生成流水线，填补这一空白。

Method: 1) 基于格子Boltzmann方法（LBM），采用cumlant碰撞算子进行流场求解；2) 在生成的复杂几何通道中开展Re=1,000–10,000的3D湍流模拟；3) 通过与实验测量数据（Strouhal数、阻力系数、湍流脉动）对比以及系统的网格收敛性研究（在1024×512×512分辨率下）进行严格验证；4) 规划阶段：将Fourier Neural Operator（FNO）与U-Net变体应用于预测、超分辨率和误差校正三类任务，并使用物理信息驱动的评估指标来衡量对湍流能量级串的表征能力。

Result: 目前尚未给出神经算子的定量实验结果（属于规划阶段）。已展示的方法学成果包括：可复现的数据生成流水线已建立并完成物理基准验证；求解器在网格收敛性实验中表现良好；为后续FNO与U-Net的系统基准对比奠定了基础。作者明确寻求社区对验证方法、基准设计和评估优先级的反馈。

Conclusion: 该工作为神经算子在3D湍流应用中的标准化评估提供了经过实验验证的数据基础和明确的基准路线图。论文本身更侧重于基础设施搭建与方法学贡献，而非直接的模型性能结论；其长远目标是推动数值求解器与神经替代模型之间计算效率的系统比较，促进神经算子在湍流仿真中的实际落地。

Abstract: Evaluating neural operators for 3D turbulent flow requires validated datasets with physical benchmarks. We present a reproducible pipeline generating training data for 3D channel flows around generated geometries at Re=1,000-10,000. Our lattice Boltzmann solver with cumulant collision operators is rigorously verified against experimental measurements (Strouhal number, drag coefficients, turbulent fluctuations) with comprehensive grid convergence studies at resolution 1024x512x512. Building upon an established framework, this validated pipeline enables standardized surrogate model comparison. We outline planned systematic evaluation of Fourier Neural Operator and U-Net variants on forecasting, super-resolution, and error correction tasks, using physics-informed metrics to assess turbulent energy cascade representation. Future work will compare computational efficiency between numerical solvers and neural surrogates, exploring practical application. We seek community feedback on our validation approach, planned benchmark methodology, and evaluation priorities for neural operators in turbulent flows.

</details>


### [421] [Taming Curvature: Architecture Warm-Up for Stable Transformer Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16768)
*Sameera Ramasinghe,Ajanthan Thalaiyasingam,Hadi Mohaghegh Dolatabadi,Chamin Hewa Koneputugodage,Gil Avraham,Violetta Shevchenko,Yan Zuo,Karol Pajak,Alexander Long*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于预条件Hessian最大特征值（曲率）的在线快速估计方法（热启动幂迭代），并基于此设计了"架构热身"策略——通过渐进式解锁Transformer层数来控制曲率增长，从而在十亿参数规模上稳定Transformer训练，无需动态计算图手术。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 十亿参数规模Transformer训练常出现损失突刺、梯度爆炸甚至发散，浪费大量算力。边缘稳定性（EoS）理论指出训练稳定性由 η·λ_max(H) 决定，但现有曲率估计方法（基于HVP的幂迭代）在大模型上计算和内存开销过大，难以在线应用，导致曲率控制方法在工业级训练中难以落地。

Method: 1) **热启动幂迭代曲率估计器**：利用Hessian的Lipschitz连续性证明顶层特征向量"缓慢移动"，上一时刻的估计可作为下一时刻的暖初始化，将每步所需HVP从≥20次降至<5次，并扩展到Adam的预条件Hessian G_t = P_t^{-1/2} H P_t^{-1/2}；2) **架构热身**：训练初期冻结部分Transformer层（将除RMSNorm外的所有权重置零并排除优化器），保持浅层以限制曲率；学习率衰减阶段（稳定性阈值放松时）按预设调度分批解锁层数，使 η·λ_max(G_t) 始终处于稳定包络内。方法无需计算图手术，可直接集成到现有训练流程。

Result: 在FineWeb、DCLM、Olmo-Mix三个数据集上训练最大3B参数的Llama 3风格Transformer：热启动估计器在4层模型上以5次HVP即达到冷启动20次HVP的精度且方差更低；8/16/32层对比实验显示曲率随深度增长，16和32层在LR预热期出现曲率突刺并越过稳定性边界；架构热身在不同学习率（3e-3至8e-3）下均保持稳定收敛，在1B/16层模型上显著优于QK-Norm、QK-Clip、Softcap（后者在多个数据集上发散为NaN），FineWeb困惑度从49.88降至25.02；Chinchilla计算最优设置（1B/16层/25B tokens）下验证PPL为18.35，优于QK-Norm的20.28；甚至可替代学习率热身而仍保持稳定。

Conclusion: 该工作建立了大模型曲率感知训练的可扩展框架：热启动幂迭代使十亿参数级在线曲率跟踪成为可能，理论保证（Davis-Kahan sin-Θ定理）和实验均证明其高效性与精度；架构热身以函数保持的方式渐进增加有效深度，将曲率控制与EoS稳定性判据直接关联，扩大了稳定学习率范围并减少损失突刺，且不牺牲收敛速度；两者结合可作为现有注意力级稳定方法（QK-Norm、Softcap等）的有效替代或互补。

Abstract: Training billion-parameter Transformers is often brittle, with transient loss spikes and divergence that waste compute. Even though the recently developed Edge of Stability (EoS) theory provides a powerful tool to understand and control the stability of optimization methods via the (preconditioned) curvature, these curvature-controlling methods are not popular in large-scale Transformer training due to the complexity of curvature estimation. To this end, we first introduce a fast online estimator of the largest (preconditioned) Hessian eigenvalue (i.e., curvature) based on a warm-started variant for power iteration with Hessian-vector products. We show theoretically, and verify empirically, that the proposed method makes per-iteration curvature tracking feasible at billion parameter scale while being more accurate. Using this tool, we find that training instabilities coincide with surges in preconditioned curvature and that curvature grows with depth. Motivated by these observations, we propose architecture warm-up: progressively growing network depth to carefully control the preconditioned Hessian and stabilize training. Experiments on large Transformers validate that our approach enables efficient curvature tracking and reduces instabilities compared to existing state-of-the-art stabilization techniques without slowing down convergence.

</details>


### [422] [GD$^2$PO: Mitigating Multi-Reward Conflicts via Group-Dynamic reward-Decoupled Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16771)
*Haotian Liu,Yihao Liu,Jingwei Ni,Siyuan Huang,Xinpeng Liu,Pengyu Cheng,Jiajun Song,Ruijin Ding,Junfeng Li,Zhechao Yu,Mengyu Zhou,Hongteng Xu,Xiaoxi Jiang,Guanjun Jiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 GD²PO（Group-Dynamic reward-Decoupled Policy Optimization），一种用于多奖励强化学习后训练的方法。该方法通过冲突感知过滤机制在rollout级别屏蔽掉奖励方向严重不一致的样本，并结合查询级别的重新加权策略，有效缓解了多奖励信号在聚合时相互抵消的问题，在工具调用和有用性-安全性对齐任务上显著优于GRPO和GDPO基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM后训练从单一标量奖励转向多维度奖励（如有用性、安全性、工具调用正确性、格式、长度等），如何同时优化多个潜在冲突的目标成为关键挑战。现有方法GDPO虽在各奖励维度上解耦了优势归一化，但在最终聚合时仍会将正负相反的奖励优势简单相加，导致冲突信号相互抵消，严重削弱了有效的学习信号，降低了RL训练效率。

Method: GD²PO包含两个核心组件：(1) **组动态冲突感知过滤机制**——在rollout级别判断其多奖励优势是否方向一致，提出两种过滤规则：硬过滤（若存在任意两个奖励维度的优势符号不同则丢弃该rollout）和基于信噪比（SNR）的软过滤（计算聚合优势与各维度优势绝对值之和的比值，低于阈值τ则丢弃）；(2) **查询级别重新加权**——通过保留下来的rollout比例κ̂(x)作为查询级别奖励一致性的代理，动态调整每个查询的更新强度。从理论分析上，保留的rollout数量越多，查询级更新的信噪比越高，因此保留比例可作为更新可靠性的单调代理。

Result: 在工具调用（RLLA数据集，API-Bank评估）和有用性-安全性对齐（Alpaca训练，HH-RLHF/PKU-SafeRLHF/Alpaca评估）两大任务上，使用Qwen2.5-1.5B/3B/7B-Instruct、Llama3.1-8B-Instruct、Llama3.2-3B-Instruct等多种骨干模型进行实验，GD²PO在二奖励和三奖励设置下均一致且显著优于GRPO和GDPO基线。消融实验验证了查询级重新加权能带来额外提升，SNR分数能有效区分可靠训练信号（低冲突半部训练效果优于高冲突半部），且方法对阈值τ具有鲁棒性。冲突比例分析表明多奖励冲突在不同骨干和任务中普遍存在且呈现动态变化特征。

Conclusion: GD²PO通过在rollout级别过滤严重冲突的多奖励信号并在查询级别动态调整更新强度，系统性地缓解了多奖励聚合时的信号抵消问题，在多奖励LLM后训练场景中实现了稳定且高效的多目标对齐。论文揭示了诊断和解决细粒度跨奖励动态对释放大语言模型多目标强化学习潜力的关键意义，但也指出SNR阈值τ的最优选择可能因任务、奖励尺度和模型而异，未来可探索自适应阈值策略。

Abstract: As LLMs advance, post-training reinforcement learning (RL) increasingly relies on multi-dimensional rewards to cultivate comprehensive capabilities. This shift demands new algorithms capable of optimizing diverse and potentially competing objectives simultaneously. To address this, existing methods such as Group reward-Decoupled Policy Optimization (GDPO) decompose the overall score into independent reward groups, then compute the RL loss separately within each group. However, this strategy still encounters multi-reward conflicts: a single rollout can yield positive advantages on certain reward dimensions but negative ones on others, causing opposing signals to cancel each other out during aggregation, further hindering RL training efficiency. Inspired by Dynamic sAmpling Policy Optimization (DAPO), which improves RL training efficiency by filtering out ineffective rollouts with near-zero advantages, we propose Group-Dynamic reward-Decoupled Policy Optimization (GD$^2$PO). Specifically, GD$^2$PO employs a conflict-aware filtering mechanism to mask out rollouts suffering from severe reward-wise disagreement. By preventing conflicting signals from canceling each other out, this masking strategy preserves and enhances the magnitude of effective RL advantages, thereby significantly accelerating learning efficiency. Furthermore, we introduce query-level reweighting to dynamically adjust the update intensity of each query based on its overall reward consensus. Experiments on various multi-reward scenarios, including tool calling and human preference alignment, demonstrate that GD$^2$PO consistently and significantly outperforms existing baselines. The code is available at this https URL .

</details>


### [423] [We Need Explanation Cards to Connect Explanation Algorithms to the Real World](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16786)
*Eric Günther,Balázs Szabados,Kristof Meding,Gunnar König,Sebastian Bordt,Ulrike von Luxburg*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出了"解释卡片"（Explanation Cards）框架，将标准的事后可解释性算法（如反事实解释和SHAP）的输出与关于稳健性、有效性以及明确解释说明的补充信息相结合，旨在缩小算法解释"表面含义"与"实际含义"之间的差距，帮助非专家用户正确理解算法解释，并在解释无效时检测出来。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前流行的后置解释算法存在两大核心问题：1）解释的含义往往与直觉不符，需要专家知识才能正确解读（如反事实解释的"单调性"和"稳定性"假设、SHAP依赖图的"外推"和"单调性"假设），导致非专业用户产生误解；2）已有研究（Günther et al., 2025）证明，对于复杂决策函数，局部特征归因方法本质上是不具有信息量的。两者共同导致解释"看似传达信息、实则无信息"的鸿沟，且理解责任被不合理地推给了用户。

Method: 论文采用理论分析与实例构造相结合的方法：1）问题形式化：针对表格数据的决策函数 f: ℝᵈ → ℝ，将"信息量"（informativeness）作为解释的数学必要条件；2）针对反事实解释：形式化定义单调性、反事实稳定性、输入周围稳定性，并证明当反事实缺乏稳定性时，解释不具有信息量（定理1），而具有稳定性的反事实是具有信息量的（定理2）；3）针对SHAP：形式化定义局部稳定性（定义3），证明局部稳定的SHAP值是具有信息量的（定理4），并通过定义SHAP值对其他特征变化的"近似不变性"（定义5）证明其意味着局部近似可加性（定理6）；4）实例构造：分别以贷款审批反事实解释和医疗诊断SHAP解释为案例，构建具体的解释卡片；5）法律分析：将解释卡片与欧盟AI法案第13条的透明度要求进行对接。

Result: 1）成功构建了两张示例解释卡片（贷款反事实卡片和医疗SHAP卡片），均包含机器决策、解释输出、稳定性/区域信息、解读说明等模块；2）通过数学定理证明了稳定性条件与信息量之间的严格对应关系；3）实验证明解释卡片不仅能在解释有效时使其更实用，还能在解释无效时（如SHAP依赖图大虚线包络的情况下）明确告知用户；4）法律分析表明解释卡片可作为满足欧盟AI法案第13条关于高风险AI系统透明度与可解释性要求的具体工具，同时也可支持第86条对受影响个人的解释要求以及GDPR第22条的相关义务。

Conclusion: 解释卡片通过强制提供者明确说明"哪些解释可被采纳、哪些不可"，将解释责任从用户转移到了提供者，是连接数学抽象的后置解释算法与现实应用的重要桥梁；论文为反事实解释和SHAP解释提供了可操作的卡片模板与数学保障，但同时也指出不存在通用卡片——每种解释算法和每个用例都需要定制；解释卡片是使解释算法适用于现实用例（特别是高风险场景）迈出的重要一步，未来仍需对更多解释算法和应用场景进行理论与实证分析。

Abstract: Algorithmic explanations are intended to help stakeholders understand opaque algorithmic decisions, but in practice, they often fall short. First, the meaning of algorithmic explanations is often not what one might intuitively expect, so expert knowledge is required to interpret them correctly. Second, recent work has shown that popular explanation algorithms are uninformative about the behavior of complex decision functions. Together, these issues create a gap between what explanations appear to convey and what they actually provide. In this work, we propose Explanation Cards for Explanation Algorithms, which augment standard explanations with complementary information about robustness and validity, as well as clear instructions for interpretation. The complementary information can render otherwise uninformative explanations practically useful, while also helping to detect cases where they are not. Importantly, the interpretation instructions in explanation cards shift responsibility from users to providers: Rather than expecting users to recognize what can and cannot be concluded from an explanation, providers must make this explicit upfront. Using counterfactual explanations and SHAP as examples, we demonstrate how providers can construct explanation cards and that these cards provide users with the guidance needed for sound interpretation. We further argue that explanation cards offer a practical means of operationalising the explainability provisions of the EU AI Act. Overall, explanation cards are a significant step toward making explanation algorithms fit for real-world use cases.

</details>


### [424] [HawkesNest: A Multi-Axis Synthetic Benchmark for Spatiotemporal Pattern Complexity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16863)
*Yahya Aalaila,Sumantrak Mukherjee,Gerrit Großmann,Sebastian Vollmer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: HawkesNest 是一个面向时空点过程（STPP）模型的合成基准，基于多元 Hawkes 过程生成器，定义了四个复杂度轴（时空纠缠、背景异质性、跨类型交互、域拓扑），每个轴配有从潜在数据生成机制直接计算出的确定性索引。它通过固定全局速率、稳定性与模拟预算，对 STPP 模型进行受控的诊断性压力测试。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 STPP 模型评估严重依赖不透明的真实世界数据集，潜在生成结构未知，模型失败难以归因。现有合成生成器（EasyTPP、ETAS 模拟器、犯罪热点模拟等）通常只变化单一机制或局限于低维设置，缺乏在联合时空复杂度下进行系统性诊断的能力。作者需要一个生成器对齐的基准，以隔离并可控地变化各结构复杂度来源，从而将模型失效归因到具体机制。

Method: 1. **四个生成器对齐的复杂度支柱（pillars）**：
   - **时空纠缠（Pillar I）**：通过调制场 z(r,τ) 对可分核 ϕ_b 进行非可分形变，用双变量高斯互信息 I_G(θ) 归一化得到 α_ent ∈ [0,1]。
   - **背景异质性（Pillar II）**：固定均值 λ_0，引入结构化场 g(s,t)，用归一化背景强度方差 χ² 散度定义 α_het。
   - **跨类型交互（Pillar III）**：分支矩阵 A_θ = δI + θB，结合谱范数与 Newman 模块性得到 α_int。
   - **域拓扑（Pillar IV）**：用随机几何图建模域，用欧氏距离与图测地线距离之比定义 α_top = 1 - d̄_e/d̄_g。
2. **模块化多元 Hawkes 模拟器**：通过 Ogata 风格 thinning 生成多类型时空事件，通过全局缩放保证稳定性 ρ(A)<1。
3. **两种压力测试协议**：联合异质性-纠缠对角线扫描（C1–C5）与孤立纠缠扫描（L0–L3），在固定全局速率、稳定性、模拟预算下评估 Hawkes、Cox–Hawkes 及神经 STPP 模型 AutoSTPP。

Result: 1. **索引验证**：四个复杂度索引随各自控制参数单调递增；4D 因子扫描方差分解显示主效应解释 ≥99% 的方差，跨支柱交互可忽略，验证近正交性。
2. **Hawkes 族基线在联合复杂度下退化**：每事件测试对数似然从 C1 到 C5 单调下降——Cox–Hawkes 从 2.24±0.10 降至 0.75±0.29，Hawkes 从 2.59±0.06 降至 2.09±0.11；尽管这些模型在结构上与 Hawkes 生成器对齐，仍出现渐进性失效。
3. **AutoSTPP 对孤立纠缠敏感**：强度相关性从 L0 的 0.732 持续下降至 L3 的 0.580；测试 NLL 在 L3 也明显恶化（-1.779 vs -1.832），且增加训练预算不能弥合高纠缠配置的差距，揭示了神经模型的归纳偏置或优化局限。

Conclusion: HawkesNest 定位为 STPP 模型的诊断性压力测试工具，而非排行榜式基准。其生成器对齐的复杂度索引在固定机制族内提供有意义的受控扫描坐标，可揭示两类失败模式：Hawkes 族模型在联合异质性-纠缠下的统计退化，以及 AutoSTPP 在孤立纠缠下对潜在生成结构恢复能力的退化。该框架补充了不透明的真实世界基准，但作者明确指出其索引并非跨任意 DGP 的通用复杂度度量。局限在于仅评估有限模型族与似然/强度恢复诊断。未来工作包括丰富每支柱的生成器（PDE/SDE 背景场、上下文协变量），并向用户贡献的"活基准"演化。

Abstract: Evaluation of spatiotemporal point process (STPP) models relies heavily on opaque real-world datasets, where latent generative structure is unknown and model failures are difficult to attribute. We introduce HawkesNest, a generator-aligned benchmark for controlled spatiotemporal pattern complexity built on a multivariate Hawkes backbone. HawkesNest defines four complexity axes: space--time entanglement, background heterogeneity, cross-type interaction, and domain topology. Each axis is associated with a deterministic index computed from the latent data-generating mechanism. By varying these axes while holding global rate, stability, and simulation budget fixed, HawkesNest enables diagnostic stress tests of STPP models under known structural difficulty. We verify that the indices are monotone and nearly orthogonal under controlled sweeps. We illustrate its use by showing that Hawkes-family baselines degrade under joint heterogeneity--entanglement complexity, even though they are structurally aligned with the Hawkes data-generating backbone. We further show that HawkesNest exposes neural-model sensitivity: AutoSTPP remains vulnerable under isolated increases in space--time entanglement. Code. Available at this https URL

</details>


### [425] [Integrated Marketing Attribution: A Bayesian Framework for Privacy-Safe Granular Measurement Anchored in MMM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16878)
*Meghana R. Bhat,Ankit Umare,Utsav Aggarwal,Richard Vecsler,Arunkumar Mani,Karthik Nair,Chandhu Nair*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为"整合营销归因"（IMA）的统一框架，将营销组合建模（MMM）与渠道特定的贝叶斯归因模型相结合，在不使用用户级追踪的前提下，从聚合数据中推导出细粒度的活动级别营销效果，既保持了隐私安全性，又与MMM保持一致性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代营销测量面临"鲁棒性"与"粒度"之间的权衡：MMM虽隐私安全但粒度过粗难以支持活动级优化，MTA虽粒度精细但受隐私法规（如第三方Cookie废弃）影响可靠性下降。同时大规模增量实验在运营和成本上不可行。因此需要一种在不使用用户级数据的前提下，既能产出可执行的活动级洞察，又能与MMM保持一致的隐私安全框架。

Method: IMA框架包含三个阶段：(1) **MMM估计**——基于聚合数据建立周度渠道级模型，输出渠道级增量销售贡献及广告库存（adstock）参数；(2) **时间解聚**——利用MMM学习到的adstock参数将周度渠道贡献拆解为日度渠道贡献，保留MMM的延续效应结构；(3) **渠道特定归因建模**——对每个渠道独立拟合贝叶斯回归模型（采用PyMC的ADVI推断），目标变量为日度渠道增量贡献，自变量为活动级adstock转化后的媒体序列，并以MMM导出的渠道级系数β_c和截距α_c作为截断正态先验（lower=0），通过贝叶斯收缩缓解高维度和多重共线性。

Result: 基于三年真实营销数据验证：渠道级模型拟合R²达0.98，Search、Social、Display三类渠道的周度MAPE分别为4.1%、5.97%、3.25%（略高于MMM基准的2%）。活动级结果在统一MMM先验锚定下仍能根据数据信号产生有意义的分化，识别出低效、中等与高效活动，证明贝叶斯收缩在稳定估计的同时允许数据驱动的差异化。

Conclusion: IMA是一个可扩展、隐私安全的活动级归因框架，在保持与MMM周度渠道级强一致性的同时实现了细粒度活动级分解，验证了"无用户级追踪的细粒度归因"可行性。未来工作包括：跨渠道交互建模、滚动/序贯贝叶斯先验动态更新、整合实验数据强化因果性、采用分层贝叶斯建模引入地理级异质性。

Abstract: Retail marketing measurement increasingly requires granular campaign-level insights without relying on user-level tracking. However, the two dominant approaches, Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) and Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA), often produce fragmented insights. MMM is privacy-safe and robust for channel-level planning but is too coarse for campaign optimization, while MTA provides granular attribution but has become less reliable under increasing privacy restrictions. We propose Integrated Marketing Attribution (IMA), a unified framework that combines MMM with channel specific Bayesian attribution models to derive campaign-level effects from aggregated data. By leveraging MMM-informed priors, IMA delivers granular, privacy-safe attribution while preserving consistency with MMM.

</details>


### [426] [Fantastic Pretraining Optimizers and Where to Find Them II: Hyperball Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16899)
*Kaiyue Wen,Xingyu Dang,Kaifeng Lyu,Tengyu Ma,Percy Liang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Hyperball，一种简单即插即用的优化器包装器，通过将权重矩阵的 Frobenius 范数及其更新量范数约束为固定常数，替代传统解耦权重衰减（decoupled weight decay）的隐式范数控制机制。在 1.2B 参数的 Qwen3 架构上，Muon Hyperball 相较权重衰减基线实现 20–30% 的 token 等效加速（MuonW 仅有约 10%），并显著改善了跨模型宽度与深度的最优学习率迁移性。理论分析揭示了权重衰减本质上通过平衡随机范数增长来间接控制"角向学习率"，而 Hyperball 将此机制显式化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 矩阵型优化器（如 Muon）相对 AdamW 的加速效果随模型规模与数据量增长而显著衰减（从约 30% 降至约 10%），在更大算力场景下难以维持其增益。根本原因在于：现代 Transformer 中许多权重矩阵在损失层面具有尺度不变性，传统的解耦权重衰减在尺度不变情形下并非起到 L2 正则化作用，而是间接通过控制权重范数 R_t 来调节"角向学习率"η_ang = ‖u_t‖/R_t。这种隐式控制在规模和训练时长变化时鲁棒性差，导致矩阵优化器的相对优势被吞噬。

Method: Hyperball 是一种优化器包装器，给定任意基础优化器（Adam、Muon、KL-SOAP 等），对每个受约束的权重矩阵 W_t 执行以下更新：① 由基础优化器计算更新 u_t；② 将更新方向归一化为 û_t = u_t/‖u_t‖_F；③ 取步长 η_t·R 的无约束步；④ 通过 Frobenius 归一化将权重投影回半径为 R = ‖W_0‖_F 的超球面。即 W_{t+1} = R · Normalize(W_t − η_t·R·Normalize(u_t))。该方法在注意力与 MLP 权重矩阵上应用，嵌入、归一化增益等参数仍使用标准 Adam。方法仅需 O(N²) 投影成本。理论部分假设梯度为各向同性平稳高斯过程，推导了解耦权重衰减下权重范数与角向步长的稳态解析解（R_⋆ ∝ U·√(η/λ)），并定义矩阵符号核 κ_{p,q}(ρ) 表征 Muon 类更新的自相关结构，从而在理论上证明 Hyperball 与权重衰减控制相同的"角向学习率"量。

Result: 1) 在 1.2B Qwen3 模型 1×–8× Chinchilla 比率训练下，MuonH 维持 20–30% 的 token 等效加速，且差距随训练时长扩大；MuonW 仅约 10%。2) 在 modded-nanogpt Track 3 基准上，KL-SOAP-H 在 3125 步达到验证损失 3.2780，为该基准最快；MuonH 与 NorMuonH 同样优于其权重衰减对应版本。3) 在 Marin Ferries 8B 规模上，MuonH 较 AdamW 基线损失再降 0.04。4) 学习率迁移：跨深度 L∈[4,512] 与宽度 d∈[128,2048] 扫描下，AdamH/MuonH 最优学习率漂移仅约 1.4×，而 AdamW 为 2–4×。5) 130M 过训练数据规模扫描中，MuonH 拟合渐近损失 L∞=3.065，低于 MuonW 的 3.079。

Conclusion: Hyperball 用对矩阵范数与更新范数的显式约束取代了解耦权重衰减的隐式范数控制。它在多种优化器（Adam、Muon、NorMuon、KL-SOAP）上一致提升预训练表现与超参数迁移性，理论上有充分的尺度不变性与角向动力学解释。未来方向包括：探索谱范数约束、逐行/逐列约束、混合约束等更细粒度的设计方案，以及发展权重归一化参数化下更精确的轨迹分析理论。该工作也可视为"通过显式范数控制完全移除权重衰减"的原理验证。

Abstract: Matrix based optimizers such as Muon can substantially speed up language model pretraining, but their gains over AdamW are observed to shrink as model size and data scale grow when using standard constant decoupled weight decay. We propose Hyperball, a simple optimizer wrapper that addresses this issue. Given a base optimizer such as Adam or Muon, Hyperball sets the Frobenius norms of weight matrices and their corresponding optimizer updates to fixed constants. On Qwen3 style models up to 1.2B parameters, Muon Hyperball achieves 20--30% token equivalent speedup over weight decay baselines. Hyperball also improves learning rate transfer across widths and depths compared to decoupled weight decay. This method is motivated by prior theory showing that training with weight decay leads to an equilibrium weight norm that only depends on the training hyperparameters. Through this mechanism, the weight decay then decides the angular learning rate, i.e. how fast the direction of the weight matrix changes.

</details>


### [427] [Factorized Neural Operators Decompose Dynamic and Persistent Responses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16900)
*Hao Tang,Yuechen Duan,Jiongyu Zhu,Zimeng Feng,Hao Li,Chao Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新的神经算子架构——因子化神经算子（FaNO），通过统一的格林函数框架将物理系统的谱表征分解为等变动态响应和不变持续响应两个分支。该方法在球面、欧几里得网格和非结构几何流形上均显著提升了预测精度、参数效率及跨尺度泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有神经算子通常依赖单一的归纳偏置，将快速演化的动力学与持久的几何/边界结构耦合在共享表示中，难以有效捕捉多尺度物理系统中的异质响应机制。这种耦合导致可解释性差、自回归误差累积以及跨分辨率泛化能力弱。论文旨在通过将物理响应分解为机制特定的组件来突破这一瓶颈。

Method: 1. 提出统一可设计格林函数框架（UGF），将格林函数视为算子设计原理而非需恢复的解析核；2. 设计等变格林函数 G(T⁻¹u) 推导动态算子 S_E，捕捉变换敏感的瞬态动力学；3. 设计绝对位置依赖的格林函数 G(u) 推导持续算子 S_I，通过几何感知积分 C_f 提取稳定的持久结构；4. 在谱域中将两个分支拼接融合：g(u) = F⁻¹{Concat[F[f]·G^E_θ, C_f·G^I_θ]}·w₁；5. 在欧几里得域（傅里叶基）、球面域（球谐基）和流形域（Laplace-Beltrami 特征基）上统一实现，通道分配比例为0.5:0.5。

Result: 1. 机制特化：S_E 分支自发捕捉快速变化的瞬态动力学（高变异性），S_I 分支提取跨样本和时间的稳定持久结构（低变异性），该模式在SWE、NS和圆柱绕流中一致出现；2. SWE基准（球面浅水方程）：仅用1.61M参数（远少于SFNO的2.36M），在跨分辨率外推和长程自回归中MRE降低4倍以上；3. WeatherBench真实天气预报：2.7M参数，3天和5天预测ACC达72.9%和53.6%，优于SFNO的69.4%和49.7%；4. Navier-Stokes湍流：0.19M参数（仅为FNO的45.8%），在粘度和分辨率零样本迁移中均更优；5. 圆柱绕流：t=200步时MSE较NORM降低28.8%；6. 时无关算子（Darcy流、Helmholtz）、球面MNIST分类、RNA和人体网格分割均取得最优效果。

Conclusion: FaNO通过将物理系统的异质响应分解为动态和持续两个机制特定的分支，提供了一种超越单一归纳偏置的因子化算子设计原则。这种分解不仅改善了预测精度和参数效率，还显著增强了长程自回归稳定性、跨分辨率泛化能力以及对物理状态变化的鲁棒性。结果表明，标量化建模可受益于因子化算子表示，这为科学计算中可解释、稳健且可泛化的神经算子设计提供了新方向。未来工作可探索多物理场耦合下更丰富的格林函数构造和响应分解方式。

Abstract: Physical systems often exhibit heterogeneous mechanisms, where rapidly evolving dynamics coexist with persistent structures. Capturing such multiscale physical behavior remains challenging for existing neural operators, which typically rely on single dominant inductive bias and therefore couple distinct physical responses into a shared representation. We introduce the Unified Green's Function Framework across domains and propose the Factorized Neural Operators (FaNO), which decompose spectral representations into equivariant dynamic responses and invariant persistent responses, leading to better interpretability and generalization. Mechanistically, we show that the two operator branches spontaneously specialize into distinct physical roles that remain consistent across scales and domains: the equivariant branch captures rapidly varying transient dynamics, whereas the invariant branch extracts coherent persistent structures. This factorized mechanism of FaNO improves prediction accuracy, parameter efficiency and cross-scale generalization across physical systems and domains. In particular, it maintains consistent predictions under long-horizon autoregressive rollout, cross-resolution extrapolation and physical-regime shifts. These findings suggest that scalable physical modeling may benefit from moving beyond single-inductive-bias formulations toward factorized operator representations that better reflect the heterogeneous organization of physical systems, accelerating the reliable deployment of machine learning for scientific computing and discovery.

</details>


### [428] [Beyond the Smile: A Hybrid Convolutional VAE for Crypto Volatility Surfaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16961)
*Sadanand Singh,Allam Reddy,Manan Chopra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种用于加密货币隐含波动率曲面的卷积变分自编码器(ConvVAE)，并将其与二次微笑曲线重拟合通过确定性路由规则结合形成混合预测器。在BTC和ETH期权数据上，混合预测器在50%随机遮蔽下实现0.83波动率点的RMSE，显著优于单一参数方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 期权做市与风险管理依赖连续、规整的隐含波动率曲面，但实际链数据存在缺失、稀疏等问题。传统参数化微笑模型(如SVI、SABR)在数据密集时表现良好，但在生产环境中常见的feed中断、整条到期日下线等场景下完全失效。研究动机是开发一种能够处理结构化缺失数据、提供无套利保证、并支持跨资产迁移的鲁棒波动率曲面重建方法。

Method: 1. 数据：使用Binance Options的EOH归档，6,034个完整填充的小时级BTC和ETH曲面(2023年5-10月)，参数化到6×7(到期日×delta)网格；2. 模型：2D卷积VAE，三层3×3卷积编码器-解码器，潜在维度z=16，特征通道h=64，β-VAE损失(β=10⁻³)；3. 训练：随机遮蔽(10-50%)，Adam优化器，500轮训练；4. 混合路由：每行观测≥3个格点用参数化重拟合，否则用ConvVAE；5. 架构对比：与MLP和自注意力VAE对比；6. 评估：随机遮蔽、结构化遮蔽(整行/整列缺失、翼部缺失)、跨资产零样本迁移、联合训练、无监督异常检测。

Result: 1. 架构选择：ConvVAE在所有评估场景下均优于MLP和AttnVAE，结构化行缺失场景中相对MLP降低45%误差；2. 混合预测器：50%遮蔽下达到0.83波动率点vs.纯微笑重拟合7.00(8倍改善)，随机遮蔽下在每个mask率都Pareto占优单一组件；3. 结构化缺失：行缺失场景中微笑重拟合误差达9.6-13.1波动率点，ConvVAE仅1.5-1.9，混合器自动路由到ConvVAE；4. 无套利：ConvVAE和混合器在7个上市行权价上calendar和butterfly套利率为0%，而微笑重拟合在50%遮蔽下有38.9%(BTC)/33.1%(ETH)的butterfly套利违反；5. 跨资产：BTC单独训练在ETH上零样本达到1.82波动率点(50%遮蔽)，远优于ETH特定参数化基线(5.84)；联合训练BTC+ETH在所有市场相对最佳单符号模型再降9-27%；6. 异常检测：重建误差在未经监督情况下标记出10月ETF预期上涨和8月17日闪崩事件。

Conclusion: ConvVAE与二次微笑重拟合的确定性混合路由方案在加密货币隐含波动率曲面的随机和结构化缺失场景下均取得最低隐藏格点RMSE。混合方案在50%随机遮蔽下实现8倍于纯参数化方法的精度提升(0.83 vs. 7.00)，且消除了参数化基线在行缺失场景下的灾难性失败(误差从9.6-13.1降至1.5-1.9)。BTC和ETH的波动率曲面在观测窗口内存在显著共享的流形结构，联合训练带来9-27%的额外改善。部署的预测器在上市行权价上calendar和butterfly套利免费，无需额外推理成本，并附带有效的无监督异常检测信号。代码与基础设施已开源以支持可复现的后续研究。

Abstract: We present a convolutional variational autoencoder for cryptocurrency implied-volatility surfaces, together with a deployable predictor that combines it with a quadratic smile re-fit through a deterministic per-tenor routing rule. Trained on 6,034 fully-filled hourly Binance Options surfaces of BTC and ETH spanning May-October 2023 and parameterised on a common $6 \times 7$ tenor-delta grid, the model attains a hidden-cell surface-completion RMSE in the 0.94-1.56 vol-point range across both markets and mask rates 10-50%. The hybrid predictor attains 0.83 vol points at 50% masking against 7.00 for the smile re-fit alone, an eightfold reduction obtained at no additional inference cost. Under structurally-correlated hole patterns that emulate the withdrawal of an entire tenor of strikes, the smile re-fit incurs 9.6-13.1 vol points of error while the learned model remains at 1.5-1.9, isolating a regime in which the generative model is the only viable predictor. Joint training on BTC and ETH improves the in-distribution model on both markets by 9-27% relative to the better-performing single-symbol counterpart, indicating a substantially shared vol-surface manifold across the two largest cryptocurrencies over the observation window. The hybrid is calendar- and butterfly-arbitrage-free at the listed strikes, a property that the parametric smile re-fit alone fails at high mask rates. The per-snapshot reconstruction error of the trained model flags the late-October ETF-anticipation rally and the August $17$, $2023$ flash crash as elevated-error periods without supervision. All training and evaluation infrastructure is released to support reproducible follow-on work.

</details>


### [429] [Scalable Pairwise Kernel Learning with Stochastic Vec Trick](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16979)
*Napsu Karmitsa,Tapio Pahikkala,Antti Airola*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了SPaiK，一种基于随机广义向量技巧（sGVT）的可扩展成对核学习方法。该方法通过随机化Kronecker积核矩阵-向量乘法，将训练成本从O(nm+nq)进一步降至O(n_𝒷m+n_𝒷q)，使得成对核学习能够应用于更大规模的数据集。在七个药物-靶点亲和力数据集上的实验表明，SPaiK与现有最优方法性能相当，且在零样本学习（ODOT）场景下表现尤为突出。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 成对学习（pairwise learning）广泛存在于药物-靶点亲和力预测、推荐系统、链接预测等任务中。Kronecker积核方法因能建模对象间的非线性交互而在零样本学习等冷启动场景中表现优异。然而，全批量Kronecker积核方法（如CGKronRLS）的训练成本仍与观测对数量n直接相关，难以扩展到大规模数据。现有的可扩展核学习方法主要针对单实例核，未利用成对核的结构特性。因此需要一种既能保持核方法表达力、又能显著降低计算和内存开销的随机化方法。

Method: 核心方法包含两个组件：1）随机广义向量技巧（sGVT，算法2）：将GVT扩展到小批量设置，以目标为中心（target-wise）进行批量采样——随机选取q_𝒷个目标索引，纳入与之交互的所有药物，形成大小为n_𝒷的批次。引入辅助对偶-药物矩阵M∈ℝ^{m×q}保留历史批次信息，从而建模当前批次预测与批次外对偶变量之间的依赖关系，使每轮迭代后p_i几乎依赖于所有a_j。2）StoILMBM（算法4）：一种基于InexactLMBM非光滑优化器的随机化变体，在每个epoch中按随机顺序处理所有目标索引（确保每目标至少出现一次），对每个批次子问题调用InexactLMBM求解。SPaiK主算法（算法3）结合sGVT与StoILMBM，使用ε-不敏感平方损失和ℓ₁正则化进行训练，并通过验证集的C-index进行早停和模型选择。计算复杂度从朴素法的O(n²)经GVT的O(nm+nq)进一步降至sGVT的O(n_𝒷m+n_𝒷q)。

Result: 在Davis、Metz、KIBA、Merget（连续标签）和GPCR、Ion Channels、Enzymes（二值标签）七个基准药物-靶点亲和力数据集上，对比CGKronRLS和KronSVM两种基线方法，评估IDIT/IDOT/ODIT/ODOT四种实验设置。结果显示：1）SPaiK与现有最优方法性能竞争力相当；2）p_𝒷=20%是精度-效率的最佳平衡点（C-index平均仅下降0.003），CPU时间可降低一个数量级；3）在最具挑战性的零样本学习（ODOT）设置中，SPaiK100在多数数据集上超过CGKronRLS，SPaiK20也具有竞争力；4）epoch-wise批量选择策略在C-index和IC-index上均优于完全随机策略，尤其更好地保留了成对交互信息；5）KronSVM在GPCR和Ion Channels上比CGKronRLS慢6-10倍，在Enzymes上5小时内无法完成训练。Merget数据集是例外，所有方法性能均较低，原因在于数据集本身特性。

Conclusion: 本文提出的sGVT将Kronecker积核矩阵-向量乘法的计算复杂度从O(nm+nq)进一步降至O(n_𝒷m+n_𝒷q)，且不依赖于特定的优化器或学习方法，可作为通用模块嵌入其他核方法。SPaiK通过结合sGVT与StoILMBM，在保持核方法表达力的同时显著提升可扩展性。实验证明SPaiK在零样本学习等困难设置中表现稳健，p_𝒷≈20%是推荐的默认配置。该方法将成对核学习推广到以往难以处理的大规模问题，代码已开源。

Abstract: Pairwise learning is a specialized form of supervised learning that focuses on predicting outcomes for pairs of objects. In this work, we introduce SPaiK, a new scalable kernel learning method tailored for pairwise settings. Our approach preserves the expressive power of kernel methods while substantially reducing computational and memory requirements. The key innovation is the stochastic generalized vec trick (sGVT), a stochastic extension of the sparse Kronecker product multiplication algorithm, which enables efficient large-scale training with pairwise kernels. By incorporating sGVT, SPaiK makes it possible to apply kernel-based pairwise learning to datasets of a size previously out of reach. We evaluate the performance of SPaiK on seven real-world drug-target affinity datasets and compare the results with state-of-the-art methods in pairwise learning.

</details>


### [430] [Analytic Torsion and Spectral Gap Capture Persistent-Laplacian Performance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16990)
*Jernej Grlj,Aaron D. Lauda*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种基于持续拉普拉斯算子（Persistent Laplacian）的紧凑谱特征表示方法，通过将完整的特征谱蒸馏为三个数学上严格的不变量——Betti数、谱隙（spectral gap）和解析挠率（analytic torsion）——来解决了持续拉普拉斯算子在不同过滤尺度下谱长度变化及高维噪声问题。在MNIST、QM-3D和SKEMPI WT三个基准数据集上，该方法在保持甚至超越全谱预测性能的同时，显著降低了计算开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持续同调（persistent homology）虽能跟踪多尺度拓扑特征的生灭，但忽略了条形码不变时仍持续演化的更精细几何信息。持续拉普拉斯算子作为扩展，保留了同调信息和额外的非调和谱结构，但面临两大瓶颈：(1) 不同同调维度和过滤参数下谱长度变化（"spectral packing"问题），(2) 朴素截断高阶特征值反而降低模型精度（高阶谱的噪声问题）。因此需要一种数学上严格且固定长度的特征表示方法。

Method: 方法核心是一种"数学特征工程"策略，将持续拉普拉斯算子 Δ_{q,s} 的完整谱信息分解为三部分：(1) 调和部分——持续Betti数 dim(ker Δ_{q,s})，捕捉持续拓扑信息；(2) 谱隙 γ_q = λ_min(Δ_{q,s} |_{ker^⊥})，即最小正特征值，反映全局连通性和最低非平凡扩散尺度；(3) 解析挠率 log T = ½ Σ_q (-1)^{q+1} q · log det_0(Δ_{q,s})，通过对数伪行列式交替乘积来汇总所有非零特征值的全局几何信息。通过Rips过滤构建单纯复形，使用scikit-learn中的Random Forest（MNIST分类、QM-3D回归）和Gradient Boosting（SKEMPI WT回归）进行学习。

Result: 在三个基准数据集上均取得与基线相当或更优的性能：MNIST分类准确率86.2%（基线85.4%），QM-3D能量预测MAE为53.1（基线52.2，性能相当），SKEMPI WT结合非谱特征后MAE降至1.67、Pearson相关系数提升至0.67。训练时间大幅缩短：QM-3D从143.6s降至24.9s（约5.8倍加速），MNIST从12.6s降至3.9s（约3.2倍加速），SKEMPI WT从284.3s降至242.5s。SHAP分析和消融实验表明各组成部分均对性能有贡献，其中QM-3D任务最依赖谱隙和挠率，MNIST任务最依赖谱隙和Betti数。

Conclusion: 该工作表明，持续拉普拉斯算子丰富的非调和谱信息可以有效地浓缩为Betti数、谱隙和解析挠率这一紧凑的三元特征集，在多个领域（分子物理、蛋白质工程、计算机视觉）实现了与全谱相当甚至更优的预测性能，同时显著降低计算开销、避免高阶特征值引入的噪声。这为谱几何与拓扑学习之间提供了一个数学上透明、原理性强且固定长度的接口桥梁。局限在于解析挠率作为全局不变量会聚合掉局部几何细节；未来方向包括将方法推广到持续层拉普拉斯算子（persistent sheaf Laplacians）以及研究这些不变量在不同噪声条件下的稳定性。

Abstract: While persistent Laplacians (PL) offer a richer geometric representation of data than persistent homology, utilizing their full eigenspectrum for learning tasks is often hampered by high dimensionality and the ``varying length'' problem across different filtration scales. We propose a compact spectral representation that distills the persistent Laplacian into three mathematically grounded invariants: Betti numbers, the spectral gap, and analytic torsion. Across benchmark datasets including MNIST, QM-3D, and SKEMPI WT, we demonstrate that this reduced feature space captures the essential predictive signal of the full spectrum, and in some cases outperforms it, while significantly reducing computational overhead and preventing the noise introduced by higher-frequency eigenvalues. Our results suggest that these invariants provide a principled, fixed-length interface between spectral geometry and topological learning.

</details>


### [431] [From Tokens to Policy: Causal and Interpretable Heterogeneous Treatment Effects Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17010)
*Riccardo Cadei,Frank Otchere,Nyasha Tirivayi,Gustavo Angeles Tagliaferro,Falco J. Bargagli-Stoffi,Francesco Locatello*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出NEXIS（Neural EXposure Interaction Search），一种将异质性处理效应（HTE）识别重构为马尔可夫毯发现问题的方法，通过前向-后向迭代条件检验从学到的稀疏自编码器字典中因果地识别直接效应修饰因子，并将其部署于非洲两个反贫困项目，发现了被忽略的环境异质性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有HTE方法在表达力与可解释性之间做权衡，且当关键的异质性驱动因素未被测量时，两类方法都可能产生无因果解释力的虚假HTE刻画。在受控实验中，传统的人口统计学协变量不足以完全解释反贫困项目的影响异质性，许多关键的环境修饰因子（如水源、植被、森林覆盖）被遗漏，导致政策优化缺乏因果依据。

Method: 核心方法包括：（1）利用预训练基础模型（如Prithvi-EO、SigLIP）加稀疏自编码器（TopK SAE）学习可解释的预处理表征Z；（2）将HTE识别重构为在字典上发现CATE的马尔可夫毯问题；（3）NEXIS算法采用前向-后向迭代步骤进行条件CATE等价性检验（默认使用线性处理-交互检验+FWER Bonferroni校正），逐步添加有显著残余异质性信号的坐标并剪枝冗余坐标；（4）理论保证：在主对齐（Principal Alignment）、均值忠实性和检验有效性假设下，NEXIS以至少1-α的概率一致地恢复主代理直接效应修饰因子集合S*。

Result: NEXIS在CelebA半合成实验中验证了选择一致性和优越的精度-召回权衡（优于边际筛选基线），并展示了实验功效悖论：边际筛选随功效增加精度崩溃。应用于乌干达YOP项目，识别出"常年河流存在"、"植被空间异质性"、"结构化农业景观"等环境修饰因子；应用于加纳LEAP 1000项目，识别出"季节性水道"和"封闭冠层森林"两个环境修饰因子，使局部处理效应提升6-8倍，且无人口统计学发现。

Conclusion: 本文展示了在受控实验中利用更广泛的测量数据和更好的模型表征，因果且可解释的HTE刻画终于可实现，提出了首个端到端从原始测量到策略指导的算法。在两个非洲反贫困项目中的部署发现了先前被忽略的环境异质性证据，为项目下一轮迭代提供了具体指导。方法依赖于测量充分性、表征对齐和统计检验有效性等假设，这些假设需谨慎对待和实验验证，不可盲目信任。

Abstract: Heterogeneous Treatment Effect (HTE) identification is crucial to explain the impact of an intervention and optimize our policies accordingly. Existing approaches trade expressivity for interpretability, but, if some active heterogeneity drivers are unmeasured, methods at both ends of this spectrum allow for spurious HTE characterization with no causal reading. In this work, we focus on controlled experiments and argue that an oracle HTE causal characterization via the latent interactors is now within reach, thanks to (i) more extensive pre-treatment measurements, i.e., multi-modal and multi-view, and (ii) scalable representations with minimal human supervision. We then re-frame HTE identification as a Markov-blanket discovery problem on a sufficient and aligned pre-treatment representation, and introduce Neural EXposure Interaction Search (NEXIS), an iterative procedure with provable and empirically validated consistent selection. We deploy NEXIS on two anti-poverty programs in Africa, augmenting each with satellite imagery capturing previously unmeasured environmental effect modifiers, leading to novel, interpretable and prescriptive guidelines to optimize the programs' next iterations.

</details>


### [432] [Filtered Conformal Ellipsoids for Graph-Native Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17014)
*Yannick Limmer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出"过滤共形椭球体"（Filtered Conformal Ellipsoids）框架,将冻结的图状态空间滤波器与分割共形校准相结合,为多变量时间序列生成联合预测区域。核心创新是解耦椭球的"形状"（由学习到的预测协方差提供）与"覆盖半径"（由共形分位数标定），并在可观测预测律商空间而非原始循环隐藏状态上分析稳定性。理论证明在稳定贝叶斯高斯投影滤波、有限水平可观测性/Fisher条件下,小的高斯NLL超额风险可传递到发出预测律的收缩性。实验在图原生交通基准（METR-LA-20、PEMS-BAY-50）上验证了所学滤波器比静态协方差和非滤波基线生成更尖锐的椭球体,但在全图规模和非图原生数据集上,因子和Copula基线可能更强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部署式多元传感器流预测需要联合预测区域而非N个独立的边缘区间——边缘共形区间的笛卡尔积会因忽略跨传感器依赖性而漏掉目标联合事件。此外,标准分割共形预测的可交换性假设在时序数据中被破坏,且学习的循环滤波器不一定在原始隐藏状态范数下收缩。该研究旨在填补此空白：如何在依赖性时序数据上构建具有理论保证且利用学习协方差的联合共形椭球预测集。

Method: 方法层面包含三个核心组件：（1）冻结滤波器ϕ发射一步预测高斯𝒩(Ŷ_{t|t-1}, Σ̂_{t|t-1}),用平方马氏距离R_t = r_t⊤Σ̂_{t|t-1}^{-1}r_t作为共形分数；（2）分割共形校准在时序校准块上收集分数,经验(1-α)分位数提供标量半径；（3）实例化使用GCN-GRU滤波器,协方差头为对角加低秩Σ̂ = diag(d_t) + L_t L_t⊤,秩r=4。理论层面,在可观测预测律商空间𝒬（识别产生相同未来发出律的隐藏状态）上分析收敛性,提出核心定理3（NLL超额→发出律Bures-Wasserstein收缩）、定理6（依赖分数下过滤分割共形覆盖的Chebyshev和Bernstein形式）、定理8（高斯oracle实现下近oracle对数体积比较）。

Result: 实验在10个真实数据评估单元上进行。在中等规模图原生交通（METR-LA-20和PEMS-BAY-50）上,所提出的gnf方法获得最佳目标覆盖率下的最尖锐椭球：宽度分别为3.05和1.98,比Static-CGIF分别窄23.6%和40.5%,比最强非滤波目标方法窄8.4%和13.9%。对数体积指标𝒱̂_m在两个数据集上比Static-CGIF分别改善0.27和0.51 nats/坐标。但在全图规模（N=207, 325）上,领导地位取决于均值骨干：图感知骨干下因子基线领先,图无关骨干下gnf+ACI保持8.6-9.0范围。CopulaCPTS在非图原生数据集（solar/loop-sea/ett）上领先。诊断审计验证了理论假设的可操作性:ρ̂_{d_𝒢} ≈ 0.46, ρ̂_Γ ≈ 0.85, τ_int ∈ [10,13]。

Conclusion: 核心结论是共形椭球体在图携带有用空间信息且维度中等的条件下,从学习的条件协方差形状中受益。在此范围内,滤波器协方差头相对于静态协方差、简单条件Σ_t更新和已发布联合CP基线减少了共形半径/形状不匹配。但理论保证是有条件的（依赖稳定oracle、协方差有界、有限水平Fisher可识别性以及分数依赖控制）,而非对任意训练循环滤波器的分布无关定理。线性卡尔曼基线在真实交通数据上存在协方差形状误设问题,宽度可达CGIF的3.37倍。在大图规模下,当均值预测器已吸收图结构时,秩高效因子基线可能更优。论文明确声明学到的滤波器并不普适优于联合共形预测,而是为图原生中等维度流提供了一种有用的、可审计的提供时变椭球形状的方法。

Abstract: Joint prediction sets for multivariate time series should control a single event while adapting to cross-coordinate dependence. We study filtered conformal ellipsoids: a frozen state-space filter emits a one-step predictive mean and covariance, and split-conformal calibration is applied to the resulting Mahalanobis scores. The filter is used to choose the ellipsoid shape; conformal calibration chooses the scalar radius, so the construction benefits from a learned predictive covariance without relying on Gaussian tail probabilities for coverage. The main difficulty is that filtered scores are dependent and learned recurrent filters need not contract in their raw hidden state; we therefore analyse contraction in an observable predictive-law quotient that identifies hidden states producing the same future sequence of emitted Gaussian laws. Under a stable Bayes Gaussian-projection filter, covariance bounds, and a finite-horizon observability Fisher condition, small excess Gaussian negative log-likelihood implies contraction of the learned emitted laws. Combined with a threshold-autocovariance envelope this yields a Chebyshev-type approximate coverage bound for filtered split-conformal prediction under dependence; a sharper Bernstein-type bound requires an additional geometric-mixing concentration assumption. Under Gaussian oracle realisability we also obtain a near-oracle log-volume comparison within the class of conditionally valid Gaussian ellipsoid rules. We instantiate the framework with a GCN-GRU filter with diagonal-plus-low-rank covariance. On moderate-size graph-native traffic benchmarks (METRLA-$20$ and PEMSBAY-$50$), the learned filter gives sharper at-target ellipsoids than static-covariance and non-filter baselines; at full-graph scale and on non-graph-native datasets, factor and copula baselines can be stronger.

</details>


### [433] [ExpRL: Exploratory RL for LLM Mid-Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17024)
*Violet Xiang,Amrith Setlur,Chase Blagden,Nick Haber,Aviral Kumar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ExpRL 是一种用于 LLM 中训练（mid-training）的探索式强化学习方法。它不再将参考答案作为模仿目标，而是将其作为"奖励支架"——利用 LLM 裁判基于参考答案对模型在线采样的推理轨迹进行评分，从而为部分正确的中间进展分配稠密奖励。实验证明 ExpRL 比 SFT、稀疏奖励 GRPO 和自蒸馏等基线能更有效地为下游稀疏奖励 RL 提供更好的初始化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏奖励 RL 在提升 LLM 推理能力时高度依赖基础模型的覆盖率（coverage）。现有方法通常通过 SFT 在人工策划的推理轨迹上进行中训练来"打底"，但该方法需要人工指定模型应学习什么，且不清楚这些原始技能是否足以解决需要组合多种技能的困难问题。因此需要一种更自动化的中训练方法，在不需要人类手动指定技能的前提下，扩展模型对有效推理路径的覆盖范围。

Method: ExpRL 利用大规模人写问答数据集进行基于 RL 的中训练。具体设计包括：(1) 将参考答案隐藏于策略之外，仅用于构建针对具体题目的评分量表；(2) 策略仅从原始题目提示采样，由 LLM 裁判比较采样轨迹与参考答案，给出 1-5 分的稠密分数并归一化到 [0,1]；(3) 提出两种变体——ExpRL-Outcome 对完整轨迹分配稠密结果级奖励，ExpRL-Process 对中间前缀序列分配稠密过程级奖励；(4) 过程级优势采用相邻前缀差分进行中心化（DeltaNorm），强调相对进展而非绝对分数；(5) 使用 GRPO 或 REINFORCE 进行策略优化，添加 KL 正则化约束。裁判被明确指示"验证而非求解"，不补全缺失步骤或纠正错误。

Result: (1) 在 AIME25/26、HMMT、IMO-AnswerBench 四个数学基准上，ExpRL（尤其是 ExpRL-Process）经过 Stage-II 稀疏奖励 RL 训练后，在 pass@1 上全面超越 SFT、GRPO 和自蒸馏基线，AIME26 上达到 63.41% 显著高于 GRPO 的 58.75%；(2) Stage-I 阶段 ExpRL 即在 pass@1 和 pass@16 上优于基线，证明其已形成更好的 RL 就绪初始化；(3) 训练动态分析显示 ExpRL 保持较高 token 级熵，过程奖励下更快解锁可解题目；(4) 行为分析表明 ExpRL 增加了验证、自我修正、回溯等搜索导向行为；(5) 8B 策略 + 4B 裁判的混合领域实验显示 ExpRL-Outcome 在数学和 STEM 聚合上达到最强，但代码领域例外；(6) 校准实验证实裁判需要正确且问题匹配的参考答案（≥4B 规模）才能提供可靠奖励信号。

Conclusion: ExpRL 通过在线 RL 配合参考答案引导的稠密奖励来构建推理路径覆盖度，为下游稀疏奖励 RL 提供更强的初始化。核心贡献在于将参考答案从模仿目标转化为验证支架，利用 LLM 的验证-生成差距提供丰富反馈。局限在于依赖参考答案等辅助信息，对裁判能力有最低要求（≥4B），且在代码等参考支架较弱的领域效果有限。未来可探索利用裁判的自然语言反馈、与前缀条件生成的结合，以及奖励校准与长度归一化的系统研究。

Abstract: Sparse reward reinforcement learning (RL) has become a standard tool for improving LLM reasoning, but its success depends critically on the coverage present in the base model. In practice, models are often primed for RL through \emph{mid-training} on curated reasoning traces that teach useful primitive skills such as decomposition, verification, or self-correction. Although effective, this strategy requires manually specifying what the model should learn, and it remains unclear whether such primitive coverage is enough for much harder problems, which require combining these skills into broader solution strategies. We study a more automated approach: \emph{RL-based mid-training} using large corpora of human-written question-answer data. Rather than treating reference solutions as targets to imitate, our method, ExpRL, uses them as \emph{reward scaffolds}: references are hidden from the policy and used only to construct problem-specific grading rubrics for judging on-policy reasoning traces. The policy samples from the original problem prompt, while an LLM judge compares the sampled reasoning trace against the reference solution and assigns outcome-level or process-level dense rewards. This lets ExpRL reinforce partial progress, useful intermediate reductions, and productive reasoning behaviors that sparse final-answer rewards often fail to upweight. On challenging math reasoning tasks, ExpRL yields stronger RL priming than SFT, sparse-reward GRPO, and self-distillation, and provides a better initialization for subsequent sparse-reward RL. Additional mixed-domain experiments further suggest that ExpRL can extend beyond the original math-only setting.

</details>


### [434] [Your Privacy My Cloak: Backdoor Attacks on Differentially Private Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.17035)
*Xiaolin Li,Ning Wang,Ninghui Li,Wenhai Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文挑战了差分隐私(DP)天然增强联邦学习(FL)抵御后门攻击鲁棒性的假设，提出RING攻击——首个在差分隐私联邦学习(DP-FL)中同时实现高攻击成功率和规避现有SOTA防御的后门攻击，通过受秘密共享启发的协同扰动机制，在四个图像和文本数据集上对六种先进防御实现了90.3%的平均攻击成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 先前研究普遍认为DP噪声为联邦学习提供经验性和可认证的后门攻击鲁棒性。然而，作者揭示了DP-FL中的根本性矛盾：避开DP可使SOTA防御检测并过滤恶意更新（牺牲隐私合规），而遵守DP则意外掩盖了中毒更新的统计特征，使防御失效。这种"隐身性"与"有效性"的张力促使作者探索：攻击者能否在DP-FL中同时实现高攻击成功率与规避防御？该问题对日益普及的隐私保护AI系统具有重要安全意义。

Method: 1. 威胁调查：对两种基线攻击（DP-opt-in遵守DP协议、DP-opt-out绕过DP）进行系统实证分析，评估其针对六种SOTA防御（DeepSight、Krum、Flame、MESAS、FreqFed、FLShield）的可检测性。2. RING攻击设计：受秘密共享启发，将m个恶意客户端划分为g个不相交子组，每个客户端j采样独立噪声z_j并计算扰动ζ_j = z_j - (1/m_l)Σz_k，确保组内扰动在聚合时精确抵消。3. 双目标优化：在保持每个恶意更新与DP扰动良性更新统计相似的同时，通过聚合重建强大的后门信号。4. 理论分析：证明扰动ζ_j ~ N(0, (m_l-1)/m_l · σ²I_d)；分析部分聚合下残差噪声的期望平方范数；证明RING残差噪声始终小于DP-opt-in。5. 广泛实验评估：在MNIST、CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、Sentiment-140四个数据集上，跨概率型、Dirichlet型、数量型三种非IID分布，系统评估攻击性能和潜在缓解措施。

Result: RING在适度隐私预算(ε=5)下对六种SOTA防御实现了90.3%±13.8%的平均攻击成功率（ASR），较基线策略提升高达26.08倍（DP-opt-in: 57.5%±39.3%，DP-opt-out: 51.9%±46.6%）。关键发现：(1) RING在聚合时成功恢复后门信号，效果与无防御DP-opt-out相当；(2) 现有防御均无法选择性识别RING的恶意更新，部分防御（如Krum、Flame、FreqFed）甚至保留更多恶意更新而非良性更新；(3) RING对不同后门技术（VBA、DBA、Neurotoxin）均有效；(4) 攻击在隐私预算ε、裁剪界C、数据分布（IID/非IID）变化下保持稳健；(5) 评估的缓解措施（随机丢弃、限时提交、服务端DP扰动）均导致显著的效用损失（如服务端DP使准确率从88.24%降至11.18%）。

Conclusion: 本文揭示了DP-FL中安全、隐私与效用之间的根本性矛盾：DP噪声可被攻击者武器化以掩盖恶意行为而非抑制后门。RING攻击暴露了当前防御体系在面对协调自适应攻击者时的根本性安全漏洞。服务商若因威胁而削弱或放弃DP，将牺牲其设计的隐私保障，这凸显了亟需开发能协同保护安全性与隐私性的原则性防御机制。该研究对差分隐私联邦学习系统的实际部署具有重要警示意义。

Abstract: Prior research suggests that differential privacy (DP) inherently enhances the robustness of federated learning (FL) against backdoor attacks. In this paper, we challenge this assumption. Through an empirical analysis of two baseline attack strategies, we uncover a fundamental tension in DP-FL: while bypassing DP allows state-of-the-art defenses to detect and filter malicious updates, complying with DP inadvertently masks their distinguishing statistical characteristics. Consequently, existing defenses become ineffective as DP reduces the raw backdoor signal. Building on this masking effect, we propose RING, a novel attack that explicitly exploits DP to conceal malicious contributions while maximizing attack impact. By collaboratively crafting adversarial perturbations, compromised clients reconstruct a strong backdoor signal during aggregation without triggering anomaly detection. RING operates as a perturbation layer that is agnostic to the underlying backdoor technique, making it broadly applicable and composable with existing attacks -- a property that significantly amplifies the threat it poses to DP-FL. Extensive evaluations across four image and text datasets under non-iid distributions show that RING achieves an average attack success rate of 90.3% against six state-of-the-art defenses under a moderate privacy budget, an improvement of up to 26.08x over baseline strategies.
