Result: 在14个基准测试上，4B的RoboPIN全面超越7B开源具身模型，相对于最强7B基线Mimo-Embodied实现12%平均提升。在EmbSpatial(83.1)、SAT(78.0)、RoboSpatial(66.6)、CrossPoint(72.2)、RefSpatial(50.5)、RoboRefit(89.0)、RoboAfford(72.8)等任务上取得开源最佳。消融实验表明：(1) PinCoT + RFT在EmbSpatial上达84.7，优于Coord CoT+ID的81.5；(2) 移除Pin奖励下降2.7分，大于移除一致性奖励的2.0分；(3) 推理过程分析显示RFT使跨步骤ID覆盖从18.8%飙升至99.9%，跨视角ID迁移率从60.6%提升至86.3%；(4) 错误锚点的答案错误率是正确锚点的2.2倍；(5) 真实xArm机器人零样本任务中，空间推理5/5、多视角4/5，远超Mimo-Embodied的2/5和0/5。

Conclusion: PinCoT通过结构化推理锚点将推理过程显式锚定到视觉证据，为具身VLM提供了一条可扩展且有效的空间推理增强路径。过程监督（特别是RFT中的Pin奖励和一致性奖励）是维持跨步骤和跨视角实体追踪一致性的关键驱动因素。局限性：当前验证仅在4B参数规模，未来计划扩展至3D空间定位、长视野规划以及更大模型与数据规模。

Abstract: Embodied reasoning requires models to perceive task-relevant objects and spaces in physical environments and maintain consistent visual grounding throughout multi-step reasoning. However, current vision-language models rely on text-only or coordinate-augmented chain-of-thought, where entity references remain implicit and ambiguous. This may cause the reasoning process to decouple from visual evidence, entity references to drift across steps, and a causal disconnection between the reasoning trajectory and the final answer, with these problems further amplified in multi-view scenarios due to cross-view appearance changes. To address these issues, we propose Pinned Chain-of-Thought (\pincot{}), a structured reasoning paradigm that pins every reasoning step to visual evidence. \pincot{} introduces the concept of \reasoninganchor{}, which binds each task-relevant entity to a structured visual anchor with entity name, unique identity, view index, and spatial grounding, enabling consistent entity tracking across reasoning steps and views. We build a fully automated data generation pipeline to construct \dataset{}, a high-quality \pincot{}-formatted reasoning dataset. We then train \method{} through three-stage post-training that progressively injects embodied knowledge, structured reasoning ability, and process-supervised alignment, with rewards that directly constrain both anchor localization and identity consistency during reasoning. On 14 benchmarks covering embodied spatial reasoning, multi-view reasoning, and pointing, \method{} with only 4B parameters consistently outperforms 7B level open-source embodied models, achieving a 12\% average improvement over the strongest 7B baseline, Mimo-Embodied. Further analysis shows that \pincot{} improves grounding accuracy and cross-step identity consistency, validating the effectiveness of process supervision.

</details>


### [488] [Rethinking Scaffolding in LLM Tutors: The Interactional Mismatch Between Benchmarks and Real-World Deployments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15766)
*Alexandra Neagu,Jeffrey T. H. Wong,Marcus Messer,Rhodri Nelson,Peter B. Johnson*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文揭示了当前AI导师（LLM Tutor）评估基准中关于"脚手架教学"（scaffolding）的隐含假设——学生会主动接受并参与脚手架式对话——在实际部署中并不成立。作者通过在9个数据集（含4个AI导师基准和5个真实部署）上对比"聊天机器人脚手架程度"和"学生接受度"两个指标，发现真实场景中学生常绕过脚手架、主导对话方向，指出这是教学框架与学生学习目标之间的"错配"，呼吁未来基准应纳入学生行为与学习情境。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有AI导师的对齐与评估方法仅关注聊天机器人一方的教学行为质量，并隐含假设学生会像传统课堂中一样接受并参与脚手架式对话。然而，LLM开放式聊天界面允许学生几乎无社交成本地绕过脚手架、按自身目标驱动交互。因此，需要实证检验该假设在真实部署中是否成立，并揭示当前评估范式的结构性缺陷。

Method: 作者提出两维度评估管线：(1) Chatbot Scaffolding（1–5分）——基于MathDial、MathTutorBench、EduBench、LearnLM四个基准共识，衡量聊天机器人是否提供引导式教学（不直接给答案、针对性提问、最小化提示等5个信号）；(2) Student Uptake（−1到+1的有符号标度）——衡量学生是否接受聊天机器人的框架还是自我主导对话方向。使用GPT-5-mini作为逐轮评分器，对9,490条对话、9个数据集进行打分，并通过人类标注验证（Chatbot Scaffolding准确率93.8%；Student Uptake与人类标注78.9%一致，Gwet's AC1=0.580）。采用PERMANOVA和PERMDISP检验类别间差异，用Spearman相关分析两指标关系。

Result: 核心发现：(1) 基准数据集集中在"高脚手架+高接受度"象限，而真实部署（无论有无显式脚手架设计）则广泛分布于该象限之外的区域，且PERMANOVA/PERMDISP检验显示三组数据集（基准/有脚手架/无脚手架）存在统计显著的差异（p<0.0001）；(2) 在真实部署中学生接受度普遍偏低（RECIPE4U: 0.36, StemChat: 0.30, StudyChat: −0.02, MathsChat: −0.07），而基准中普遍较高（MathDial: 0.75, QATD₂k: 0.76）；(3) 聊天机器人脚手架程度与学生接受度之间的Spearman相关在基准中几乎为零（缺乏方差），在真实部署中虽有统计显著性但效应微弱且不一致，说明更多脚手架并不必然带来更高接受度；(4) 真实场景中学生常以低社交成本绕过脚手架（如直接索要答案），反映教学框架与学生学习情境（目标、先验知识、已投入精力、任务紧迫度等）之间的错配。

Conclusion: 绕过脚手架不一定有害学习，反而常揭示聊天机器人教学框架与学生学习目标之间的错配，可能反映学生的工具性或执行性求助行为（instrumental/executive help-seeking），受学生目标取向（掌握型vs.回避型）影响。文章建议：(1) 未来评估基准应纳入学生行为侧（不仅聊天机器人侧），并设计包含低接受度、学生主导交互模式的多样化场景；(2) 应将学习情境（如先验尝试、投入时间、知识追踪状态）作为输入与评估依据；(3) 聊天机器人需具备在低接受度情境下动态调整教学策略的能力。该研究推动AI导师设计从假设"学生会合作"走向适应多元学习情境与学生驱动交互模式。

Abstract: A central pedagogical value evaluated in AI tutor benchmarks is scaffolding: guiding students through graduated steps toward a solution. Alignment and evaluation methods for embedding scaffolding behaviour into chatbots, however, rest on an implicit assumption: that students will take up the scaffolding and engage in the conversation. To examine whether this assumption holds, we introduce an evaluation pipeline around two metrics - Chatbot Scaffolding and Student Uptake - and apply them across nine datasets of 9,490 chats, spanning AI tutor benchmarks and real-world deployments of educational chatbots. Our analysis reveals that while benchmarks assume a high-scaffolding, high-student-uptake environment, students in real-world settings exhibit lower levels of uptake overall - frequently bypassing the chatbot's pedagogical framing to drive the interaction toward their own learning goals at little interpersonal cost. We argue that bypassing scaffolding is not necessarily detrimental; rather, it frequently highlights a mismatch between a chatbot's pedagogical framing and the student's learning goals. To meaningfully evaluate the effectiveness of a chatbot's assistance, future benchmarks must move beyond the assumption that students will simply take up the scaffolding, and instead evaluate how these chatbots navigate diverse learning contexts and student-driven interaction patterns.

</details>


### [489] [Mitigating Visual Hallucinations in Multimodal Systems through Retrieval-Augmented Reliability-Aware Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15782)
*Pratheswaran Hariharan,Haiping Xu,Donghui Yan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的检索增强可靠性感知推理框架，通过外部视觉证据库与多信号可靠性估计来减少过度自信的视觉幻觉错误，而无需重新训练底层模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MLLM常以高置信度生成缺乏视觉支撑的响应（视觉幻觉），尤其在视觉证据弱、模糊或语义不一致时。现有方法多关注表征对齐或检索增强生成，缺乏对单实例预测可靠性的量化机制以及识别"自信但错误"视觉输出的能力，导致系统被迫对所有输入给出答案。

Method: 1) 使用预训练ResNet-50提取2048维视觉嵌入并L2归一化，构建约13万张ImageNet-100训练图像的外部证据库；2) 基于FAISS进行top-k(k=5)最近邻检索；3) 通过softmax加权(α=20)聚合类支持得分得到预测类；4) 计算五类可靠性信号——相似度强度(s_top, s_mean)、类支持一致性(E1, E2)、证据裕度(M)、熵不确定性(H)及聚合可靠性分(R=0.6E1+0.4Q)；5) 阈值(τ_sim=0.8416, τ_mean=0.8285)结合R、H、M触发三态决策门——ACCEPT(高置信)、ANSWER WITH CAUTION(中等证据)、ABSTAIN/FALLBACK(证据不足)；6) LLaVA根据决策状态生成受控的最终响应。

Result: 在ImageNet-100验证集(5000张)上：接受预测准确率从85.84%提升至88.88%(覆盖率89.04%，弃答率10.96%)；类幻觉式接受错误率从14.16%降至11.12%(绝对降低3.04个百分点，相对降低21.48%)；ECE从7.40%降至5.87%；高置信错误数从263降至226。证据质量分析显示接受样本的平均可靠性分0.9560、裕度0.8666、熵0.1563，均显著优于弃答样本(0.8137/0.5380/0.6308)，验证了门控机制确实拒绝了真正不可靠的样本。定性案例(鲨鱼接受、鸟类/模糊汽车/飞机弃答)进一步验证了框架在强证据、类歧义、低质量和分布外场景下的合理行为。

Conclusion: 该框架将"预测生成"与"预测接受"解耦，作为一种即插即用的后处理可靠性层，无需重训视觉编码器或MLLM，通过检索证据、不确定性估计与选择性决策控制的结合，有效降低了自信但错误的视觉输出，提升了校准度。局限包括：仅在ImageNet-100受控场景评估、依赖证据库覆盖范围、可靠性权重为手工设计、ResNet-50表征能力有限、生成层可控性需加强。未来工作将拓展至开放词汇数据集、更强视觉语言编码器(如CLIP/SigLIP)及学习式可靠性校准方法。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in vision-language understanding and natural-language response generation. However, these systems can still produce overconfident predictions and hallucination-like outputs, particularly when the visual evidence is weak, ambiguous, or semantically inconsistent. Most existing approaches focus on improving multimodal representation alignment or retrieval-augmented generation, while providing limited mechanisms to quantify instance-level prediction reliability or identify incorrect visual outputs. This work proposes a retrieval-augmented reliability-aware inference framework for trustworthy multimodal visual understanding. The proposed framework constructs an external visual evidence database using pretrained visual embeddings and nearest-neighbor retrieval over normalized feature representations. Retrieved evidence is used to estimate prediction trustworthiness through multiple reliability indicators, including similarity strength, class-support agreement, evidence margin, entropy-based uncertainty, and an aggregate reliability score. Based on these signals, a decision gate determines whether the system should accept the prediction, answer with caution, or abstain/fallback when evidence is insufficient. A multimodal response-generation layer then produces a final user-facing response conditioned on the reliability decision. Experiments on ImageNet-100 demonstrate that the proposed reliability-aware framework improves accepted prediction accuracy from 85.84\% to 88.88\% at 89.04\% coverage. The hallucination-like accepted wrong-answer rate is reduced from 14.16\% to 11.12\%. These results show that integrating retrieval evidence, reliability estimation, and selective decision gating can improve calibration and reduce overconfident visual errors without retraining large multimodal models.

</details>


### [490] [Unassigned Agents in Compilation-based Multi-agent Path Finding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15797)
*Pavel Surynek*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对多智能体路径规划（MAPF）的扩展变体——含未分配智能体的MAPF（UA-MAPF），将两种基于编译的SAT求解器SMT-CBS和NRF-SAT适配到该变体上，并通过实验揭示了未分配智能体数量对求解性能的反直觉影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准MAPF要求所有智能体从起点到达指定终点，而实际场景（如自动停车场、自动化仓库）中存在大量无目标但需为其他智能体让路的"未分配"智能体（UA-MAPF）。该变体要求未分配智能体必要时必须移开但无需到达目标，对编译式求解器的模块化和可扩展性提出了新挑战。现有搜索式和编译式求解器对UA-MAPF的支持有限，需探索基于SAT的编译方法如何适配该变体。

Method: 核心方法为将标准MAPF的编译技术（TEG和MDD）扩展到UA-MAPF，提出UA-MDD（Unassigned Agent MDD）。由于未分配智能体无目标节点，MDD中基于"可达目标顶点"的剪枝条件不再适用，仅保留基于起始顶点的距离约束，导致UA-MDD结构更大。论文在MDD基础上引入布尔变量、边变量及增量式makespan/FUEL+上界搜索机制，并将该编码分别嵌入SMT-CBS（基于CEGAR的惰性编码）和NRF-SAT（采用非精化抽象的CEGAR求解器）框架中。

Result: 在movingai.com基准的四种地图（empty-16-16、random-32-32-20、room-64-64-16、ost003d）上进行的实验揭示了反直觉的趋势：在大型地图中，初始增加未分配智能体数量反而使UA-MAPF对两个求解器都更困难，因为较大的UA-MDD增加了公式规模，超过了"问题松弛"带来的收益；只有当未分配智能体占多数时，松弛效应才占优势。在小型empty-16-16地图上，松弛效应从一开始就占优，说明UA-MDD膨胀效应可忽略。NRF-SAT因非精化抽象机制整体效率较高，受UA-MDD膨胀的影响相对SMT-CBS较小。

Conclusion: 论文成功将SMT-CBS和NRF-SAT两种SAT-based编译求解器适配到UA-MAPF，仅需将MDD生成模块替换为UA-MDD，充分展示了SAT-based编译方法的模块化与可扩展性。实验同时发现一个反直觉的洞见：未分配智能体数量的增加在大规模地图中初期会令问题更难（因UA-MDD膨胀），仅在未分配智能体占多数时松弛效应才显现。未来工作拟将该方法推广到连续空间MAPF变体。

Abstract: Compilation-based techniques represent an important stream of solvers for multi-agent path finding (MAPF) due to their modularity and adaptability for non-standard variants of the problem. While in the standard MAPF the task is to navigate all agents from their initial positions to given individual goal positions without any collision, variants where a different requirement for agents is used are also relevant. Such a variant is MAPF with unassigned agents (UA-MAPF) where some agents have the same setting as in the standard MAPF with initial positions and goals while the remaining agents have the initial position but have no goal - unassigned agents. Despite unassigned agent do not need to reach any goal position they have to be moved out of the way of the standard agents if needed which represent a specific challenge. We show in this paper that UA-MAPF can be expressed in recent compilation-based techniques for MAPF based on formulating the problem as Boolean satisfiability, namely we adapt SMT-CBS and NRF-SAT, the recent solvers based on counterexample guided abstraction refinement and non-refined abstractions.

</details>


### [491] [TrustedARI: Towards Trust-Native Agentic Routing Infrastructure for Agentic AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15822)
*Qi Li,Zhenhua Zou,Shuo Li,Mingwei Xu,Zhuotao Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: TrustedARI是首个面向智能体AI的可信路由基础设施，通过ARI适配的三方TLS握手、隐私保护查询构造协议和可验证计费协议三大核心创新，解决了Agentic Routing Infrastructure(ARI)在代理查询和响应明文访问、服务提供商认证缺失以及请求/响应易被篡改等方面的信任问题，且无需修改服务提供商即可部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着AI智能体广泛通过Agentic Routing Infrastructure (ARI)访问外部模型、工具和服务，ARI架构引入了根本性的信任风险：ARI能够以明文形式访问智能体查询和服务响应，且智能体无法验证其查询是否被路由到预期的服务提供商，也无法保证请求和响应未被篡改。现有ARI缺乏端到端的可验证性和隐私保护机制。

Method: TrustedARI基于三大核心创新构建：
1. **ARI适配的三方TLS握手协议**：通过角色特定的TLS密钥材料分发，使智能体和ARI能够联合认证服务提供商；
2. **隐私保护查询构造协议**：允许智能体和ARI在不暴露各自私有输入的情况下协作构造格式良好的查询；
3. **可验证计费协议**：支持公平的基于用量的结算，同时保持服务响应的完整性和机密性。

Result: 原型实现与全面评估验证了TrustedARI的高效性：
- ARI适配的握手协议相比现有三方TLS握手减少39.34%的通信开销；
- 隐私保护查询构造协议开销可忽略不计——平均计算时间0.19秒，通信成本0.58 MB；
- 可验证计费协议的证明生成速度提升28.20倍；
- 关键优势是无需修改服务提供商即可部署。

Conclusion: TrustedARI是首个面向智能体AI的"信任原生"路由基础设施，通过三大密码学/协议创新有效解决了ARI的信任漏洞，在效率、隐私和可验证性方面均表现优异，且具备良好的实际部署可行性，对推动安全可靠的智能体生态系统具有重要意义。

Abstract: AI agents increasingly access external models, tools, and services through Agentic Routing Infrastructure (ARI) to manage the overhead of heterogeneous interfaces and fragmented subscriptions. Yet, the architecture of ARI introduces fundamental trust risks: it obtains plaintext access to agent queries and service responses, while leaving agents unable to verify that their queries are routed to intended service providers or that requests and responses remain untampered. To address this problem, we present TrustedARI, the first trust-native agentic routing infrastructure for agentic AI. Architecturally, TrustedARI is built upon three core innovations: (i) an ARI-adapted three-party TLS handshake that enables the agent and ARI to jointly authenticate the service provider through role-specific distribution of TLS key materials; (ii) a privacy-preserving query-construction protocol that allows the agent and ARI to collaboratively construct well-formed queries without exposing their respective private inputs; and (iii) a verifiable billing protocol that supports fair usage-based settlement while preserving the integrity and confidentiality of service responses. We implemented and extensively evaluated a prototype of TrustedARI to validate its performance. Experiments confirm that TrustedARI is highly efficient: our ARI-adapted handshake protocol reduces communication overhead by 39.34% compared to the existing three-party TLS handshake. Furthermore, the privacy-preserving query-construction protocol imposes negligible overhead-averaging 0.19 seconds in computation time and 0.58 MB in communication costs-while the verifiable billing protocol speeds up proof generation by 28.20x. Crucially, TrustedARI is readily deployable without any modification to the service providers.

</details>


### [492] [An Integrated System for Real-Time Student Assessment and Career Guidance Using Neural Networks in Computing Disciplines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15831)
*Sakir Hossain Faruque,Md. Jubair Hossain,Sharun Akter Khushbu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种AI驱动的学生评估与职业预测系统，将职业指导专家（CGE）系统与基于Web的学生评估（WBSA）平台相结合，利用多层感知器（MLP）模型为计算机科学和软件工程专业的本科生提供个性化职业路径推荐，验证准确率达到94.71%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计算机科学和软件工程专业的本科生在选择职业道路时面临困难，尤其是在学业成绩、能力与兴趣不完全匹配的情况下，缺乏个性化的职业指导支持。此外，学生与教师之间的互动和毕业生离校后的持续指导也存在不足。

Method: 1. 设计并实现了一个集成框架，将基于AI的CGE系统与WBSA平台相结合。2. CGE系统采用多层感知器（MLP）模型，使用通过雪球抽样法从大学生中收集的真实学业和课外数据进行训练。3. WBSA平台作为现代化Web应用开发，整合评估、个性化任务、导师指导和安全的实时聊天功能。4. 技术栈采用ASP.NET、相关Web技术及PostgreSQL数据库，部署在安全的云基础设施上。5. 在部署前后分别进行预调查和后调查，收集学生和教师的反馈。

Result: CGE系统中的MLP模型在预测个性化职业路径方面达到了94.71%的验证准确率；预调查验证了模型在部署前的可行性；WBSA平台通过后调查获得学生和教师的反馈，证明系统在交互性、可用性和职业推荐效果方面具有积极表现。

Conclusion: 该研究证明了将AI驱动的职业预测与Web评估平台相集成的可行性，能够有效帮助学生识别与自身技能和兴趣匹配的职业方向、研究生领域及继续深造机会。系统在可扩展性、响应性和数据安全方面表现良好，为IT行业毕业生的职业选择提供了可靠支持。未来可通过持续收集用户反馈来进一步优化系统有效性和可用性。

Abstract: Many undergraduate students in Computer Science (CS) and Software Engineering (SWE) struggle to identify suitable career paths, particularly when their academic performance, abilities, and interests do not fully align. To address this issue, this study proposes an AI-driven Student Assessment and Career Prediction System that integrates a Career Guidance Expert (CGE) system with a Web-Based Student Assessment (WBSA) platform. Within the integrated framework, CGE enhances personalized career recommendations using AI while also assisting students after graduation in identifying suitable jobs, research domains, and higher study opportunities aligned with their skills and interests. The WBSA platform further strengthens interaction between students and faculty through assessments, personalized tasks, mentorship activities, and a secure real-time chat application. The CGE system employs a Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) model trained on real-world academic and extracurricular data collected using the snowball sampling method from the students of universities, achieving a validation accuracy of 94.71% in predicting personalized career paths. A pre-survey was conducted across universities to evaluate the proposed model before deployment. The WBSA system was developed as a modern web application using technologies such as this http URL , this http URL , and PostgreSQL to ensure scalability, responsiveness, and secure data management. The overall system is supported by a secure cloud-based infrastructure, the platform provides reliable performance while assisting graduates to select suitable career path in IT sector. In addition, a post-survey involving both students and faculty was conducted to gather feedback and further improve the overall effectiveness and usability of the system.

</details>


### [493] [AIChilles: Automatically Uncovering Hidden Weaknesses in AI-Evolved Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15834)
*Yajie Zhou,Ao Li,Ashwin Silla,Zaoxing Liu,Vyas Sekar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AIChilles是一个自动化测试框架，用于发现AI驱动系统优化（ADSO）框架（如AdaEvolve、Engram、OpenEvolve）所生成AI演化程序中的隐藏弱点。它通过将原始人工设计程序P作为差分预言机，搜索有效工作负载以发现AI演化程序P'在正确性、执行时间、内存使用或解的最优性方面出现的回归。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI驱动的系统优化（ADSO）范式使用AI代理迭代改写系统算法，虽然报告了12-60%的分数提升，但这些AI演化程序可能：(1)在未见工作负载上表现更差（过拟合评估器）；(2)引入严重的可扩展性回归（时间/内存爆炸）；(3)产生静默的质量退化。传统模糊测试和程序测试方法需要大量人工来构建执行环境，且无法直接处理AI演化程序的多样性和差异性弱点发现需求。

Method: AIChilles采用基于代理（agentic）的三阶段方法：1）**工作负载空间推断**：结合确定性AST解析（提取评估器中的候选参数）和基于代理的语义约束推断，生成有效工作负载语法；2）**按弱点类型分流的差异引导搜索**：为正确性、时间可扩展性、内存可扩展性、最优性四种弱点各分配一个子代理，使用代码执行频率（而非路径覆盖或输入距离）作为行为多样性信号，通过MAP-Elites质量多样性算法维护多样化工作负载库；3）**弱点摘要与根因分析**：通过触发函数将对抗性工作负载分组，并利用已发现工作负载作为热启动种子加速新演化程序的弱点发现。

Result: 在3个AI演化框架（OpenEvolve、AdaEvolve、Engram）、2个LLM（GPT-5、Claude Opus-4.6）、5个系统应用（事务调度、专家并行负载均衡、多云调度、LLM前缀缓存、模型放置）产生的30个AI演化程序上，AIChilles在6小时预算内发现49个不同弱点（25个时间回归、11个内存回归、7个正确性、6个最优性），显著优于随机模糊、变异模糊、基于属性的测试和朴素LLM代理基线。弱点模式具有应用依赖性和框架依赖性：Prism暴露静默质量退化，TXN-Sched暴露资源爆炸；Engram生成程序弱点较少。将AIChilles集成到AdaEvolve循环中可消除弱点，但以降低基准收益为代价（如Prism从19%提升降为0%）。

Conclusion: ADSO范式存在系统性风险：AI演化程序通过以更复杂代码过度拟合评估器工作负载，可能在真实部署中引入严重鲁棒性和安全问题。AIChilles作为差分审计工具能有效暴露这些弱点，但揭示了AI系统优化与鲁棒性之间的根本权衡——更强的评估器拟合度可能伴随更大的隐性弱点，需要更强健的基准工作负载和类CI/CD的演化流程来释放ADSO的潜力。

Abstract: The computer systems community has recently seen growing interest in AI-driven system evolution, where AI agents iteratively rewrite systems. Frameworks such as AdaEvolve and Engram report 12-60% score improvements over human-designed algorithms. While these results are promising, there are practical concerns if these AI-evolved programs can perform worse on unseen workloads and exhibit scalability regressions. Given the speed and scale of AI-generated code, we need automated mechanisms to uncover such identify hidden weaknesses in AI-evolved systems programs. To this end, we develop AIChilles that takes as input a baseline program $P$ and an AI-evolved program $P'$, AIChilles searches for valid workloads where $P'$ regresses relative to $P$ in correctness, runtime, memory usage, or output quality. To tackle the diversity in system applications, weakness types and potential bugs, AIChilles combines deterministic workload-parameter extraction, agent-based constraint inference, differential oracles, and code-frequency coverage to discover diverse failures. Across five system applications and 30 AI-evolved programs, AIChilles finds 49 distinct hidden weaknesses. We also show that explicitly including AIChilles in the AI-driven development lifecycle can mitigate several of these weaknesses.

</details>


### [494] [Heteroskedastic Signals in Budgeted LLM Verification: Structural Heterogeneity Limits Optimization Gains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15841)
*Jinlong Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对大语言模型(LLM)预算受限验证场景,识别出不确定性信号在不同成本层中存在异方差性(heteroskedastic),导致全局信号可比性假设失败。研究通过受控干预层次(Threshold→MP-Adapt→MP-Strat→CST)分离弱信号、优化不稳定与结构异质性三种因素,发现最简单但结构对齐的成本分层阈值方法(CST)在强异质性场景下比强全局在线学习方法提升命中率高达17个百分点,证明结构异质性是性能瓶颈而非优化器能力不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM系统越来越依赖不确定性信号来分配有限计算资源(如验证、测试时计算扩展、工具执行等)。这些分配策略隐含一个"全局信号可比性假设":相同的不确定性分数在不同输入上应具有可比的决定价值。然而在现实的预算受限验证任务中,这一假设可能失败:同一分数在一个成本层中信息丰富,在另一层中却接近随机。论文旨在诊断这种"可比性失败"是否为系统性问题,以及更强的全局优化器能否修复该问题。

Method: 论文采用"受控干预层次"方法,通过渐进式放松全局共享来分离不同失败源:(1) Threshold——静态全局阈值基线;(2) MP-Adapt——基于镜像近似(mirror-prox)的全局在线学习,联合优化评分参数和预算对偶变量,代表最强的全局共享学习器;(3) MP-Strat——部分分层,引入按成本层的独立对偶变量和教师-学生EMA,以检验优化不稳定性的影响;(4) CST(成本分层阈值)——有意的最弱干预,仅按预期成本将样本分为4层并在每层内独立运行分位数,无梯度更新。所有方法使用相同的三种token级不确定性代理信号(平均对数概率、最差token置信度、margin离散度),在MBPP和MATH数据集上对Qwen3-8B、LLaMA3-8B、GPT-4o-mini三种模型进行评估,并提出异方差分配失真上界理论(Proposition 1)解释结构异质性的影响。

Result: 主要实验结果:在MBPP上CST一致且显著优于全局阈值方法,β=20%时Qwen3提升+5.1pp(95% CI [+3.6,+6.6])、LLaMA3提升+15.1pp[+13.2,+17.0]、GPT-4o-mini提升+6.5pp[+4.3,+8.7];LLaMA3-8B在MBPP β=10%时最大增益达+17.0pp。MP-Adapt无法可靠超越静态阈值,MP-Strat仅部分恢复(+2.8pp),而CST在强异质性场景下凭借结构解耦实现主导性增益(+3.4至+17.0pp)。在MATH上结果呈现条件性:Qwen3-MATH出现负增益(β=20%时-7.6pp),表明分层只在分区捕获到关键反馈机制时才有效。理论分析证明全局分配失真以跨层判别力离散度为上界。控制实验排除了成本异质性作为主因(同质成本下CST退化为Threshold);同质合成信号实验表明在观察到的ρ≈0.178水平下MP-Adapt本应在同质条件下工作,但实际中失败,证明异质结构是主要瓶颈。

Conclusion: 论文得出核心结论:在LLM资源分配中存在"全局信号可比性假设"的失败模式,这种结构异质性而非优化器能力不足是性能的主要瓶颈;错误的反馈结构不能总是通过更强优化修复。理论将全局分配失真与跨层判别力离散度联系起来。论文提出诊断协议:在增加优化器复杂度之前,应先测量跨可观察决策相关层的条件信号质量,若存在变化则用简单对齐分区与负控制分区对比,仅在对齐分区下改善表明可比性失败。该诊断原则可迁移到测试时计算、模型/工具路由及人工代理审计等场景,核心贡献是诊断原理而非CST方法本身。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) systems increasingly use uncertainty signals to allocate limited computation across verification, test-time scaling, tool execution, and other selective-compute decisions. Such policies rely on a \emph{global signal comparability assumption}: equal scores should carry comparable decision value across inputs. Using budgeted verification as a controlled diagnostic setting, we identify a failure mode of this assumption: uncertainty quality is heteroskedastic across cost strata, with some regions exhibiting near-random discriminability despite concentrating many errors. Under an explicit local model, we characterize the resulting distortion of global allocation and show that its upper bound scales with cross-stratum signal-quality dispersion. We separate weak signals, optimization instability, and structural heterogeneity through a controlled intervention hierarchy: Threshold, MP-Adapt, MP-Strat, and a deliberately simple cost-stratified thresholding intervention (CST). Across MBPP and MATH using Qwen3-8B, LLaMA3-8B, and GPT-4o-mini, global online adaptation yields inconsistent gains over static thresholding; MP-Strat partially recovers performance, while CST improves hit rate by up to 17 percentage points in strongly heterogeneous settings without gradient updates. These results identify structural heterogeneity, rather than optimizer weakness alone, as the primary bottleneck in the observed settings. More broadly, misaligned feedback structure cannot always be repaired by stronger optimization.

</details>


### [495] [RetailBench: Benchmarking long horizon reasoning and coherent decision making of LLM agents in realistic retail environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15862)
*Linghua Zhang,Jun Wang,Jingtong Wu,Zhisong Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: RetailBench 是一个数据驱动的仿真基准测试,用于评估 LLM 智能体在单店超市运营中的长程决策能力。在 180 天评估中,7 个主流 LLM 在零售管理这一部分可观测决策过程中表现差异显著,大多数无法完成完整周期,即便存活下来的最强模型在净资产和销售额上仍远逊于特权预言机策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体基准多聚焦短程、结构化任务,缺乏对长程、经济闭环、耦合运营场景下持续自主决策能力的评估;零售经营(涉及库存、定价、补货、供应商、现金流等延迟反馈)恰好是检验长程一致性的天然试金石。

Method: 构建 POMDP 形式化的 RetailBench 仿真器,基于 Dominick's 真实零售数据初始化 96 个产品、20 个类目的价格/需求/采购先验,融合 Amazon Reviews 2023 评论池和金融新闻数据集,设计七大耦合模块(库存、货架、供应商、需求、评价退货、新闻、财务)。智能体通过只读工具、分析工具(代码沙箱、记忆)和状态变更工具(下单、改价、调货架、end_today)交互;评估 7 个 LLM(DeepSeek-V4-Pro、GLM-5.1、GPT-5.5、Grok-4.3、Kimi-K2.6、MiniMax-M2.5、Qwen3.5)分别在 ReAct、Reflection、Plan-and-Act 框架下的 180 天表现,并与一个拥有结构化访问权限的预言机策略对比。通过查询深度、证据完整性、价格贴近度、供应商质量得分、跟进动作率等四阶段诊断指标进行失败归因。

Result: 仅 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 和 GPT-5.5 跑完 180 天全周期,其余 5 个模型在 58–130 天内破产;GPT-5.5 净资产最高(24,350.98),DeepSeek-V4-Pro 销售额最高(164,417),但均远低于预言机(净资产 131,510.42,销售 267,998)。诊断揭示三类系统失败模式:(1)证据获取不完整(Grok-4.3 完整性 0.0000);(2)表面化决策,LLM 普遍价格优先(55.6%)而非质量优先(21.5%),价格距历史最优 17.92% vs 预言机 1.98%;(3)缺乏一致长程策略,LLM 每天仅关注 0.95–7.89 个产品,遗漏 32.86%–88.18% 的高需求机会,七日内跟进率仅 0.44–0.73。

Conclusion: 当前 LLM 智能体在长程、耦合、经济闭环的零售运营中远未达到稳定高效水平;核心瓶颈不仅在于工具调用,更在于证据选择、证据到行动的深度推理,以及跨日延迟反馈的状态化策略维护。RetailBench 既可作为性能基准,也可作为诊断测试平台,推动未来智能体在证据获取、质量调整决策和持续状态策略方面取得突破。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents have made rapid progress on short-horizon, well-scoped tasks, yet their ability to sustain coherent decisions in dynamic long-horizon environments remains uncertain. We introduce RetailBench, a data-grounded simulation benchmark for evaluating tool-using LLM agents in single-store supermarket operation. RetailBench models retail management as a partially observable decision process and is designed to support thousand-day-scale simulations. In this environment, agents must manage pricing, replenishment, supplier selection, shelf assortment, inventory aging, customer feedback, external events, and cash-flow constraints. We evaluate seven contemporary LLMs under representative agent frameworks over a 180-day evaluation horizon and compare them with a privileged oracle policy. Results show substantial variation across models: only a small subset survives the full evaluation horizon, and even the strongest LLM runs remain substantially behind the oracle policy in final net worth and sales outcomes. Behavioral analysis attributes these gaps to incomplete evidence acquisition, surface-level decision making, and the lack of a consistent long-horizon policy. RetailBench provides a controlled testbed for studying reliable autonomy in economically grounded long-horizon decision-making.

</details>


### [496] [STRIDE: Strategic Trajectory Reasoning via Discriminative Estimation for Verifiable Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15866)
*Qinjian Zhao,Zhihao Dou,Dinggen Zhang,Xiangyu Li,Chaoda Song,Zhongwei Wan,Xinpeng Li,Yanyan Zhang,Kaijie Chen,Qingtao Pan,Chengcheng Feng,Zhiqiang Gao,Xiaoyu Xia*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: STRIDE提出了一种细粒度的RLVR框架，通过对比同一响应组中成功与失败的推理轨迹，评估每个n-gram策略模式的结果判别性偏好，并结合推理显著性熵识别决策相关的策略模式，在RL优化中为不同模式分配差异化的优势值，从而在保持可验证性的同时实现更精确的信用分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RLVR方法仅依赖最终答案正确性提供轨迹级奖励，导致监督信号稀疏且对所有token一视同仁。虽然近期研究引入了过程奖励、高熵token和语义不确定性等中间信号，但这些信号本质上不可验证，无法区分有益的策略模式与有害的策略模式（如正确与错误轨迹的高熵token分布高度相似）。因此需要一种从可验证结果中推导策略性推理监督的细粒度RLVR方法。

Method: STRIDE建立判别性策略推理强化学习（DSR-RL）框架，主要包含两个核心组件：(1) 判别性推理估计——将响应分为成功集D⁺和失败集D⁻，计算每个n-gram模式g的频率判别性分数S_freq(g)=clip(log[(P(g|D⁺)+δ)/(P(g|D⁻)+δ)], -ε, ε)；(2) 策略显著性熵H_sal(g)——计算n-gram中token的平均熵，过滤掉常规执行性模式。最终显著性分数S_A(g)=𝕀(H_sal(g)≥τ)·S_freq(g)作为n-gram级别的优势修正项，叠加到基础优势A_base上形成A_final=A_base+S_A(g)，从而在GRPO目标中实现差异化信用分配。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct、Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct和Qwen3-4B-Base三个基础模型上，STRIDE在AIME24/25、MATH500、AMC23、Minerva、Olympiad六个数学推理基准上均优于GRPO、DAPO、HICRA-GRPO和HET-DAPO等基线（如Qwen2.5-7B平均分从42.18提升至44.71）。在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上的多模态推理（MMMU-Pro: 44.2 vs SRPO 42.3）和智能体任务（WebShop/ALFWorld/BabyAI平均84.3）上也取得最优性能。消融实验验证了S_freq、熵过滤器和n-gram建模三个组件的互补性，统计显著性分析（p<0.001）表明改进稳定可靠。

Conclusion: STRIDE通过从可验证的成功与失败轨迹中识别结果判别性策略模式，结合频率估计与推理显著性熵，为有益模式分配正优势、为有害模式分配负优势，实现了比标准结果级RLVR更精确的信用分配。跨数学推理、多模态推理和智能体任务的广泛实验证明了其有效性、鲁棒性和泛化能力。未来工作可探索开放式生成场景、更高效的模式估计以及更灵活语义单元的应用。

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has become an effective post-training paradigm for improving the reasoning abilities of large language models. However, existing RLVR methods typically rely on final-answer correctness to assign trajectory-level rewards, providing sparse supervision and treating all tokens uniformly regardless of their actual contribution to reasoning. Although recent studies introduce intermediate signals such as process rewards, high-entropy tokens, and semantic uncertainty, these signals are often not inherently verifiable and may fail to distinguish beneficial strategic patterns from harmful ones. To address this limitation, we propose STRIDE (Strategic Trajectory Reasoning with Discriminative Estimation), a fine-grained RLVR framework that derives strategic reasoning supervision from verifiable outcomes. STRIDE contrasts successful and failed trajectories within each response group to estimate the outcome-discriminative preference of each $n$-gram strategic pattern, and further combines this signal with reasoning saliency entropy to identify decision-relevant strategic patterns. These patterns are assigned differentiated advantage values during RL optimization, enabling more precise credit assignment while preserving the verifiability of RLVR. Extensive experiments demonstrate that STRIDE consistently improves reasoning performance across diverse models, tasks, and extended settings, including VLMs and agent-based systems.

</details>


### [497] [LLM-as-Code Agentic Programming for Agent Harness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15874)
*Junjia Qi,Zichuan Fu,Jingtong Gao,Wenlin Zhang,Hanyu Yan,Xian Wu,Xiangyu Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"Agentic Programming"（代理式编程）范式，主张将由程序掌控控制流（循环、分支、序列），而LLM仅作为被调用的自适应组件（LLM-as-Code），用于推理与生成任务。该方法用调用图的DAG结构组织上下文，将每调用的上下文长度限制为调用深度而非步骤累积，从而根治当前LLM Agent框架中由LLM担任编排者所导致的token爆炸、控制流幻觉与不可靠完成等架构性缺陷。在OSWorld基准上仅用15步即以86.8%超越100步最高80.4%的基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前主流LLM Agent框架（如AutoGen、OpenHands、MetaGPT）均采用ReAct范式，让LLM担任编排者，自主决定下一步行动、工具调用与终止时机。作者指出，将循环、分支、序列等确定性工作交给概率性系统是"范畴错误"，由此产生三类架构性失败：（1）token爆炸——上下文随步数线性增长至窗口溢出；（2）控制流幻觉——模型在验证运行前即宣称任务完成；（3）不可靠完成——模型被最新失败测试左右而放弃正确早期诊断。更好的提示词或更强的模型只能降低单步错误率，无法提供多步正确性保证，失败概率随任务长度复合累积。

Method: 提出Agentic Programming范式，包含四部分设计：（1）代码驱动的工作流——用普通代码（如for循环、if分支）编写工作流，LLM仅在被调用的节点处推理，运行时通过@agentic装饰器将LLM调用封装为类型化函数；（2）DAG结构化上下文——调用上下文遵循调用图作用域规则，每调用仅携带其祖先链的完整上下文，已返回的兄弟调用折叠为单行摘要，复杂度由O(steps)降为O(depth)；（3）多Agent协作——并发Agent即调用图的兄弟分支，合并点为程序逻辑而非模型裁决，失败局部化于单个返回值；（4）自我编程式演化——LLM提议的新函数在被测试接受后作为代码提交，作为确定性步骤运行而非每次重读。

Result: 在OSWorld GUI自动化基准上，基于LLM-as-Code的Agent（Claude Sonnet 4.6后端）仅用15步即达到86.8%总体成功率，超过允许100步的Holoo3-35B-A3B（80.4%）、OpenAPA+Gemini-3.1-pro（78.3%）、Claude Sonnet 4.6（72.1%）等所有基线；在Chrome、Multi-Apps、OS三个子域上分别取得93.5%、80.0%、100.0%，均居首位。所有Top级循环约150行Python代码，遵循"循环归代码，推理归LLM"原则。作者强调这一优势源于"可靠性由构造保证"——所需步骤由代码按规定顺序执行，不可能被采样决策跳过、重复或错序。

Conclusion: LLM Agent的主流执行模型存在范畴错误，将确定性工作交给概率性系统，失败属架构性问题而非可被规模化解决。当工作流具有已知结构时，该结构应被编写为程序而非委托给模型；探索性任务仍可保留LLM编排。在软件工程实践中，Agentic Programming恢复了常规工程实践：单元测试可钉住LLM返回值进行确定性断言，失败定位于具名调用的返回值而非50步对话中的某一轮，现有软件可逐步引入LLM推理而无需重写为Agent。

Abstract: Every major LLM agent framework gives the LLM the role of orchestrator; the model decides what to do next, when to call tools, and when to stop. We argue that token explosion, control-flow hallucination, and unreliable completion are not implementation bugs but architectural consequences of assigning the deterministic work of looping, branching, and sequencing to a probabilistic system. A better prompt or a stronger model cannot guarantee the reliability of the LLM agent. We therefore propose Agentic Programming, in which the program governs all control flow, and the LLM is itself part of it, an adaptive component we call LLM-as-Code and invoke only where a task calls for reasoning or generation. Within each call the model keeps full flexibility, but it cannot alter the program's execution path. With control in the program, the LLM's context is built from the execution history's call tree and forms a directed acyclic graph (DAG). Each call's context length is then determined by its call depth rather than by accumulation over steps. A case study of computer-use agents shows that the design is practical, not just a theoretical stance, substantially improving the stability of long visual operation sequences.

</details>


### [498] [UrbanWell: Benchmarking Multimodal Large Language Models for Spatio-Temporal Urban Wellbeing Analytics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15890)
*Yanxin Xi,Xiang Su,Jie Feng,Yu Liu,Sasu Tarkoma,Pan Hui*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: UrbanWell是一个大规模多模态基准测试，用于评估多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在城市福祉分析中的时空推理能力。该基准整合了38个城市（2012-2024年）的卫星图像、街景图像与19个跨五个领域的城市指标，在统一的零样本设置下对15个前沿MLLM进行基准测试，并定义了三类任务范式：单年估计、多年预测和时序趋势分类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的城市视觉数据集和基准在多模态覆盖、时间深度和指标异质性方面存在局限：缺乏环境空气质量、感知属性和纵向观察的系统整合；已有研究多聚焦于孤立任务、特定区域或单年预测设置，限制了对模型跨时空推理能力的系统比较和可重复性；MLLMs在通用视觉任务上表现强劲，但在结构化城市分析中的能力尚未被系统评估，特别是跨城市泛化、多指标预测和时序推理方面。

Method: 1）构建UrbanWell基准：覆盖38个城市（主要为欧洲城市，辅以亚、北美、南美、非洲和大洋洲代表城市），时间跨度2012-2024年，网格级空间对齐（每网格约1.6 km²），整合19个指标分为五大类（环境、空间可达性、城市形态、城市活力、主观感知）。2）数据来源包括Google Earth卫星图、Google Street View API、ODIAC（CO₂）、EEA（NO₂、PM2.5）、Copernicus（NDVI）、Urban Atlas（土地利用）、OSM（路网/POI）、WorldPop（人口）及Place Pulse 2.0感知模型。3）三类任务范式：单年估计（静态时空推理）、多年预测（基于历史观测的纵向推理）、时序趋势分析（分类正/负/稳定趋势）。4）在统一零样本提示模板下评估15个MLLM（Gemma3、Qwen2.5VL、InternVL、Phi、Mistral、Llama4、Nova、Gemini、GPT-5-nano等），主要使用RMSE和分类准确率。5）通过消融实验分析卫星图像、街景数量、图像模态、时间长度、LoRA微调等因素的影响。

Result: 1）单年估计极不稳定：环境指标尤其困难，CO₂的RMSE跨模型变化达多个数量级；人口估计误差极大；城市形态指标相对稳定；感知与活力类指标（如经济多样性、美丽、生机）跨模型差异较小。2）多年预测显著改善：误差大幅下降且跨模型更紧凑，消除了CO₂和人口的极端异常值，表明时间上下文提供了强烈信号。3）时序趋势分析仍具挑战：多数指标准确率集中在0.2-0.4，模型倾向于预测"稳定"，存在时序过度平滑问题；土地利用多样性（LUD）最易预测（>0.75），环境和感知类指标较难。4）模型规模与架构影响：同族内大模型通常表现更优，但跨族对比无统一最优模型，Gemini-2.0-Flash在环境指标上最强，GPT-5-nano在城市形态上最优。5）卫星图像对感知和结构指标帮助较大；LoRA微调大幅改善单年任务但多年任务增益有限；人类在CO₂和人口上优于最佳MLLM。

Conclusion: UrbanWell作为统一基准，系统揭示了当前MLLM在多模态城市福祉分析中的能力边界：模型在视觉可观察、静态空间结构相关的指标上表现相对良好，但在环境排放推断、人口等非视觉直接可观测指标以及细粒度时序推理上仍面临重大挑战。模型规模带来部分提升但并非跨任务一致，时序上下文的引入显著改善数值稳定性但未能解决细粒度趋势判别问题。这些发现凸显了开发更强多模态定量与纵向城市推理AI系统的必要性，并为未来研究提供了标准化测试平台。基准的局限性包括感知标签继承自预训练模型、城市地理分布偏欧洲、年度聚合与瞬时图像的潜在错配以及预训练数据暴露的可能性。

Abstract: Understanding urban wellbeing from multimodal data requires integrating heterogeneous spatial and temporal signals, posing significant challenges for current multimodal large language models (MLLMs). We introduce UrbanWell, a large-scale benchmark designed to systematically evaluate the spatio-temporal reasoning capabilities of MLLMs for urban wellbeing analytics through joint modeling of satellite and street view imagery. UrbanWell spans 38 cities across multiple years and includes diverse indicators covering (1) environmental conditions (CO$_2$, NO$_2$, PM${2.5}$, and Normalized Difference Vegetation Index), (2) spatial accessibility (minimum distance to supermarkets and restaurants), (3) urban form (road length, road density, and land use), (4) urban vitality (population, economic activity diversity, and land use diversity), and (5) subjective perception attributes (e.g., safety, beauty, liveliness, wealth, and quietness). All indicators are aligned at grid level to enable standardized evaluation. Beyond static prediction, UrbanWell defines temporal reasoning tasks, including future value forecasting from historical observations and temporal trend classification. We benchmark 15 state-of-the-art representative MLLMs in a zero-shot setting, providing a comprehensive comparative evaluation across spatial and temporal dimensions. Experimental results indicate that while MLLMs capture salient spatial and perceptual cues, their performance varies substantially across heterogeneous urban indicators spanning environment and subjective perception. UrbanWell serves as a unified benchmark for evaluating multimodal spatial and temporal reasoning in urban wellbeing analytics, offering a standardized testbed for systematic assessment and future research on multimodal urban intelligence. Our codes and datasets are accessible via this https URL .

</details>


### [499] [Agentic Framework for Deep Learning workload migration via In-Context Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.15994)
*Qiyue Liang,Steven Ingram,George Vanica,Andi Gavrilescu,Newfel Harrat,Hassan Sipra,Sethuraman Sankaran*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种全自动智能体框架,结合上下文学习(ICL)与基于执行预言机(oracle)的自调试机制,用于将 PyTorch 深度学习模型自动迁移到 JAX。系统通过精心策划的 ICL 示例提供结构锚定,利用 PyTorch 实际执行生成的不可变预言机数据作为数学真值,通过智能体循环自动生成测试并基于错误反馈自我修正。在 Level 1(数学操作)上达到 100% 数值等价,Level 2(神经模块)上达到 91%,并在 10 个真实代码仓库(包括 SAM、T5、Code Whisper 等)上验证了端到端的迁移能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: PyTorch 到 JAX 的代码迁移通常依赖人工且容易出错。核心挑战在于:(1)两种框架存在根本性差异——PyTorch 采用面向对象、可变状态、即时执行,而 JAX 采用函数式、无状态、JIT 编译;(2)存在张量布局(NCHW vs NHWC)、默认精度(fp32 vs bfloat16)、填充方式等多种默认差异;(3)LLM 在严格的 API 对齐和高维张量算术方面容易产生幻觉,无法可靠处理精确的数学运算;(4)基于 RAG 的方法会引入分布式计算等无关噪声,加剧"迷失在中间"现象;(5)现有方法缺乏可靠的执行验证闭环,导致 reward hacking 和数值不等价问题。

Method: 系统采用四阶段流水线:(1) **ICL 锚定阶段**:精心策划小而密集的参考翻译集(源 PyTorch 模块、惯用 JAX 翻译、相关测试用例)作为结构锚点,避免 RAG 引入的噪声;(2) **动态执行预言机生成**:运行 PyTorch 模块,通过前向传播提取初始化权重、输入张量和输出激活,序列化为不可变的"预言机"数据(.pkl 文件),作为数学真值的执行锚;(3) **智能体翻译与预言机条件测试生成**:智能体在 ICL 约束下将 PyTorch 翻译为 flax.linen 抽象,并基于预言机数据自动生成测试 harness。评估采用三阶段分层流程——编译正确性、形状一致性(容忍 ϵ=10⁻⁷ 的浮点差异)、数值等价性;(4) **迭代自调试与 Silver 参考验证**:测试失败时将错误信息、堆栈跟踪和精确数值差异反馈给 LLM 进行自修正。最终评估使用独立的人工构建测试集且与 ICL 示例严格分离,防止 reward hacking。

Result: 消融实验在 Level 1(9 个数学/训练操作)和 Level 2(11 个神经模块)上进行:基线为 9%/44%(数值/编译)、纯指令提示为 18%/67%、指令+自调试为 27%/89%、完整流水线达到 91%/100%。Level 2 上形状匹配从 55% 提升至 91%。Level 3 在 10 个真实 GitHub 仓库(Code Whisper、MMTF、Simple-MOE、Time-series、FinGPT、StyleGAN2、T5、Two-tower、SAM2、DETR)上由人类专家评估,完整性普遍达到 100%(SAM2 为 86%),数值等价率范围 57%-100%(4 个仓库 100% 匹配,DETR 最低 57%),可读性 Likert 评分 3.75-4.9。失败模式主要分为三类:语法幻觉(缺少包装类)、API 签名不匹配(误用 PyTorch kwargs)、状态映射差异(权重传输 KeyError)。

Conclusion: 论文证明 LLM 在获得明确规则和优质参考后,能成为高效的代码生成器;将结构化 ICL 锚点与动态执行预言机相结合,可有效处理函数式状态管理和隐藏数值问题。方法在独立模块上达到高保真度,提供了可扩展的跨框架迁移蓝图。主要局限在于:(1)尚未实现完全自动化的仓库级迁移(需完整的结构依赖管理);(2)未系统研究 ICL 示例选择对结果的影响。

Abstract: Translating deep learning models from PyTorch's flexible, object-oriented design to JAX's functional, stateless setup is usually a manual and error-prone task. Automated migration is challenging because Large Language Models (LLMs) struggle with strict and dynamic API alignment and are prone to mistakes for exacting operations. We propose a fully autonomous system that combines In-Context Learning (ICL) with oracle-driven self-debugging. First, we curated an ICL context that serves as a strict reference for idiomatic JAX styling and test case generation. Second, instead of depending on the LLM to deduce mathematical outputs, we run the source PyTorch modules to get their actual dynamic tensor states. This creates an unchangeable execution oracle. We then use an autonomous agentic loop to synthesize tests based on the oracle data. The test cases are executed repeatedly, and the traceback is sent back to the LLM for self-correction. Ablations show that combining ICL references with oracle grounding and self-debugging greatly outperforms pure instructional and basic agentic baselines. This improvement does not add an excessive computational overhead. Our lightweight pipeline achieves 91% numerical equivalence (compared to baseline: 9%, instruction + self-debugging: 27%) on neural modules, providing a highly reliable, scalable blueprint for cross-framework migration. This has been validated across several state-of-the-art models including SAM (segment anything), T5, Code Whisper amongst others showing high numerical equivalency. Code: this https URL

</details>


### [500] [SciText2Eq: Assessing LLMs for Explainable Equation Generation for Scientific Creativity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16003)
*Yifan Mo,Xiao Fu,Yue Su,Qingyu Meng,Koen Hindriks,Qingzhi Liu,Jiahuan Pei*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 SciText2Eq 框架，评估大语言模型从非结构化科学文本中生成可解释数学方程的能力，并构建了基于 AI 论文的基准数据集与多层级评估协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方程生成方法多依赖结构化或合成输入（如变量对、数学应用题），难以处理真实科学论文中方程与自然语言交织、多方程相互依赖的复杂场景。此外，缺乏与人类判断对齐的综合评估方法，限制了模型在科学创造力任务中的应用。

Method: 1) 从 ACL/ICLR/ICML/NeurIPS/NAACL 等会议收集 170 篇 AI 论文（含 1,043 个方程），构建上下文-方程-描述三元组数据集；2) 设计顺序式方程生成工作流，LLM 依据当前上下文及此前所有已生成方程和变量描述，逐个生成目标方程和变量说明；3) 提出三层评估协议：自动指标（TexBLEU、Levenshtein、SeqSim、ROUGE-L、TED）、LLM-as-Judge 五维评分（Validity、Coverage、Clarity、Appropriateness、Equivalence）以及 100 样例的人工评估对齐分析；4) 评估 5 个开源/闭源 LLM（GPT-4.1、GPT-4o-mini、DeepSeek-R1、LLaMA3.3-70B、Qwen3-235B），并分析方程密度、会议来源等因素影响。

Result: 1) 自动指标显示各模型在词法和句法相似性上表现中等（Lexicality ≈ 51.7%，Syntax ≈ 29.6%），语义等价性差（Equivalence 评分仅 2.4–3.0）；2) 方程密度增加会显著降低语义准确性，呈现非单调效应（中等数量方程略有提升，>10 个方程时下降）；3) LLM-as-Judge 与人类判断相关性弱（多数 Spearman/Kendall 接近零，Cohen's κ ≈ 0.2），DeepSeek-R1 在语义维度对齐最佳；4) 算子级 Jaccard 重叠分析显示仅 20–26% 的方程实现精确算子等价；5) 不同会议写作风格对评估结果影响极小，表明局限源于模型内在能力。

Conclusion: LLM 能生成语法有效、上下文合理的方程，但在真实科学文本中捕捉数学语义的能力有限，尤其在高方程密度场景下；LLM 自动评估与人类判断对齐不足，需开发结合符号结构、方程间依赖与语义等价的建模方法和评估框架。本工作提供了可扩展的工作流与基准，为 AI 辅助科学发现奠定基础。

Abstract: This work investigates the ability of large language models (LLMs) to generate mathematical equations from scientific texts. Prior work faces challenges in unstructured grounding, multi-equation dependency, and humanaligned evaluation. To this end, we construct a dataset of AI research papers, pairing contextual passages with ground-truth equations and variable descriptions. We develop an explainable equation generation workflow and evaluate it across diverse open- and closed-source LLM backbones. We introduce an evaluation protocol combining automatic metrics, LLM-based rubrics, and human judgments to assess accuracy, explainability, and human-LLM alignment. Results indicate that LLMs perform moderately on lexical- and syntactic-based similarity, while struggling with semantic accuracy. Comparisons between LLM-based evaluations and human judgments reveal limited alignment, highlighting challenges in using LLMs to assess equation quality. These findings offer insights for improving equation generation models and developing more reliable evaluation methods for scientific text. We provide code and data for reproducibility.

</details>


### [501] [Auditing Reward Hackability in Code RL Training Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16062)
*Shreshth Rajan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文对代码强化学习训练环境中的奖励可黑客性(reward hackability)进行了系统审计。在 SWE-bench Verified 的 49 个任务样本中,28.5% 的任务测试套件弱到足以让一个 Docker 验证的错误补丁通过;在 R2E-Gym 的 20 个任务中该比例为 25.0%。通过 134 个前沿模型提交的随机效应元分析发现,在同一人类评级难度层内,可黑客任务上的 Pass@1 比健壮任务高 14.14 个百分点。研究还提出了一种带 Docker 黄金健全性闸门的修复流程,发现 LLM 增强测试的逐次缺陷率为 61.9%,而单独的 LLM 评判器无法捕捉这些缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代码强化学习依赖执行反馈(verifier)作为奖励信号。如果测试套件接受不正确的解决方案作为正确,智能体将因错误行为获得奖励,从而引发奖励黑客(对齐造假、破坏等更广泛的涌现失准问题)。Anthropic 2025 年 11 月的生产代码 RL 报告已将此效应与更广泛的涌现失准联系起来。然而,已发布的 SWE-bench Verified 审计既未给出训练集中任务的可黑客率,也未提供运维级别的修复程序。本文旨在弥补这一空白,提供 (1) 跨基准的可黑客率审计,(2) 黑客性对 Pass@1 影响的元分析验证,(3) 增强器缺陷率测量与修复流程。

Method: 方法由四部分组成:(1) **利用生成**:使用 Claude Sonnet 4 为每项任务生成 K 个候选错误源补丁(统一 diff 或 file_replacements),通过 Docker 容器应用并用项目原生测试运行器验证,采用 EvolveCoder 风格的迭代攻击模式(第 1 轮单次,第 2–3 轮利用失败日志偏向生成)。(2) **环境质量评分 (EQS)**:四维加权评分,EQS(t) = 0.35·V(t) + 0.30·(1−H(t)) + 0.20·F1(t) + 0.15·D(t),其中 V 为 NVIDIA 风格验证器判别分,H 为经验可黑客率,F1 为 LLM 评判-执行一致性的三向混淆矩阵 F1,D 为跨模型可学习性信号;阈值划分为 KEEP (>0.70) / FIX ([0.40, 0.70]) / DROP (<0.40)。(3) **黄金健全性闸门的修复循环**:两阶段流程——阶段 1 将增强测试注入项目测试文件,应用黄金解决方案并运行项目原生 runner,若黄金失败则丢弃并触发多样性偏向重试(温度从 0.3 提升至 0.7);阶段 2 通过在 (0.2, 0.4, 0.6) 温度下采样的 3 样本自洽性 LLM 评判器投票,BLOCKS 判定计为覆盖。(4) **元分析验证**:收集 134 个模型对 SWE-bench Verified 的逐任务 Pass@1,按人类评级难度分层后用 DerSimonian-Laird 随机效应模型汇总逐模型差值 Δm。

Result: **可黑客率审计**:SWE-bench Verified 49 任务中 14 个 (28.5%) 存在 Docker 验证的利用;可黑客任务分布于 2/12 个代码库(astropy 6 个、django 8 个);单次利用率为 18.4%,迭代攻击新增 5 个任务。R2E-Gym 16 个决定性任务中 4 个 (25.0%) 可黑客,因 K=1 单次生成为下界。**元分析**:Δ̂ = +14.14 pp,95% CI [+11.80, +16.48],单侧 p < 10⁻⁶,I² = 0%,123/134 模型 Δm > 0;Wilcoxon 符号秩检验一致同意;非分层效应为 +25.64 pp,人类难度分层保留了 55%。**修复流程发现**:未加闸门时,LLM 评判器单独报告 10/11 任务升级;Docker 复验 8 个分层抽样 BLOCKS 判定中,6 个为 INVALID_AUG(增强器错误),并按任务具体命名(错误的导入风格、@u.quantity_input 在 None 上误用、跨数据库实体缺失、参数默认值误判为 None 而非 inspect._empty、escape() 方向反转、关键字 username 重复)。**加闸门后**:65/105 决定性增强被闸门标记失败(61.9% 逐次缺陷率),最终 9/11 任务升级(FIX→KEEP),平均 EQS 从 0.570 提升至 0.797,API 成本 $3.60。**消融实验**:闸门(无重试)将升级数降至 3/11,加上重试恢复至 9/11;多样性偏向提示与中性提示效果相同(9/11),降低提示多样性不改变结果,3 样本评判相对 1 样本多恢复 1 个任务;闸门+重试是 3→9 差距的主导因素,提示风格与评判分辨率不是。

Conclusion: 本文提供了一种可操作的端到端流水线,用于测量和修复代码 RL 训练环境中的奖励可黑客性。核心发现:相当比例的 SWE-bench Verified (28.5%) 与 R2E-Gym (25.0%) 任务接受错误解决方案;前沿模型在可黑客任务上的 Pass@1 系统性地高出 +14.14 pp(分层后),与四项独立测量(SWE-bench Verified 审计、OpenAI 退役说明、UC Berkeley trustworthy-env、本元分析)指向同一方向。修复方法论上的关键洞察是:Docker 黄金健全性闸门是必需的——LLM 评判器本身在 61.9% 的逐次增强中产生错误,这些错误被闸门捕获。该研究将闸门+重试的组合定位为修复阶段的关键支撑(从 3/11 提升到 9/11),并指出直接因果测试(在固定算力下用修复后与未修复的损坏任务训练)是下一步的自然工作。主要局限:审计样本量较小(49 + 20 任务),单前沿 LLM 攻击者,优化回路的 9/11 基于 n=11;而 61.9% 缺陷率基于 n=105 决定性健全性检查,是更稳定的核心方法论发现。

Abstract: We measure the rate at which code RL environments accept incorrect solutions as correct. On a 49-task sample of SWE-bench Verified, 28.5% of tasks have test suites weak enough that a Docker-verified incorrect patch passes them. On 20 R2E-Gym tasks across 6 repositories, the same pipeline at single-shot exploit generation yields 25.0%. A random-effects meta-analysis over 134 frontier model submissions to SWE-bench Verified finds, within the same human-rated difficulty stratum, model Pass@1 is +14.14 percentage points higher on flagged-hackable tasks than on robust ones (95% CI [+11.80, +16.48]; one-sided p < 10^-6; I^2 = 0%; 123 of 134 models positive). We then describe a procedure for hardening the broken tasks. An inline LLM judge with a Docker gold-sanity gate runs each generated test against the gold solution before the judge is consulted. On the 11 broken tasks in the audit, the gate flags 65 of 105 decisive LLM-generated tests as failing on the gold patch itself, a 61.9% per-augmentation defect rate the LLM judge alone misses. With diversity-biased retry, the loop converges 9 of 11 tasks to a gated upgrade.

</details>


### [502] [Mind-Studio: Executable World Models with Lookahead Evaluation for Partially Observable Games](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16070)
*Yifei Dong,Mingen Zheng,Linquan Wu,Jeff Z. Pan,Jiaxin Bai*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Mind-Studio 是一个利用大语言模型从状态-动作-下一状态轨迹中合成可执行 pygame 风格世界模型的框架，结合熵选择的轨迹与游戏技能文件，在部分可观测的 Atari 游戏上显著提升了 K 步前瞻保真度与任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有符号化世界模型方法多聚焦于拟合观察到的转移或局部规则的混合，无法生成独立于真实环境运行的完整可执行程序；而在部分可观测的 Atari 游戏中，相同可见状态可能隐藏不同内部条件，多种机制（移动、碰撞优先级、敌机行为、重生、物品收集）常在同一局部区域交互。这要求世界模型不仅能预测下一状态，还需以可运行程序形式编码对象身份、静态场景约束、动作语义与更新顺序，从而在从不同状态执行时保持行为一致性。

Method: 框架分为两阶段：（1）合成阶段——通过基于熵的打分函数 H(r_i) 从符号化转移中挑选隐含规则的关键子集 𝒯̃，按静态接口 𝒫（持久对象槽）与每步增量 Δ𝒫（仅记录变化属性）进行压缩，再与游戏技能文件 𝒮_game（包含对象类型、合法动作、领域约定与静态场景布局）一同输入冻结的 LLM 综合器 g_φ，生成 pygame 风格的 Python 转移程序 M，最后在保留集上以一阶 NSP 挑选最优候选 M⋆；（2）规划阶段——将 M⋆ 接入共享的 LLM-as-Planner 框架（Algorithm 1），在每轮对每个候选动作执行 K 帧保持（K=8 或 16）以生成预测分支表 B_t，并采用子目标回滚机制（终端重置或 N_stuck 步无进展时回退至最近已验证检查点）。评估采用 K 步前瞻保真度协议，对比 M 与真实 ALE 滚动结果在玩家像素坐标上的精确匹配率（NSP）。

Result: 在 Montezuma's Revenge 上，Mind-Studio 将选中动作的 NSP 从 PoE-World 的 0.3% 提升至 48.7%，并验证 5/8 个子目标；在 Assault 上，跨五个规划器均取得最强选中动作与分支 NSP（如 Qwen3-Coder-480B 下分支 NSP 达 0.87 vs. PoE-World 0.44），任务得分 84 vs. 63；在 Alien 与 Skiing 上也获得强于或与基线相当的分支级保真度（跨规划器平均分支 NSP：Assault 0.91 vs. 0.36；Skiing 0.27 vs. 0.24；Alien 0.34 vs. 0.28；Montezuma 0.19 vs. 0.09）。消融实验表明，移除压缩或游戏技能文件会显著降低 NSP（Qwen3-Coder-480B 从 0.52 降至 0.08 / 0.24）。在 56 组 learned-source 对比中，更高 NSP 在 44 组中平局或提升任务结果。

Conclusion: Mind-Studio 证明：仅需对熵选择的符号化轨迹进行一次未精炼的 LLM 综合，即可产出能支持部分可观测环境规划的可执行世界模型。可由像素级场景提取填充的游戏技能文件弥合了原始视觉观测与 LLM 所需结构化动态知识之间的鸿沟；K 步前瞻保真度作为评估信号，将程序质量与规划器格式化效应解耦。整体设计——技能文件引导的单次合成 + K 步前瞻评估——可作为在任何具备对象级观测与离散动作的领域构建轻量可解释世界模型的可复用蓝图。剩余错误集中于几何敏感场景（绳索/头骨交互、梯子-平台重叠），未来工作可结合针对性轨迹采集、随机情况下的更丰富转移模板以及将显式规则注入 LLM 上下文以替代编译程序。

Abstract: World-model synthesis aims to turn interaction experience into an internal model of environment dynamics. Existing symbolic approaches often fit observed transitions or mixtures of local rules, but they do not produce a complete executable program that can run independently of the real environment. We present Mind-Studio, a framework that synthesizes executable pygame-style world models from state-action-next-state trajectories using large language models. Mind-Studio combines entropy-selected traces with a lightweight game skill file containing object, action, and static scene information extracted from screenshots. We evaluate synthesis quality with a K-step lookahead fidelity protocol that compares generated world-model rollouts against Real-ALE rollouts from the same state. On Montezuma's Revenge, Mind-Studio improves chosen-action next-state prediction from 0.3% for PoE-World to 48.7% while verifying 5 of 8 subgoals; across Alien, Assault, and Skiing, it achieves stronger branch-level fidelity than prior learned lookahead sources.

</details>


### [503] [Rhythm of the Deep: A Computational-Linguistic Test of Duality of Patterning in Sperm Whale Codas](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16084)
*Mudit Sinha,Sanika Chavan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文使用计算语言学方法，基于1483个抹香鲸coda（咔哒声串）样本，测试其是否具有人类语言"双重模式"（duality of patterning）特征。研究发现抹香鲸coda系统呈现窄义的两层组合架构：下层为点击的无序集合加节律，上层为coda在回合（bout）级别的序列依赖。这一发现不涉及语义、感知或人类语言声称，但提供了一种可迁移的、零假设受控的框架来区分声学相似性与真实组合结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类语言的"双重模式"设计特征（低层无意义单元组合成高层有意义单元，再组合成更大序列）是否存在于非人类通信系统是一个长期未决问题。抹香鲸coda作为候选系统，其组合结构难以确认，因为原始音频中的声学相似性会伪装为符号结构。本文旨在用计算语言学的结构发现方法，从连续音频中区分真正的组合结构与声学伪迹。

Method: 采用多层级结构发现方法：(1) 使用8个冻结音频编码器家族（AVES、BEATs、VampNet、Whisper、Perch、HuBERT、wav2vec 2.0、AVES2）的共识（23个coda视图、20个点击视图）；(2) 使用Sharma注释的ICI作为点击定位锚点，并进行去注释控制的去新颖点击检测验证；(3) 通过co-association共识聚类生成token字母表；(4) 按Date×Unit×IDN分块的留出交叉验证；(5) 每个结构统计量配以非循环零假设；(6) Phase G声学零假设可恢复性闸门（频谱匹配噪声、点击顺序洗牌、包络噪声填充、跨coda点击替换）；(7) 信息论序列诊断（NSB二阶转移熵等6个估计器）；(8) 节律专用基线（手工ICI特征与VLMM启发的dICI基线）；(9) 节律缩放协议检测抽象梯度。

Result: 主要发现：(1) coda库存一致存在（Phase A：253/253编码器对AMI显著高于零假设，lift=0.244）；(2) 点击身份预测coda身份（T1b：NMI=0.410 vs 零假设0.032，lift=0.376，20/20视图正向，存活Phase G闸门）；(3) 点击顺序在共识层面不存在（T2b：大ram零假设lift=0.0008 bits/token）；(4) 节律在固定点击多重集后仍贡献coda身份（Bridge 6：ρ=0.183，p=0.002，23/23编码器正向，组感知排列检验显著）；(5) coda在bout层面有二阶序列依赖（Phase E：NSB TE lift=0.132 bits，p=0.002，139/139表示变体通过）；(6) 节律专用基线在上层失败（手工节律lift=-0.419，VLMM启发dICI lift=-0.196）；(7) 匹配节律缩放下，点击身份强依赖于速率（ARI≈0.07）而coda身份显著更稳定（ARI 0.43-0.52），形成跨层抽象梯度；(8) 去新颖点击检测控制下T1b仍存活（lift=0.347 vs 0.376）。Phase G闸门5/10主统计量存活，5/10被标记。

Conclusion: 抹香鲸coda呈现表征层面的窄义两层组合结构。下层为点击的无序库存加节律（click→coda），上层为coda在bout级别的序列依赖（coda→bout）。两层使用不同的组合规则：下层非纯序列、上层则具有可测量的二阶依赖。这种结构与"双重模式"设计特征的正式签名一致，但其下层是节律性的而非音段性的——这是与人类典型音段语言模型结构性不同的组合编码方案。方法论上，本文提供了一套可迁移的框架：跨编码器共识、每统计量零假设、声学零假设可恢复性闸门，用于在符号必须从音频中诱发的任何场景中区分组合结构与声学相似性。研究明确不声称语义、感知、行为使用或人类式音素，而是将该结构发现作为可验证的计算语言学问题。局限包括：单一种群（多米尼加）、bout样本量小、16 kHz采样率上限、共享编码器偏差未完全消除。

Abstract: Human language has often been described as combining structure at two levels: lower-level units combine into larger units, which then combine into larger sequences. We test for this design feature, duality of patterning, in sperm whale codas using 1,483 codas from the Dominica Sperm Whale Project. Because acoustic similarity can imitate symbolic structure, we treat the problem as computational-linguistic structure discovery from continuous audio rather than as a direct claim about language or meaning. We use a consensus of frozen audio encoders, held-out structural tests, per-statistic nulls, and acoustic-null recoverability gates. The evidence supports a narrow two-tier architecture. At the lower tier, clicks compose into codas not by a stable ordered rule, but by which clicks are present together with their inter-click rhythm. At the upper tier, coda tokens show bout-level sequential dependence, with an NSB second-order transfer-entropy lift of 0.132 bits (p = 0.002). Under tempo scaling, encoder-derived click identity is strongly rate-bound, while coda identity remains substantially more stable, yielding a measurable abstraction gradient across the click-to-coda step. Rhythm-only baselines recover substantial lower-tier structure but fail to reproduce the upper-tier sequential-dependence signal. We do not claim language, semantics, perception, or human-like phonemes. Instead, we report representation-level evidence for a duality-of-patterning-like architecture whose lower tier is rhythmic rather than segmental, and provide a portable null-controlled framework for testing combinatorial structure in induced acoustic token systems.

</details>


### [504] [RecourseBench: A Modular Framework for Reproducible Algorithmic Recourse Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16113)
*Zahra Khotanlou,Hashir Ahmed,Chenghao Tan,Ahmed Abdelaal,Amir-Hossein Karimi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: RecourseBench 是一个用于算法追索（algorithmic recourse）方法评估的模块化、可复现、交互式基准测试框架。它将流程分解为数据、预处理、模型、追索方法、评估五个解耦层，通过四级可复现性分类系统对集成的 28 种方法进行自动化验证，并提供交互式 Web 界面支持灵活对比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 算法追索方法虽发展迅速，但现有框架在模块化、可扩展性和可复现性方面存在显著不足：CARLA 架构紧耦合难以扩展，ReLax 受限于 JAX 生态，而所有现有基准均缺乏对方法忠实复现的自动化验证机制，阻碍了公平、可靠的比较。

Method: 框架基于四大设计原则（模块化、可扩展性、可复现性、实验完整性）构建：(1) 通过抽象基类（ABC）和 DatasetObject 消息传递实现五层完全解耦，采用动态注册器（@register 装饰器）实现即插即用；(2) 定义对称相对误差 Δ 作为复现度量，设定 35% 容差阈值 δ，将方法划分为 Level 0-3 四级复现等级；(3) 通过 YAML 配置驱动的中央 Experiment 工作流统一调度；(4) 采用负指数变换 m̃=e^(-m) 将异构指标归一化到 [0,1]，用户自定义指标子集计算聚合得分；(5) 基于 Web 界面提供可配置排行榜和预设指标画像（Balanced/Quality/Speed）。

Result: 框架集成了 28 种当前最优追索方法，涵盖 6 大类别（约束逻辑、梯度优化、表示学习、代理辅助、无导数启发式、实例搜索）；评估组合为 3 个数据集、3 种模型类型、22 种通过复现验证的方法，共 137 个兼容配置。复现结果显示文献存在显著结构性问题：4 个方法（DiCE、MACE、C-CHVAE、FACE）被排除，1 个（CF Expl.）因无定量指标无法评估，复现障碍主要来自缺失代码、未公开数据集、未指定超参数、商业软件依赖（如 Gurobi）、框架不兼容（TensorFlow vs PyTorch）以及伪随机序列执行顺序敏感性和硬件浮点差异等。

Conclusion: RecourseBench 是首个通过自动化定量测试强制执行方法级可复现性的追索基准，将可复现性从隐含期望转化为可标准化度量的属性；其模块化架构降低了新方法集成门槛，支持社区贡献扩展。未来工作应纳入方差估计、扩大方法注册表，并解决 δ=0.35 容差选择和缺少运行级方差聚合的局限性。

Abstract: Algorithmic recourse methods provide counterfactual explanations that inform individuals of the actions required to overturn an unfavorable model decision. Despite rapid methodological progress, principled comparison remains elusive; existing frameworks are often difficult to extend and lack both interoperability and systematic verification that integrated methods faithfully reproduce their originally reported results. We introduce \emph{RecourseBench}, a unified evaluation framework built around three commitments namely, modularity, reproducibility, and interactivity. The framework decomposes the pipeline into five fully decoupled layers -- Data, Preprocessing, Model, Recourse Method, and Evaluation -- governed by abstract interfaces and a dynamic registry. To address the reproducibility gap in prior benchmarks, we introduce a four-tier classification system in which every integrated method is validated by an automated test suite against its originally reported results. We further provide an interactive web interface for flexible, configuration-driven comparison across methods, datasets, and model architectures. Our framework currently integrates 28 state-of-the-art recourse methods and, to our knowledge, constitutes the first recourse benchmark to explicitly enforce method-level reproducibility through automated, quantitative testing.

</details>


### [505] [Know Your Limits : On the Faithfulness of LLMs as Solvers and Autoformalizers in Legal Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16118)
*Olivia Peiyu Wang,Sanna Wong-Toropainen,Daneshvar Amrollahi,Ryan Bai,Tashvi Bansal,Arush Garg,Leilani H. Gilpin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了大型语言模型（LLMs）在法律推理任务中作为求解器和自动形式化器的忠实性问题。通过比较纯LLM分类、LLM形式推理和Z3 SMT求解器形式推理三种范式，在重新标注的ContractNLI数据集上评估了五个LLM。研究发现引入形式结构虽能提升基准准确率，但并不意味着忠实推理，并识别出三种主要失败模式：scope laundering、隐式约束盲视和程序合成失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLMs在高风险法律领域应用受限，核心问题在于其推理是否忠实于逻辑推导还是仅依赖启发式近似。现有神经符号方法在法律领域的应用有限，且未系统评估"LLM作为求解器"范式是否真正忠实于底层符号执行。因此需要研究LLM形式推理的忠实性，揭示基准准确率与逻辑忠实性之间的根本差距。

Method: 1. 数据集构建：在ContractNLI基础上基于严格形式语义（可满足性检查）重新标注400个样本，并构建最小对扩展至610个样本。2. 神经符号管线：包含自动形式化器（将自然语言翻译为一阶逻辑FOL，经相关条款识别、谓词归一化、形式翻译、全局约束四个阶段）和求解器（Z3 SMT）。3. 三种范式比较：纯LLM分类、LLM形式推理、求解器形式推理。4. 在五个LLM（Claude、DeepSeek、GPT、Qwen、Llama）上进行实验和错误分析。

Result: 1. 引入形式结构提升准确率，LLM形式推理表现最佳（如Claude达83.0%），但Z3求解器更保守。2. 主要错误模式为N→E（过度蕴含）。3. 重新标注显示89个标签从Entailment/Contradiction转为Neutral，揭示语用解释与严格形式语义之间的系统性差距。4. 识别三种失败模式：scope laundering（所有模型均存在，GPT 15.3%到Qwen 52.5%）、隐式约束盲视（GPT 0.7%到Claude 4.4%）、程序合成失败（Claude 25.5%错误率到Llama 63.2%）。5. 标注者间一致性为81.0%（κ=0.627），分歧集中在Entailment与Neutral之间。

Conclusion: 本文揭示了基准准确率与逻辑忠实性之间的根本差距。形式结构的引入虽能提升性能，但LLM形式推理常产生看似逻辑合理实则未执行符号推理的分类结果（scope laundering），不能作为符号执行的忠实代理。法律文本的隐式假设问题影响人类标注和模型行为，进展需要不仅更好的模型，还需将隐式假设显式化并呈现给人类审查的律师中心推理工具。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong performance on reasoning tasks, but whether this reflects faithful logical inference or heuristic approximation remains unclear. We study this question in legal entailment by comparing three paradigms, including pure LLM classification, LLM-based Formal Reasoning, and solver-based Formal Reasoning using the Z3 SMT solver, on a re-annotated subset of ContractNLI across five LLMs. Our re-annotation reveals a systematic and measurable gap between pragmatic legal interpretation and strict formal entailment, where a substantial proportion of legally sound inferences are not formally grounded without additional unstated assumptions. While introducing formal structure improves accuracy, with LLM-based Formal Reasoning achieving the highest benchmark performance, we show that this gain does not imply faithful reasoning. We identify three recurring failure modes: scope laundering, where LLMs report solver-inconsistent classifications without executing the underlying formal reasoning, producing conclusions that appear logically grounded but are not; implicit constraint blindness, where LLMs overlook logical constraints present in formal representations; and program synthesis failures, where LLMs generate incorrect Z3 code despite structured prompting. Critically, scope laundering persists across all models, raising serious concerns about the faithfulness of LLM-based formal reasoning as a proxy for symbolic execution. These results reveal a fundamental gap between benchmark accuracy and logical faithfulness.

</details>


### [506] [Thinking with Visual Grounding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16122)
*Junkai Zhang,Yihe Deng,Kai-Wei Chang,Wei Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"视觉锚定思维"（visually grounded thinking）范式，通过让视觉语言模型在自然语言推理过程中显式地以点（point）或框（box）形式标注关键视觉证据的区域坐标，实现推理过程与图像区域的可验证、可监督对齐。基于Gemma3-4B-IT模型，在2个计数基准和4个空间推理基准上验证：4B带视觉锚定的模型在空间推理上可匹配甚至超越同系列的27B模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLM的"thinking"过程以纯自然语言形式输出推理链，但视觉问答的证据存在于图像中而非文字中，导致：(1) 推理过程难以验证（即使最终答案正确，推理链可能与图像无关但仍显合理）；(2) 难以在视觉证据层面进行细粒度监督。作者借鉴人类回答视觉问题时会把思维锚定到具体图像区域的方式，提出需要一种将语言推理与图像区域显式绑定的思维范式。

Method: （1）可扩展的数据合成流水线：从Qwen3-VL-Plus等模型蒸馏正确的视觉推理轨迹，提取推理所需的关键视觉对象（以"名称+场景上下文"表示），使用基于SAM3的agent（结合VLM与四种工具动作：调用SAM3、验证渲染掩码、选择最终掩码ID、报告无检测）进行迭代式grounding以获得RLE掩码，再转换为[0,1000]坐标系下的点（取掩码内距边界最远的内部点）或框作为SFT与RL监督信号。最终产出19,909条推理轨迹和72,381个grounded对象。（2）Grounding-aware强化学习：使用GRPO算法，奖励由答案正确性、思考格式、grounding格式、截断惩罚构成的稀疏奖励和密集的grounding质量奖励组成。Box模式用生成框集合与真值框集合并集区域的IoU均值；Point模式用生成的点与真值掩码的一对一匹配的F1均值。通过一个轻量VLM路由器（Qwen3.5-4B）匹配模型生成对象与真值对象，再评分。

Result: 在2个计数基准（TallyBench、CountQA）和4个空间推理基准（VSR-zeroshot、EmbSpatial、SpatialMQA、MultihopSpatial）上，基于Gemma3-4B-IT训练的三种对照变体（无grounded thinking、box grounded thinking、point grounded thinking）显示：视觉锚定思维显著优于基座模型和纯语言思维基线（后者出现训练过程中响应长度线性坍缩导致性能大幅下降）。空间推理上，4B视觉锚定模型在SpatialMQA和MultihopSpatial上超过Gemma3-27B-IT，VSR-zeroshot和EmbSpatial上接近12B-27B之间。Pass@4指标上所有视觉锚定模型大幅超过27B模型。Box模式在加入grounding奖励后在空间任务上提升最明显（依赖对象边界与几何关系）；Point模式在计数任务上更优（仅需实例级定位），在空间任务上与box模式接近但grounding奖励带来的下游增益不如box模式稳定。

Conclusion: 视觉思维的下一步不是更长的思维链，而是将思维"锚定"到图像区域，使其可检查、可监督、可改进。通过SAM3-based合成流水线与grounding-aware RL的组合训练，4B级VLM即可在空间推理上匹敌甚至超过同系列27B模型，验证了"思维—证据绑定"对视觉推理的重要性。Point grounding适合计数类实例定位，box grounding配合显式grounding奖励更适合需要几何关系的空间推理。

Abstract: Visual thinking should not only sound right; it should show its evidence. While recent vision-language models (VLMs) can produce natural-language reasoning traces, these traces often leave the supporting image regions implicit, making them hard to verify and difficult to supervise. We introduce visually grounded thinking, a reasoning process in which models interleave natural-language thoughts with explicit point or box groundings of the visual evidence used at each step. This lets the model express intermediate reasoning in language while grounding key objects in the image regions they refer to. To train this behavior, we construct a scalable synthesis pipeline that distills correct visual reasoning traces, extracts the visual objects required by the traces, grounds them with a SAM3-based agent, and derives aligned point and box supervision from the resulting masks. We further propose grounding-aware reinforcement learning, which combines answer correctness rewards with dense grounding rewards that score whether generated object references match the correct image evidence. Across two counting benchmarks and four spatial reasoning benchmarks, adding visually grounded thinking to Gemma3-4B-IT consistently improves performance over the original model and the non-grounded thinking baseline. On spatial reasoning, the visually grounded thinking 4B models match, and in some cases surpass, Gemma3-27B-IT from the same model family. Our analysis shows that point grounding is well suited to counting, while box grounding benefits most from explicit grounding rewards on spatial tasks. Overall, our results show that VLMs think better when their intermediate thoughts are tied to the image regions that make them true.

</details>


### [507] [VibeThinker-3B: Exploring the Frontier of Verifiable Reasoning in Small Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16140)
*Sen Xu,Shixi Liu,Wei Wang,Jixin Min,Yingwei Dai,Zhibin Yin,Yirong Chen,Xin Zhou,Junlin Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 VibeThinker-3B，一个仅 3B 参数的稠密小型语言模型，通过 Spectrum-to-Signal 后训练范式（课程学习 SFT + 多领域 RL + 离线自蒸馏），在 AIME26（94.3，CLR 后 97.1）、HMMT25（89.3）、LiveCodeBench v6（80.2 Pass@1）、IMO-AnswerBench（76.4）等高难度可验证推理任务上达到与 DeepSeek V3.2（671B）、GLM-5（744B）、Kimi K2.5（1T）、Gemini 3 Pro 等旗舰大模型相当甚至更优的水平，并在近期 LeetCode 竞赛 OOD 测试中取得 96.1% 通过率，同时 IFEval 上 93.4 分证明推理增强未损害指令可控性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前业界普遍依赖通过扩大参数规模来突破困难推理任务的性能门槛，前沿推理能力主要集中在数百亿至上千亿参数的大模型上。小型语言模型（≤3B）虽具备部署成本、推理效率和学术可及性优势，但被认为在复杂数学推导和编程任务上存在固有瓶颈。本文动机在于挑战"小模型必然存在推理能力上限"的传统认知，探索 3B 模型在可验证推理任务上的真实能力边界，并回答"3B 参数预算是否足以进入第一梯队推理系统性能带"这一核心问题。

Method: 1. **基座与整体框架**：基于 Qwen2.5-Coder-3B，沿用并强化前作 VibeThinker-1.5B 提出的 Spectrum-to-Signal Principle（SSP）后训练范式——SFT 阶段构建宽广解题空间（Spectrum），RL 阶段放大高价值推理信号（Signal）。2. **SFT 阶段**：构建多领域（数学、代码、STEM、通用对话、指令遵循）合成数据；采用多路径推理蒸馏保留完整中间步骤；实施 N-gram 过滤、LLM 查询质量过滤、轨迹正确性过滤三级质量控制；采用两阶段课程学习——第一阶段（5 epoch，lr=5e-5，余弦退火）广覆盖冷启动，第二阶段（2 epoch）以 VibeThinker-1.5B 为参考模型做 8 次 rollout，筛选错误率≥0.75 的长链难题；通过 Diversity-Exploring Distillation 合并领域专才模型。3. **RL 阶段**：核心算法为 MGPO（MaxEnt-Guided Policy Optimization），通过对经验正确率 p(q) 与最大熵点 p₀=0.5 的散度施加权重 w(q)=exp(-γ·D_ME(p(q)∥p₀))，聚焦能力边界附近的 prompt；采用 on-policy 稳定化策略；使用单一 64K 长上下文窗口（摒弃渐进式扩展以保护长链推理能力）；按"数学→代码→STEM"顺序进行多领域推理 RL；引入 Long2Short Math RL，在正确子集内做基于 1/L_i 的零和重分配（λ=0.2）以提升 token 效率。4. **离线自蒸馏**：对各阶段 checkpoint 做拒绝采样，引入学习势能分数 S_LP（学生模型的归一化负对数似然），按域内长度分桶筛选中高分区间的轨迹，回灌统一学生模型。5. **Instruct RL**：在 on-policy 框架下混合规则验证（格式/顺序/关键词约束）与 rubric 奖励，提升复杂指令下的可控性。6. **测试时扩展**：提出 Claim-Level Reliability Assessment（CLR），K=32 次采样提取 M=5 个决策相关声明，模型自验证生成二元判决 v_{k,m}，通过非线性轨迹可靠度 r_k=(1/M·Σv_{k,m})^M 与等价聚类加权投票得出最终答案。

Result: 1. **核心基准**（表 1）：VibeThinker-3B（3B）在 AIME25 91.4、AIME26 94.3、HMMT25 89.3、BruMO25 93.8、IMO-AnswerBench 76.4、LiveCodeBench v6 80.2、OJBench 38.6、GPQA-Diamond 70.2、IFEval 93.4、IFBench 74.5 上全面领先所有 14B 以下对比模型；LiveCodeBench v6 80.2 与 IFEval 93.4 在整张表（包括大模型）中均位居前列。2. **与顶级模型对比**（表 2）：裸跑状态下 AIME26 94.3 与 DeepSeek V3.2（671B）94.2、Kimi K2.5（1T）93.3 持平，BruMO25 93.8 超过多款超大模型；启用 CLR 后跃升至 AIME25 96.7、AIME26 97.1、HMMT25 95.4、BruMO25 99.2、IMO-AnswerBench 80.6、GPQA-Diamond 72.9，进入顶级集群，可与 Gemini 3 Pro、GLM-5、Claude Opus 4.5 等模型同台竞争。3. **OOD 泛化**（表 3）：在 2026.04.25–05.31 的 LeetCode 周赛/双周赛 8 场共 128 题上，VibeThinker-3B 一次性 Python 提交通过 123 题（96.1%），高于 GPT-5.2（95.3%）、Kimi K2.5（90.6%）、Claude Opus 4.6（86.7%）、GLM-5（76.6%）等，远超其参数量级，仅次于 Gemini 3.1 Pro（99.2%）和 GPT-5.3-Codex（100%）。4. **性能边界**：GPQA-Diamond 等知识密集型基准仍与超大模型存在可见差距，验证"推理可压缩、知识需覆盖"的假说。

Conclusion: 本文以 VibeThinker-3B 为"参数规模探针"实证表明：在精心设计的后训练范式（课程 SFT + MGPO 多领域 RL + 离线自蒸馏 + 指令对齐）与合理的测试时扩展（CLR）下，3B 紧凑模型即可在 AIME、HMMT、IMO-AnswerBench、LiveCodeBench 等高难度可验证推理任务上进入与 DeepSeek V3.2、GLM-5、Kimi K2.5、Gemini 3 Pro、Claude Opus 4.5 等旗舰系统相当的性能带，并在近期 LeetCode 竞赛中展现强 OOD 泛化。基于此提出 **Parametric Compression-Coverage Hypothesis**：可验证推理属于"参数密集型"能力，其核心是结构化解空间内的搜索、约束满足、纠错与多步组合，可被高度压缩进紧凑的"推理核"；而开放域知识与通用能力属于"参数广覆型"能力，依赖对长尾事实、概念与语义关联的广覆盖。这一区分衍生出 **Reasoning-Knowledge Decoupling Paradigm**——大模型继续承担知识广度，结构约束与可靠训练信号下的小模型已足以承载高密度推理深度。因此 SLM 不应仅被视为部署效率驱动的被动妥协，而应被视为与传统参数规模化范式根本互补的、有前景的研究路径，为未来推理系统设计提供新思路。

Abstract: This technical report introduces VibeThinker-3B, a compact dense model with 3B parameters developed to investigate how far verifiable reasoning can be pushed within a strictly small-model regime. Building upon the Spectrum-to-Signal post-training paradigm, we systematically enhance the model through an optimized pipeline that includes curriculum-based supervised fine-tuning, multi-domain reinforcement learning, and offline self-distillation. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that VibeThinker-3B achieves frontier-level performance on highly demanding verifiable tasks. Specifically, it attains a score of 94.3 on AIME26 (improving to 97.1 with claim-level test-time scaling), an 80.2 Pass@1 on LiveCodeBench v6, and exhibits strong out-of-distribution generalization with a 96.1\% acceptance rate on recent unseen LeetCode contests. This effectively places it in the performance band of first-tier reasoning systems, matching or exceeding flagship models that are orders of magnitude larger, such as DeepSeek V3.2, GLM-5, and Gemini 3 Pro. Furthermore, a score of 93.4 on IFEval confirms that this extreme reasoning enhancement does not compromise strict instruction controllability. Extending our previous 1.5B work, these findings motivate the Parametric Compression-Coverage Hypothesis, which views verifiable reasoning as compressible into compact reasoning cores, while open-domain knowledge and general-purpose competence require broad parameter coverage over facts, concepts, and long-tail scenarios. This perspective suggests that compact models are not merely deployment-efficient substitutes, but a complementary path toward frontier-level performance in parameter-dense capability regimes.

</details>


### [508] [LiteOdyssey: A Lightweight Reasoning AI Agent for Interpretable Rare-Disease Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16149)
*Minh-Ha Nguyen,Erica Gray,Chih-Ting Yang,Rizwan Hamid,Lingyao Li,Siyuan Ma,Thomas A. Cassini,Cathy Shyr*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: LiteOdyssey 是一种轻量级、单智能体、工具增强的罕见病诊断框架，通过临床遗传学工作流引导单个推理语言模型进行端到端诊断，在仅使用患者临床特征（HPO术语）的条件下，于 LIRICAL 和 PhenoPacket Store 两个公开基准上达到当前最优性能（合并 Recall@1 为 59.3%），且无需微调、多智能体集成或大规模病例检索库。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有罕见病医疗 AI 系统普遍通过堆叠更多微调数据、更多智能体或更大检索库来提升性能，但这导致系统部署、审计和维护成本高昂。本研究旨在探索能否通过扩展单一 AI 智能体的推理链（结合人机协作开发的诊断策略和免费的生物医学工具）实现最先进诊断性能，从而降低部署门槛并提高临床可审计性。

Method: 核心方法包括三部分：(1) PIHF（Policy Iteration with Human Feedback），一种无权重的人机协作优化流程，将人类反馈转化为自然语言诊断策略文档的迭代修订，类比于 RLHF 但作用于策略而非模型权重；(2) 一个八阶段的临床推理工作流（从模式识别、表型-基因候选生成、证据分诊、深度调查、置信度评估、纠正性搜索、反思性裁定到最终输出），每阶段指定调用哪些生物医学工具及如何权衡证据；(3) 一个包含八个命令行工具的生物医学工具库，覆盖表型-基因排序、基因-疾病查询、疾病家族搜索、基因-疾病有效性、基因约束、文献检索、遗传分析及变异过滤，调用 Monarch、OMIM、ClinGen、gnomAD、PubMed 等公共或缓存知识源。系统由单一推理语言模型（GPT-5.4、Qwen3.6-35B-A3B、Claude Opus 4.6）端到端执行。

Result: 在 LIRICAL（370 例）和 PhenoPacket Store（873 例）两个仅含临床特征的公开基准上，LiteOdyssey 分别取得 58.6% 和 59.6% 的疾病 Recall@1，合并 59.3%；Recall@5 分别为 73.2% 和 78.0%。在更具挑战性的 Orphanet 未映射 PhenoPacket 子集上，全系统 Recall@1 达 60.7%，而同一基线模型（GPT-5.4）不使用工具时仅 10.7%（提升 50.0 个百分点）。结构化环境的增益在排除开发用病例的子集（+23.4 个百分点）、小型开源权重模型 Qwen3.6-35B（LIRICAL +8.1、PhenoPacket +39.0）、以及 515 例 Undiagnosed Diseases Network 真实世界未确诊患者（+3.7 个百分点，p=0.027）上均得到验证。基因层面，PhenoPacket Store 上 GPT-5.4 的基因 Recall@1 提升 37.6 个百分点，Qwen3.6 提升 47.4 个百分点；UDN 队列中基因 Recall@5 提升 5.3 个百分点（Bonferroni 校正后 p=0.0049）。

Conclusion: LiteOdyssey 证明诊断性能不仅取决于模型"知道什么"，还取决于"如何组织其推理过程"。通过将诊断流程编码为可外部化、可审计的自然语言策略而非训练权重，该系统在显著降低部署负担（无需微调、多智能体编排、病例检索库或专用硬件）的同时达到了最先进准确率，并提供可逐案审查的推理轨迹，为资源有限机构部署罕见病 AI 诊断支持提供了可行路径。局限性包括：主要依赖表型信息、未整合实验室/生化/遗传检测结果；公共基准为回顾性策划病例；未评估系统在常见病或非罕见病患者中的行为；推理轨迹是审计制品而非模型内部计算机制透明度。未来工作将纳入更丰富的临床输入、前瞻性临床验证以及将 PIHF 策略蒸馏至模型权重的可能性。

Abstract: Most medical AI systems improve by scaling additional machinery: more fine-tuning data, more agents, and/or larger retrieval databases. In rare-disease diagnosis, however, such scaling can produce systems that are difficult to deploy, audit, and maintain. We asked whether state-of-the-art diagnostic performance could instead be achieved by extending the reasoning chain of a single AI agent: guiding it with a diagnostic policy, developed through human-AI collaboration and augmenting with freely available biomedical tools. We introduce LiteOdyssey, a lightweight rare-disease diagnostic framework that guides reasoning language model through a clinical genetics workflow. This framework was developed through Policy Iteration with Human Feedback (PIHF) and uses dynamic access to public biomedical tools. On two challenging benchmarks that provide only patient clinical features, LiteOdyssey achieved state-of-the-art performance, with an overall disease Recall@1 of 59.3% over the combined 1,243 cases of LIRICAL (n = 370) and the PhenoPacket Store (n = 873). Both benchmarks have a high proportion of ultra-rare disease (a prevalence below 1 in 1,000,000, with ultra-rare shares of approximately 45% and 52.8%, respectively). On the more difficult PhenoPacket subset, where causal diseases were not mapped to Orphanet in our rarity-mapping pipeline, LiteOdyssey achieved 60.7% Recall@1, compared with 10.7% for the same baseline model (GPT-5.4) without tools. This performance was achieved without fine-tuning, multi-agent ensembles, or a large case-retrieval database. Gains were also observed in the following: on cases never seen during development, on a private cohort of real-world rare disease patients, and on a smaller open-weights model. LiteOdyssey suggests a path toward rare-disease AI systems that are accurate, easier to deploy, and more transparent for physician review.

</details>


### [509] [The Quality-Utility Paradox: Why High-Reward Data Impairs Small Model Mathematical Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16152)
*Haolong Qian,Xianliang Yang,Yinuo ma,Lirong Che,Feng Lu,Ye Guo,Lei Song,Jiang Bian,Chun Yuan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文揭示了小语言模型（SLM）数学推理蒸馏中的"质量-效用悖论"：在数学推理任务中，经更强Oracle模型精炼或合成的数据虽获得更高的奖励模型评分（"感知质量"），却因偏离目标SLM的原生推理分布而增加了学习适配成本，导致下游任务表现反而不如SLM自身通过拒绝采样生成的数据（SLM-RFT）。论文提出Style-Aligned Refinement（风格对齐精炼）方法，在保留Oracle逻辑修正的同时维持SLM原生推理风格，有效恢复了下游效用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在SLM数学推理的知识蒸馏实践中，业界普遍假设奖励模型评分更高的数据是更好的监督信号。然而，本文质疑这一假设的普适性：当Oracle模型对SLM的推理轨迹进行精炼以提升逻辑质量时，可能同时引入与SLM原生分布的偏移，使得更高感知质量的数据反而难以被SLM有效吸收。论文旨在揭示这一矛盾现象并提供解决方案。

Method: 1. **数据集构建**：基于同一问题集（约34,000道题）构建四个并行数据集：NuminaMath Subset（原始CoT）、SLM-RFT（SLM自生成并保守过滤）、Oracle-Refined（GPT-5.2精炼SLM-RFT）、Oracle-Synthesized（GPT-5.2从头生成）。2. **Style-Aligned Refinement干预**：通过提示工程指导Oracle在修正逻辑错误时严格模仿SLM的原生语言风格和结构，使用Qwen-72B和GPT-5.2分别实现。3. **多维度分析**：token级分布分析、LLM-as-a-Judge语义保真度评估、Perplexity分析（衡量适配成本）、跨模型奖励评估（Qwen2.5-Math-72B-RM、Skywork-RM-27B、Nemotron-70B-RM）。4. **跨模型/跨规模验证**：在Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B/7B、LLaMA-3.2-3B、DeepSeek-Math-7B上验证，分别采用SFT和DFT两种训练目标。

Result: **核心结果**（Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B, DFT, Avg@16）：SLM-RFT（奖励分1.47）达到37.06%准确率，显著优于Oracle-Refined（1.70→34.06%）、NuminaMath Subset（1.78→31.28%）、Oracle-Synthesized（1.88→30.02%）。**Style-Aligned (Qwen)**获得最低奖励分1.37却实现最高准确率39.12%，超过所有基线。**机制发现**：Oracle精炼引入"句法压缩"（Syntactic Compaction）现象——密集符号算子（裸反斜杠频率增加3.6%）取代SLM原生的自然语言脚手架（间隔符、连接词减少），导致Q1起始阶段loss贡献者从语义引导词（"To"、"the"）转变为结构标记（"\("、"\"）。Global PPL与下游性能呈严格负相关。**跨模型验证**：现象在四个模型家族、两种训练算法（SFT/DFT）、多组超参数下均稳定存在。

Conclusion: 论文得出三个核心结论：(1) 识别出SLM蒸馏中的质量-效用悖论，挑战了"高奖励分=高质量训练数据"的传统假设；(2) 揭示了Oracle精炼的双面效应——既改善逻辑质量又引入分布漂移，适配成本可能超过逻辑收益；(3) 提出Style-Aligned Refinement作为机制验证，表明将逻辑修正与风格分离后，Oracle改进可重新被SLM有效利用。论文强调有效的数学推理蒸馏应联合优化感知质量与学习者-数据兼容性（pseudo-on-policy特性），而非仅依赖奖励模型评分。该工作为设计学习者感知的蒸馏数据选择策略提供了方法论指导。

Abstract: Knowledge distillation from powerful reasoning models is widely used to improve Small Language Models (SLMs) on mathematical reasoning, often assuming that traces with higher reward model scores provide more useful supervision. We identify a counterintuitive \textbf{Quality-Utility Paradox} in mathematical reasoning distillation. Data refined or synthesized by a stronger Oracle obtains higher perceived quality according to reward models, yet consistently underperforms traces generated by the SLM itself and selected through rejection sampling across Qwen2.5, LLaMA-3, and DeepSeek families. Our analysis shows that Oracle refinement couples logical repair with distributional drift away from the SLM's native reasoning distribution. This drift increases the learner's adaptation cost and can outweigh the benefit of improved reasoning logic. To test this mechanism, we introduce \textbf{Style-Aligned Refinement}, which preserves the native trajectory of the SLM while retaining logical repair from the Oracle. This intervention lowers adaptation cost and restores downstream utility. These findings suggest that effective mathematical reasoning distillation should jointly optimize perceived solution quality and learner-data compatibility, rather than relying solely on reward-model scores. The datasets and code are available at this https URL .

</details>


### [510] [AI Pluralism and the Worlds It Misses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16167)
*Rashid Mushkani*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"AI多元主义"不应仅关注输出层面的多元价值/偏好表征，还应关注AI系统强加的本体论（ontology）。作者将"本体论扁平化"（ontological flattening）定义为一种将情境化、有争议、具有历史特定性的意义转化为被视作中立的有限技术范畴、代理变量、聚合规则或基准目标的过程。据此提出"多元生命周期治理"（PLG）框架，作为定性审计支架，覆盖本体论开放性、认识论包容性、程序性权威、评估多元主义和生命周期问责性五个维度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的多元对齐（pluralistic alignment）和参与式AI研究多聚焦于表征多元价值、暴露多元答案、支持跨视角操控或匹配人口分布，但忽视了一个前置问题：多元方法何时保留了可争议的世界建构方式，何时将其压缩为固定的技术本体论？例如，"安全""可达性""包容性"等概念被还原为模型可优化的稳定类别时，损失了情境性、争议性和历史性。这一空白亟需在AI治理中显性化。

Method: 采用有界概念与定性综合方法：(1) 概念图谱——对价值多元主义、多元对齐、参与式与民主AI、程序正义、STS与女性主义认识论、问责研究等进行目的性理论抽样；(2) 11次半结构化专家访谈（7次初步+4次PLG聚焦），仅作为构念精炼证据；(3) 三个城市公共空间AI配套案例的二次分析：Case A（多准则公共空间生成数据集与DPO实验）、Case B（参与式街道包容性建模）、Case C（可靠性感知的城市视觉-语言基准）。采用五码矩阵（本体论入口、异议处理、权威与救济、代理限制、生命周期延续）进行跨案例机制分析。明确区分四类主张：文献确立、访谈综合、案例源报告、作者推论。

Result: (1) 概念上：明确界定"本体论扁平化"为AI多元主义的一种生命周期失败模式，与偏差、测量错误、代理失败、表征伤害、形式化参与相邻但不同；区分"结果多元主义"（多元输出/操控/偏好分布）与"程序多元主义"（对问题框架、范畴、证据、聚合、评估、修订的权威）。(2) 案例机制：Cases A和B表明后期参与仅能填充既有本体论；Case A中DPO二元偏好优化压缩了中立比较的语义；Case B中视觉代理可能将"包容性"窄化为可见美学；Case C中不同维度的可靠性差异意味着"准确率"在低人类一致性维度上具有误导性。(3) 框架贡献：PLG作为定性审计支架，提供五维度诊断问题、充分证据与不充分指标、证据状态分类（已记录/部分记录/缺失/未知），明确区分文档化与权威性。

Conclusion: AI多元主义不能仅通过多输出、多用户、多偏好实现；必须解决AI系统将多元生活世界（lifeworlds）压缩为单一技术本体论的问题。PLG框架通过将本体论可争议性显性化作为AI治理的对象，使多元主义超越模型输出层延伸至整个生命周期。该框架目前为初步定性审计支架，未经评分量表验证，需未来通过独立评分者、前瞻性应用、决策影响追踪等进行实证检验。多元程序需配套补偿、可达性、多语言支持等制度资源，否则易演变为劳动剥削。多元主义并非制度瘫痪，而是"临时共识"——其合法性依赖于可争议程序、公共理由、记录异议与修订路径。

Abstract: AI pluralism is often framed as a problem of representing diverse values, preferences, users, or outputs. This paper argues that this framing is incomplete because AI systems also impose ontologies: they define what counts as an entity, relation, feature, harm, benefit, and valid form of evidence. We define ontological flattening as the conversion of situated, contested, and historically specific meanings into a restricted technical category, proxy, aggregation rule, or benchmark target that is treated as neutral and difficult to contest. The paper develops a bounded conceptual and qualitative synthesis across value pluralism, pluralistic alignment, participatory and democratic AI, procedural justice, science and technology studies, accountability research, aggregate themes from 11 expert interviews, and three urban AI companion cases. The cases illustrate how pluralistic methods can improve or structure model behavior while still compressing categories, proxies, aggregation rules, and revision rights before affected actors have procedural standing. We introduce Pluralistic Lifecycle Governance (PLG) as a preliminary qualitative audit scaffold for documenting ontological openness, epistemic inclusion, procedural authority, evaluation pluralism, and lifecycle accountability. PLG is not presented as a validated scoring instrument; it is a framework for making the evidence and governance conditions of pluralistic AI explicit.

</details>


### [511] [TimeVista: Exploring and Exploiting Vision-Language Models as Judges for Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16173)
*Zhi Chen,Yuxuan Wang,Jialong Wu,Yong Liu,Haoran Zhang,Xingjian Su,Jianmin Wang,Mingsheng Long*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: TimeVista 提出首个面向时间序列预测的 VLM-as-a-Judge 基准,包含 5,563 个样本与详细评分细则,通过微观(趋势/形态/相位/幅度)与宏观(领域知识)两级评估协议,验证了 VLM 作为评判者与人类专家具有高度一致性,并显著优于 MSE、MAE、DTW 等传统点对点指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统点对点指标(MSE/MAE)难以捕捉时间序列的形态结构与领域特定偏好(如 ECG 波形完整性、交通速度拥堵谷底、能源负值),与人类直觉严重脱节。文本型 LLM-as-a-Judge 虽在 NLP 评测中成功,但时间序列存在离散化、注意力衰减、模式可视化困难等模态鸿沟。受到人类专家通过可视化曲线评估预测质量的启发,作者提出借助 VLM 的视觉-语言联合理解能力,实现与人类偏好对齐的时间序列预测评估。

Method: 1) 形式化定义:将预测评估建模为 VLM 接受高分辨率时间序列图 V 与文本评分细则 C,输出 1-5 Likert 分数 s 与解释 R 的多模态判断任务;2) 两级评估协议:微观层将时间序列分解为趋势(T)、幅度(A)、形态(M)、相位(P)四个正交维度,采用五点李克特量表;宏观层针对医疗/金融/能源/交通等八大领域设计领域特定评分细则,并由人类专家迭代打磨;3) 构建 TimeVista(5,563 样本:5,163 真实+400 通过 kernel-synth 正交合成)与 Meta-TimeVista(1,025 预测案例,5 位专家标注,Spearman ρ>0.89);4) 采用 6 种 VLM(Gemini-3.1-Pro、GPT-5.4、Claude-Sonnet-4.6 等),以 Spearman ρ 与 Kendall τ 衡量与人类一致性,并在 13 个预测模型(3 个统计方法、9 个 TSFM、1 个多模态 Aurora)上完成 GIFT-Eval 微观重评与 TimeVista 宏观评估。

Result: 1) VLM 评判者与人类专家高度一致:Gemini-3.1-Pro 在微观四维度 Spearman ρ 达 0.860-0.907,宏观层 ρ 达 0.865-0.909,显著优于 MSE(ρ=0.390)、MAE(0.402)、DTW(0.421),且在宏观 w/knowledge 场景下传统指标甚至呈负相关;2) 视觉模态效率与性能双优:相比文本输入,图像化使 token 成本与预测长度无关,且各长度下相关性均更高;3) 鲁棒性:对随机颜色/线型保持 82.8% 评分一致,纵横比变化下相关性波动<0.011;4) 模型评估洞察:Chronos2 与 Moirai2 在趋势维度领先但相位/幅度弱,Seasonal Naive 反而在相位/幅度上具竞争力;13 个模型宏观得分均偏低,最佳 Chronos2 仅 2.188/5,Aurora 虽能输入文本但无法转化为约束,常预测物理不可能的负值。

Conclusion: TimeVista 验证了 VLM-as-a-Judge 作为人类对齐、可靠且可解释的时间序列预测评估范式的可行性,弥补了点对点指标在结构保真度与领域实用性上的盲区;同时揭示了当前 TSFM 在相位对齐与领域约束遵守方面的关键缺陷,为下一代预测模型的研发提供了更贴近实际部署需求的反馈信号。未来工作将聚焦于开源专用 VLM 评测模型、多变量场景扩展以及面向罕见专业领域的专家级评分细则构建。

Abstract: High-quality time series forecasting is pivotal for real-world decision-making. However, traditional point-wise metrics often fail to reveal complex temporal patterns and align poorly with human intuitive preferences. While the ''LLM-as-a-Judge'' paradigm has revolutionized text evaluation by providing flexible, human-aligned judgment, its application to time series remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we leverage Vision-Language Models (VLMs) as judges for time series forecasting, harnessing their ability to comprehend time series plots grounded in textual information. Specifically, we propose a novel framework integrating micro- and macro-level judgments informed by contextual information to evaluate time series forecasting. To this end, we introduce TimeVista, a comprehensive VLM-as-a-Judge benchmark comprising 5563 time series samples paired with detailed evaluation rubrics. Extensive meta-evaluations demonstrate that VLMs are highly reliable judges, achieving significantly higher consistency with human preferences than conventional metrics. Building upon our benchmark, we comprehensively assess recent Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) under the VLM-as-a-Judge paradigm. Our results demonstrate that VLMs serve as robust and interpretable judges, providing a comprehensive, human-aligned standard for evaluating time series models.

</details>


### [512] [PAL-Bench: Evidence-Grounded Profile Reconstruction from Longitudinal Personal Albums](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.16175)
*Qiwei Yan,Zhiqiang Yuan,Zexi Jia,Nanxing Hu,Kailin Lyu,Jie Zhou,Jinchao Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: PAL-Bench 是首个针对纵向个人相册进行证据溯源式档案重建任务的受控基准。它将个人相册建模为弱模式多模态数据库，通过"证据编译器"从潜在私有世界生成经过感知重建的公共记录，并强制公私分离审计。基准包含50个合成用户、36,659条公共照片记录和2,799个评估目标。提出的PAL-TRACE参考框架通过状态分离（先冻结身份绑定再挖掘事实）取得最佳结果，但硬身份解析仍未解决。


<details>
